"Heh, well then I'll give you a good fight. Now let's dance!" I exclaim.

I take to the skies and quickly form a few spheres of compressed Space.

I aim them towards Guy. "Archangel Shootdown!" We still have the kiddie gloves on so I might as well see how these Magics I created do in a real fight, though testing them against Guy might have been a bit pointless.

I'm proven right when Guy simply slaps the balls away with his Aura coated hand.

"Hah! I expected more from you Felix!" Guy taunted.

"I'm just getting started!" I respond.

Unfortunately Guy doesn't give me the chance to cast my next Magic as he generated an Abyss Core and then crushed it causing it to release a Dark Light.

Fuck he used Death Streak. A Nuclear Magic that bypasses all physical and magical defenses while killing everything it touches, it can even destroy souls. It releases a Dark Light since it agitates Spiritrons which causes the Spiritrons to release radiation which is what the Dark Light is.

According to Arcueid Death Streak is the Magic Guy used to become a True Demon Lord.

I assume Guy used this in a casual fight since he felt like I could handle it, and he would be correct.

The best way to counteract Death Streak is with a Death Streak of your own.

I quickly generated an Abyss Core and crushed it, and then guided the agitated Spiritrons to release the Dark Light in the direction of Guy's own attack resulting in a stalemate.

I of course could have also just consumed the Dark Light with Beelzebuth but I want to have a bit of fun too, relying on my Ultimate Skill to no sell everything when it isn't necessary is boring.

Of course I could immediately tell that this wasn't Guy's entire plan, my worries were proved correct when I sensed Guy appear behind me.

"Calamity Claw!"

And for the first time in a very long time my Extra Skill: Ultra Instinct warned me of danger to my being.

'Notice. The Art Calamity Claw carries an intense poison property capable of corroding the mind the moment it impacts.'

Heh, unfortunately for Guy his attack would never land.

I turned to look at the confused Guy as his hand refused to budge and hit me, of course he almost immediately realized the issue.

"Spatial Manipulation huh? And from your Ultimate Skill at that, I guess it's time to take off the kiddie gloves then." He said before backing off.

"I have just the Skill to deal with Spatial Manipulators like you Felix. Don't prove my praise wrong by dying here!" Guy said with a dark grin. Is he a battle maniac?

"Hah! As if I'd die so easily." I began relying on Satanael as I increased my power by slowly giving into my Wrath.

Of course I could still control myself perfectly thanks to Odin, there was just a slightly red tint to my mind, I could feel myself get stronger as I let my anger flow through me.

Guy seemed to have sensed it too as he muttered, "Satanael?" He knows then. Unfortunately that information isn't quite enough to determine if he copied Satanael from Milim.

All I know is that if he has Satanael, this is gonna be a long fight.

All of a sudden I sensed the Spiritrons all around Guy begin to go wild. How the hell is he controlling them to this level!? Even I would need to rely almost completely on Odin to even come close to this feat.

Did he have a Skill like Odin? If he does that will increase his threat level by multiple magnitudes.

He waved his hand towards me and immediately the Spiritrons followed his commands and began to bombard me. I immediately increased my Thought Acceleration.

Spiritrons are capable of ignoring Space all together making them easily pass through any kind of barriers, it's even capable of ignoring Infinity so I need to take this seriously.

A thought my Ultra Instinct agreed with.

Ultimate Skill: Metatron, Lord of Purity has been analyzed.

I'm not surprised that it's an Ultimate Skill, an extremely powerful one too. Its main purpose is purifying energy, it's quite similar to Holy Magic in fact.

At least that lays some of my worries to rest, if he had an Odin-like Skill of my own I would be incredibly wary of him.

This Skill also allows the user an extremely high level of control over Spiritrons, it's due to this that its full potential cannot be unleashed without causing mass amounts of destruction.

With this Skill Guy is capable of casually sending beams with the same properties as Disintegration, on top of that the beams lock on to his opponents. It's practically a sure hit kill technique for most.

I had a plan to deal with the bombardment of Spiritrons relatively easily. I raised my palm in the direction of the incoming Spiritrons.

'Beelzebuth.'

A large swirl of darkness appeared and consumed all of the attacking Spiritrons, Beelzebuth can eat anything, even a universe if given the time.

An Ultimate Skill for an Ultimate Skill.

"Oh? So you are the wielder of Gluttony then hmm?" I decided not to correct him, he may grow interested in Rimuru if he learns who truly awakened this Skill, it's probably best for now if Guy isn't too interested in Rimuru.

"How interesting, I'm not capable of analyzing or copying this Skill of yours." He commented with a smirk.

So he's just going to outright admit it then.

He snapped his fingers and a couple hundred spheres of compressed Space appeared behind him.

"You called this Archangel Shootdown? Thank you, this Spell will be fairly useful to deal with those no name mucks who challenge me."

Of course he copied it, though that's not a big deal, I'm quite certain he could probably already do something similar to Archangel Shootdown.

No biggie as long as he doesn't get my Skills. Only I'm allowed to copy Skills!

Yes, I'm a hypocrite like that.

"Hah! I expected more from you Guy!" I taunted him with the same words he said to me.

Of course this only served to tick Guy off.

I easily dealt with the incoming balls of compressed Space by simply using Ouroboros to negate them.

Guy's going to have a tough time if he wants to harm me with Spatial attacks.

Heh I know just what Magic to use, I haven't had a chance to use this in actual combat so this will be a good time to use it.

I snapped my fingers creating a localized gravitational field disruption creating an artificial black hole. At the same time I created a Barrier encompassing Guy and the artificial black hole extended all the way up into space.

'Odin, help me out here.'

'Affirmative.'

While Odin was reinforcing the Barrier making sure Guy couldn't just break the Barrier to escape my attack I made sure to control the black hole.

It took mere milliseconds for the Spell to be ready as I let go of my control of the black hole causing it to explode upwards thanks to the barrier containing the blast.

I noticed Guy erect a Multi-Dimensional Barrier around himself which should protect him from my attack.

Well at least I got to try out Gravity Collapse in actual combat I guess.

The black hole's explosion resembled that of a supernova, it was truly magnificent.

Once the attack was finished I could see Guy standing right where he was before the Spell went off with a smirk on his face.

Arrogant shit.

Before he even had a chance to react I dispelled the Barrier around him and teleported closer.

"Why don't you eat my Red!" I yelled as I formed a supercharged Red. I didn't want to show off Hollow Purple, after all I do want to keep some of my abilities secret.

Guy's eyes widened as he tried to block Red but it was no use, after all Red's primary ability is its repulsion.

Guy was sent flying, as that happened I severed the Space between Guy and his arm, cutting his arm off, Guy tried to resist with his own manipulation of Space but he just wasn't at my level when it comes to that.

Of course that wasn't able to keep him down for long as he appeared in front of me at speeds close to that of light, his fist coated in an extremely pure energy and Spiritrons easily bypassing my Infinity.

I met his fist with my own which was coated in pure Stardust, not as much energy as Guy's own fist was coated in but I was being careful with Stardust.

The moment our fists met we were both sent flying back to the opposite ends of the barrier, I took a look at my now missing hand as it quickly regenerated, though it seemed to a bit slower than it should be. I assume Guy took the same amount of damage if not more.

Spiritrons and Holy Power are not to be fucked with, they can even affect my regeneration.

….

….

I smirked as I looked back at Guy. The two of us had been exchanging blows for several hours now, though neither of us had received much damage. Sometimes I would land a stray punch, other times Guy would. Our wounds were already completely healed with Infinite Regeneration.

Our clothing is also quite damaged at this point, and that's saying something seeing as both of our outfits were God Grade Equipment created with Material Creation.

Of course my energy levels were still topped off.

Heh, why don't I give him a taste of his own medicine? Let's see how he liked dealing with those annoying Spiritrons.

I pull on the faith of my subordinates and begin to cast the Holy Magic Disintegration, except I focus the Magic into my arm. All of this takes place within milliseconds.

I hold my arm to my side and then swing it as if my arm is a sword. "Excaliburrrrrr!" I yell out.

A large beam of pure light was sent out from my arm towards Guy. The beam I just sent was capable of disintegrating someone down to their very soul.

Yes, I wanted to recreate Artoria's famous move, sue me.

Of course there was no sword used in this since weapons were banned from this fight.

The ray of Disintegration consumed Guy's Magic that he sent at me, right as it's about to hit Guy he teleports to the side.

Something that I expected seeing as I planned to get truly serious now instead of the games we were playing before. Now I decided to pull out the big guns.

I had Odin activate Future Attack Prediction which could also be used to predict Guy's own movements.

I followed the rays of light which only I could see showing me where exactly Guy would appear.

Throughout this entire process I have continued to draw on Satanael, at this point I was using about 70% of its power, something even Milim would be wary of.

Right when Guy appeared at the predicted spot I landed the perfect punch right on his face causing a sonic boom as I sent him flying. Of course that punch wasn't one that would take him out for the count so I followed him at my max speed and began giving him a barrage of punches which he wasn't able to properly defend against.

Each time he would attempt to block I would read it with Future Attack Prediction and target somewhere else.

He was acquiring more and more wounds, but he was healing just as quickly. My attacks were even damaging his Spiritual Body seeing as my punches were being reinforced by Satanael.

All of a sudden a far more intense Aura began seeping out of Guy, an Aura I recognized. I needed no warning as my Ultra Instinct blared at me. I quickly attempted to teleport back trying to avoid his predicted attack.

Unfortunately even with my Thought Acceleration I was unable to react on time and was punched straight in the face and sent flying into the very edge of the barrier before catching myself.

Thankfully I didn't have to deal with the inevitable pain such an attack would cause thanks to Pain Nullification.

I focused back onto Guy who was radiating a crimson Aura, I could tell he was getting angry.

Of course he has Satanael, it doesn't surprise me that he copied it from Milim, it's a busted Skill after all. That also means he has Magicule Breeder Reactor. And it looks like he already activated Satanael to at least 70%. He's still sane but I'm not going to rely on him to not take things too far.

Heh, that's perfect, I haven't had a life or death fight like this in a long long time.

"Heh, I guess that's enough of holding back on you Felix, get ready." Guy said as he took his stance.

"Sure sure." I smirked at him.

Unfortunately before we could resume or fight we were uninterrupted.

"Fixation."

Guy froze, I was only able to prevent myself from being frozen thanks to a timely warning from Odin and Ultra Instinct.

I turned to look at Velzard who I noticed watching us for some time now. Before she was on the other side of the barrier but for some reason she wanted to stop this spar of ours.

Velzard looked at me with interest. "You weren't affected, hmm? I wasn't going all out but still impressive."

She turned to look back at Guy and she sighed. "You weren't even able to sense my attack incoming Guy, that should be more than enough to tell you that you are close to losing yourself to that Skill. Besides this barrier you placed is beginning to break, it isn't meant to contain such a high level battle, and I don't want my castle that I spent so much work designing to be ruined for the second time."

Right after she finished talking Guy broke out of her attack as he visibly reigned in his Aura.

Ultimate Skill: Gabriel, Lord of Patience analyzed.

Ultimate Skill: Gabriel, Lord of Patience acquisition successful.

The moment I acquired Gabriel I could feel something had changed, before I even got the chance to figure out what happened I was interrupted,

'Query. Can Odin use the Ultimate Skill: Gabriel, Lord of Patience to upgrade the Ultimate Skill: Ouroboros, Lord of Infinity?'

'Hmm? If you think it is worthwhile then sure Odin, I trust you.'

If Odin thinks something will help me, I don't doubt that she will be correct. One shouldn't doubt their partners after all.

'Notice. The Ultimate Skill: Ouroboros, Lord of Infinity has gained multiple new sub-skills. Odin has also developed more useful abilities for the Master.'

'Huh? That was quick.'

Holy shit, from a quick scan of my Skill it has gotten far more useful.

I'll have to do a detailed analysis after I deal with this mess.

'Good job Odin! Explain to me all the new abilities you added later.'

'Affirmative.'

Guy sighed. "Yeah you're right Velzard, I haven't had such a fun fight in a long time. But it's best if you stopped me there, who knows what would happen if I lost control like Milim did." He must be talking about her Harvest Festival.

He turned to look at me with a smirk. "Ghaha, that was the best fight I've had in over 1,000 years Felix, you should be honored!"

I rolled my eyes. "Sure sure, and I was looking forward to fighting you going all out."

"Heh, maybe another time when I'm not worried about losing control. That Skill of Milim's is incredibly useful but also a pain." He shook his head. "Over 2,000 years and I still can't fully control it."

2,000 years?! Fuck I'm really lucky that I have Odin to control it for me. If Guy's been working on it that long who knows how long it would take me.

He sighed. "Well now that we've had our fun why don't we go back to the Ice Palace hmm Felix?"

I nodded. I've already gotten far more than I expected from coming here, two new Ultimate Skills is a massive boon.

Guy snapped his fingers and transported the three of us back to where Guy and I had our discussion earlier.

It's already night time so the view is a tad different, though the blizzard storms are still consistent.

Guy and I took our seats opposite each other while Velzard took a seat on Guy's armrest.

Yeah, she's definitely into Guy.

"Would you like to eat something Felix?" Guy asked.

Hmm, if he is serving food on the level of what was served at The Walpurgis then I'm in.

"Yeah, sure." I responded.

Guy clapped his hands causing both Misery and Rain to show up.

"Prepare a meal for the three of us." Guy ordered.

They both bowed. "Yes Master."

Guy then smirked at me. "So Satanael huh? I wonder how you got your hands on that?"

I could tell Guy was trying to fish for information. Unfortunately for Guy though he isn't getting any.

Maybe I can spin it so that there are certain conditions required for me to copy Skills.

After all, if I knew someone could copy my Skills I would either get some countermeasures like what I had Odin do, or just not show off my Skills to that person.

"Milim and I are awfully close you know? She didn't mind me using her Skill." Not a lie seeing as Milim didn't care when I brought up that I had her Skill. But this way he might consider that my close relationship with Milim is what allowed me to use her Skill. There are all sorts of Skills out there after all.

Guy's facial features didn't shift but I could tell he didn't get what he wanted. He didn't push further though.

"I see." He responded.

I turned towards Velzard, after all Veldora had a lot to say about her. The one conclusion that I came to was that she was a shit sister.

"So you are Veldora's sister?" I try to start a conversation.

She looks at me interested. "Oh? Has my rebellious little brother mentioned me? I hope he hasn't been causing trouble or I may have to discipline him again."

I rolled my eyes. "He's been doing fine, though he did have a lot to say about you."

"Oh? What did he have to say?" She asks.

"For one he hopes he never sees you again. Being constantly killed by you has traumatized him to the point he freezes up when your name is mentioned." I ignored Velzard's twitching brows and Guy's amused smile and continued. I do want to help my buddy Veldora out after all, if I can get his sister to stop being a bitch to him then why not?

"Honestly I'm pretty sure he hates you." And that's what ticked her off the most.

I might be stupid for challenging the so-called strongest True Dragon like this, but if Veldora can't stand up for himself then, as his honorary brother, I can.

All of a sudden an absolutely massive Haki descended on me. I of course didn't just take it, I released my own Demon Lord's Haki to contest it. The entire area around us was completely destroyed by our classhing Haki, though Velzard's caused far more damage to the surroundings.

This was by far the most powerful Haki I've ever felt, I was only barely able to match it with my own Demon Lord's Haki.

Velzard is likely capable of casually killing average Awakened Demon Lords with this Haki.

Fucking True Dragons.

I noticed Guy appear to the side, he was protecting himself with a Barrier. But that was all, it seems he was just going to watch for now.

'Analyzing Dragon Spirit Haki. Dragon Spirit Haki is an Intrinsic Skill of the True Dragon race, it is impossible for any other race to possess. It allows a True Dragon to imbue their Aura with various magical properties and physical properties allowing it to both exert a powerful spiritual pressure over their targets, inflict them with potentially lethal magical effects and cause them actual physical damage. When used to its fullest, it allows the user's aura to shred anything it comes into contact with.'

Damn, that's far better than Demon Lord's Haki which only lets me impose Spiritual pressure on others, of course this can still kill others or cause others to go insane, but it isn't as versatile as Dragon Spirit Haki.

The only reason I am able to oppose Velzard's Haki is due to Demon Lord's Haki scaling with my own strength.

"Just because Guy favors you does not mean you can speak whatever you wish." Velzard spoke in a chilly tone.

"Am I wrong though? After all you've continuously killed Veldora for centuries whenever he messes up, instead of lovingly teaching him as a sister should you choose the easiest method." Of course it would be foolish to push my ideas onto a True Dragon, but from what I have seen Velzard seems to genuinely care for Veldora, she just has a shit way of showing it.

If I can help my friend reconnect with his family at no cost then why not?

"I'm pretty sure Veldora misses his elder sister in his own way, he is just too afraid to try and connect to you out of fear. He has really changed you know, he even reads books now." If you can call manga books.

"All it took was for someone to guide him the right way properly." I don't even blame Veldora for being the way he is, he is the incarnation of Chaos after all, it would be foolish to expect him to obey the natural Order of the world.

I'm not really sure why Velzard's solution was to keep killing him. Maybe she hoped one of his rebirths would have a suitable personality?

All of a sudden Velzard's Haki receded, I took that as the cue to contain my own as well.

"I can see why Guy favors you Demon Lord Felix. Not many would have the guts to talk to a True Dragon like me in such a way." She sent me a smirk. "I'm glad that my brother has such friends. I will be visiting my brother myself sometime to truly see this so-called change you have spoken of."

Oops? Sorry Rimuru.

And was all that annoyance for nothing? I swear strength really does do all the talking in this world. It makes everything simple if you are strong, but life must suck for the weak.

But that's just how this world is.

"I'm glad I could help. I'm sure you'll like the new Veldora, rather than a natural catastrophe, he's more of a goof and a NEET now."

"NEET? That is the term you called me yes?" Fuck, she was listening.

"Uhh… yes?"

"Ghaha, I'm glad you two were able to sort out that mess. Watching a fight between you two would have been fun but I would have probably had to intervene so the world isn't destroyed!" Guy interrupted.

"Thanks for your help Guy." I said sarcastically.

"Heh, I knew you could handle it Felix." Guy said with that infuriating smirk he always wore.

Velzard sighed. "Now I will have to rebuild part of this castle."

"Blame yourself, your bullshit True Dragon Haki is what caused the physical damage." I teased. I was already feeling more comfortable with Velzard after that interaction, I felt like I could understand her just a little bit more.

We had a clash of Haki, One Piece style.

She giggled lightly. "Yes, that is true. Though I have never heard of my abilities as a True Dragon referred to in that way."

"Hah! What else would you call them? You True Dragons are born at the top of the world, your very existence allows you to contend against Ultimate Skill wielders at minimum."

She smirked. "Well we are not our brothers greatest creation for nothing. And you are quite impressive yourself Felix, for your mere Demon Lord's Haki to be able to contend against my own if only barely is quite impressive. I can only think of two others capable of a similar feat, Guy and Milim."

"Well I aim to please, especially a beautiful woman like you." Nothing is wrong with some innocent flirting, I'm definitely interested in tapping that but I'm pretty sure I should stay away.

I do not want to get involved in Guy and Velzard's… situationship. But maybe if I ever beat Guy making her subservient to me Velzard can come in the package?

Food for thought.

She giggled. "Ah, you truly are a tease."

I turned towards Guy to see if he had an issue with my flirting but I shouldn't have bothered. Guy was now back in her feminine form and gave me a wink.

"The food will be ready soon, why don't we shift to another area seeing as this one is no longer sufficient." Velzard and I both nodded and followed Guy along while innocently flirting with each other.

Yes, innocently.

Story: I'm a Daemon, so what?

Disclaimer: I do not own the original setting.

Chapter 31: A Student!
__________________________________________________________________________

- Felix -

Guy led us to an extravagant dining room, of course everything was made out of ice, but it was still quite beautiful. The table was in a long oval shape with over 10 seats.

Misery and Rain were already here waiting for us with the dishes ready to be served in a cart.

Guy took a seat at the head of the table with Velzard sitting in the middle. I decided to sit at the opposite end, opposite to Guy.

Once we were seated, Rain wheeled the cart around while Misery served us the dishes.

There seemed to be a stew of some kind along with some Dragon meat and some other grilled meat.

We all began eating once we were all served, I took a bite of the steak first seeing as it is what I am most familiar with.

From the taste it seems to be some kind of Fire Dragon, or at least it tastes similar to when Raiden cooks up some Fire Dragon for me.

Huh, the meat in the stew is something I've never had before, and it's incredibly delicious.

'Report. Component analysis complete. It is now possible to recreate the recipes Gryphon Stew, Grilled Spark Panther, and Roast Fire Dragon Steak.'

'Nice! Thanks Odin.'

"So what do you think Felix?" Asked Guy.

I assume she's asking about the food. "It is quite delicious, probably as good as the food my Maid cooks and I love her food."

Guy looked interested. "Oh? You have a maid as well?" For some reason Guy was acting like we were comrades all of a sudden.

"Yeah?"

She shook his head with a sigh. "Nothing nothing." Guy said as she shot a glare to an innocently whistling Rain and a serious looking Misery.

"Hmm, maybe I should stop by sometime to try your Maids food if you are comparing it to Misery's who has been cooking food for me for millenia." Guy asked.

"Hmm, as long as you don't go on a rampage or anything I don't mind. Just make sure you show up when I'm there since I visit Rimuru and Milim relatively often." I responded.

"The Slime eh? He has an Ultimate Skill too, truly this century is becoming quite interesting." Guy muttered.

So Guy knows that Rimuru has an Ultimate Skill huh? I doubt she is aware of what those Skills are though, not to mention I don't think Guy would even consider Rimuru having 4 Ultimate Skills he acquired on his own merit.

Hell even I have only acquired two Ultimate Skills on my own, the rest are copied. And even that's debatable since Odin helped push things along.

As we were finishing up the meal I said, "By the way Velzard."

She paused her eating and looked at me. "Yes?"

"Whenever you decide to visit Veldora come see me first, who knows what will happen if you just show up in Tempest, Veldora will panic, that's for sure. Not to mention Rimuru's reaction to another True Dragon showing up. It would just be easier if you come to me and then I can take you to Tempest and introduce you to Rimuru. Veldora listens to Rimuru so maybe he'll be willing to talk to you if Rimuru encourages it." I respond.

"Hmm, I see. Okay then, I will see you before I visit Veldora." Velzard acquiesced.

I nodded. "Good."

It's good that she listened, who knows if she just shows up in Tempest a fight might just start due to multiple overreactions. Velzard has more raw power than me, even when I'm using Satanael at 40%.

Hmm speaking about unsealed form, Odin had detected that she was limiting her power output for some reason.

I wonder why?

"Velzard." I called out.

She looked at me. "Yes?"

"Why is a portion of your power sealed?"

"Ah, you can even sense that. It is far easier to control my power in this sealed state. In my true form accidentally waving my hand may obliterate Veldora or Velgrynd. Not to mention another side benefit that I will not be talking about." Ah, so similar to what Freeza had done huh?

I nodded. Controlling one's power is a real issue in this world huh? Not everyone is fortunate to have a Skill that can control your own power for you.

In her current form I'd say her raw power is a decent bit greater than mine, but who knows about how strong she really is in her true form?

I'd like to think I'd still have a chance seeing as she fought Guy to a standstill, but who knows. I'm sure Guy fought her to a standstill with pure technique rather than raw power, after all Milim wasn't even born at that point so he couldn't have used Satanael to power up.

It's probably just best to avoid a fight with her in general.

We quickly finished our meal at which point I decided it was about time to leave.

I shook my head. "You always focus on one thing Hinata, even while distracted you need to be aware of your enemy. You fall for casual distractions far too easily."

"You call that a casual distraction?! That would erase a normal Enlightened!"

"They are weak, you aren't as weak." I responded.

"Grrr, you're always like this!" Hinata complained.

Ah yes, there is that. Ever since I began teaching her, Hinata has become far more casual, and dare I say it affectionate.

Little Hinata might just be developing her first crush, I didn't even do much, I just beat her up regularly and told her how to improve. I swear this girl is starved for any sort of affection, it's quite amusing actually. Though maybe I'm just her type? I am quite attractive after all.

Still it's too bad that her crush likely won't be going anywhere, at least for a long long time.

Though there is also the chance that I am just reading this completely wrong, Hinata might just have a more soft spot for her teachers. I remember Rimuru telling me a big part of why she and Rimuru fought was because she thought Rimuru killed her teacher.

Though she was still quite the rowdy girl, I remember after our first sparring session, a bloody, beaten Hinata came up to me and said that if I were to go against Humanity she would slay me.

I laughed, that's probably the most genuine laugh I'd had in a long long time.

She seemed to take that as a challenge and has been striving to prove me wrong ever since.

I shook my head and focused back on the fight.

"Now let's dance!" I yelled as I charged at Hinata, stick in hand.

After Hinata blocked a few of my strikes I decided to get a little serious and began to prepare to use one of the Hazy Style's "mysteries". Basically I pierce Hinata in five of her ten vital points, while using the other five as feints.

"Plum Blossoms - Five Petals Thrust!" I yelled as I attacked all of Hinata's weak points simultaneously, of course I didn't attack at my max speed.

Hinata needs to actually be able to avoid these after all.

Out of the five points I was aiming for, none managed to hit, Hinata isn't called a prodigy for nothing after all.

I clapped as I said, "Nice work Hinata-chan!"

She glared. "Don't call me that!"

"Ah, did you want me to call you just by your first name?! How forward, but if that is what you wish for I will not resist your advances."

Ah the blush on her face was adorable. Teasing her has become one of my new hobbies.

"Ah! Just go die Felix." Hinata yelled, embarrassed.

"Haha, maybe you can try to kill me like you claimed you would if I went against Humanity."

"You still don't think I can do it?"

"Nope!" I responded cheerfully.

It's not even funny how much progress Hinata will need to make to even have a chance at wounding me let alone permanently killing me.

"Alright, now let's keep going!" I yelled.




I snapped my fingers and teleported back to Azeroth, even though I've been having some fun teaching Hinata I'm not living in Tempest.

Teaching Hinata is just a side hobby after all. Though I am curious about how my intervention in her journey as a Hero will affect things.

I don't think there has been a single Hero in history that has been taught by a Demon Lord, but who knows, I don't know everything.

"Welcome back Master." I turned towards the voice and nodded.

"Hello Raiden, thanks for making sure everything was taken care of while I was away."

"It is my duty Master."

"Yes yes I know. I'll go pick up your weapon tomorrow, that's when Kurobe said it would be ready."

Raiden nodded. "I see, did you wish for me to come with you?"

I shook my head. "Nah, it's fine. I'll probably stick around Tempest for a bit before coming back here."

"Very well Master."

Chapter 32: Against a True Dragon!
- Felix -

I entered Kurobe's smithy and was greeted by the sight of the Oni hammering away at a sword of some kind.

He paused for a second to take a look at me before saying, "Welcome Lord Felix! Let me finish this katana and then I will get you the weapon you commissioned."

I nodded and decided to look around at the new weapons Kurobe had made. He is always coming up with new things so it can be quite fun to see what new weapons he comes up with.

After looking around for a bit I came across a few strange weapons, the weapons had a hole in them, some even had multiple holes.

Next to the weapons I could also see a couple marbles that seemed to be imbued with the power of Elementals. Maybe Rimuru asked them to design this, it seems like something from a video game.

'Answer. After analysis it has been detected that it is possible to imbue the Magic Marbles into the weapons giving each weapon magical properties.'

Huh, so you can easily swap enchantments basically then. That's pretty cool, also quite convenient. If someone comes across an enemy that is weak to fire they can put in a Magic Marble that has been imbued with the power of a Fire Elemental, and vice versa for other weaknesses.

"Thank you for waiting Lord Felix!" I heard a voice sound out.

I turned around to see a slightly sweaty Kurobe.

"It's no problem, I got to see something quite interesting after all."

"Ah! Are you interested in the Slotted Equipment? They were Lord Rimuru's idea, he wanted to add something that can only be found in The Dungeon, so he asked us to make those." Kurobe said.

"I see." Rimuru probably got the idea from something in his previous life. Otherworlders really do have an advantage over those naturally born in this world, though that's obvious at this point.

"You came here to pick up the weapon for Miss Raiden right?" Asked Kurobe.

I nodded.

"Very well then, let me go get it from the back." I continued to take a look at the Slotted Equipment while I waited.

Theoretically certain combinations of Magic Marbles can likely create far greater effects than expected.

'Correct. Theoretically combining two Fire Magic Marbles paired with a single Water Magic Marble can increase the effects by at least 10 times.'

Damn. For weaker people that sort of power is a tremendous difference. Kurobe really made something crazy huh?

And that is with Magic Marbles imbued with the power of Elementals, not even Elemental Lords either. What kind of weapon could be created if a Magic Marble was imbued with the power of something stronger?

"Here you are Lord Felix."

I turned towards Kurobe who was holding something wrapped in some cloth, of course not normal cloth but cloth made with the webs of an A Rank Knight Spider.

Kurobe carefully handed the Tachi to me.

Kurobe looked at me proudly. "This is one of my finest works! It was made with Dragotite, and imbued with that mysterious energy of yours."

He was right to be proud of it. This weapon was a bonafide Legend Grade weapon with the potential to become a God Grade.

It was capable of channelling Lightning masterfully, along with that it would bind to its wielder so it could be freely controlled by Raiden from range.

Also once it's bound it will be sealed inside of Raiden's body so she can call upon it whenever she wishes. I of course asked Kurobe to add this effect to make it as close to the weapon it is based off of.

I can probably also transfer a bunch of information on Raiden Shogun's various sword arts so that my Raiden can recreate them, and possibly improve them.

I remember there was the Musou no Hitotachi, it can be used as an instantaneous series of slashes that erupt into a torrent of energy, or a single massive slash composed of lightning. I remember when the latter attack was used it split an entire island.

There was the Chakram Wave where she slashes the air and fires three large chakrams composed of electro energy, followed by a large electro wave.

I'm sure Raiden can get a decent bit stronger overall by mastering all the moves I'll share with her.

"Thank you Kurobe, I'm sure Raiden will love this."

Kurobe gave a humble bow. "It is my duty Lord Felix."

I just nodded, non humans are incredibly loyal to their namers once named. It's just a cultural thing in this world.

It can also be a bit problematic in my opinion, after all generally none of my subordinates ever really question me which can be bad on its own. After all, if I'm doing something stupid I'll never know if no one tells me.

Thankfully Odin can fulfill that role.

'Odin will always have the Master's best interests in mind.'

'Thanks! I'll be counting on you.'

Now where is Hinata? I want to beat her up some more, though I've been wanting a good fight. Fighting Guy was incredibly fun but I can't just go there whenever I want and ask for a fight.

Or maybe I can? Still it's probably best if I find someone else.

Maybe Veldora? The Dungeon should be able to handle the both of us going all out.

Maybe I'll ask him for a fight after sparring with Hinata.

Yes, that sounds good.

I stored Raiden's new blade in my Infinity Space and headed towards the direction I sensed Hinata. It seems she's at the Holy Church that is being constructed in Tempest.

Once I was close enough I felt Hinata sense me and quickly make her way over towards me.

It seems some officials from the Holy Church have arrived at Tempest. I think those are some of the famed Crusaders, each said to be equal to a Demon Lord.

Hilarious. Even a Demon Lord Seed would wipe the floor with them, though from what I am seeing they do have potential, each of them are Enlightened which speaks for itself.

Noticing that I was staring at them they gave me a bow. Who knew Luminous' lot could be respectful?

I gave them a nod causing them to sigh in relief.

I'm not that scary, right?

"Teacher! What are you doing here?" She asked. That's another thing she has begun doing, calling me teacher.

It isn't really wrong but I'm pretty sure she is taking this whole teacher student relationship far too seriously. Especially when she said she would kill me if I attacked Humanity.

Weird girl.

"Nothing much, I just felt the sudden urge to bea- I mean teach you." She definitely bought it if the way she is giving me a half lidded stare means anything.

Man I'm too good at this.

'....'

Ignoring Odin, "Now why don't we go to The Dungeon for this session? I want to face Veldora after so it'll be easier that way."

Hinata's eyes widened considerably. "Veldora?! Why would you want to face him?!"

I shrug my shoulders. "I'm bored and looking for a good fight."

Hinata waited a moment for me to continue but seeing as I wasn't saying anything else she sighed. "That's it? You are challenging the strongest species in the world, one of the three Catastrophe Class beings due to boredom?"

I nod. "Mhmm."

"I hope I never turn out like you." Now it's my turn to look at her confused.

"Why is that? You're saying you don't want to be awesome, super strong, handsome, or in your case beautiful, though you already have that requirement met. But what's there not to like about me? I think you're just jealous of me." Yes, that must be it. After all, who wouldn't want to be me?

"Eh? Why are you blushing?" I ask.

"Grrr, shut up! Let's just go have our stupid spar!"

"Ah, I knew you valued our training, you don't need to be such a tsundere." I tease.

I noticed Hinata's subordinates looking at her in shock. Maybe she is always super serious with them or something? Yeah that's probably it.

"Before we go, why don't you introduce me to your subordinates?" I ask.

Hinata looked at me with suspicion. "Why would you be interested in them?" She questions.

I just smirk in response. "Ah, what teacher wouldn't be interested in his adorable student's subordinates."

My statement only caused Hinata's blush to reignite in vigor.

Ah, whenever Luminous finds out that I'm teaching her most precious subordinate she is gonna be pissed.

Perfect.

"Grrr, fine!" She turned towards her three subordinates that were in Tempest. I could sense other church officials inside the newly constructed church but these three seemed to be the strongest.

" " "Yes!" " " They all shouted.

The first one was a blonde man with long hair, he came up towards us and bowed again.

He seemed to have heard me asking for their introductions so he said, "Greetings Lord Felix, my name is Leonard Jester, Lady Hinata's second in command and a Saint Wizard."

A Saint Wizard huh? Humans have many classifications for Magic users.

Sorcerers are those who specialize in Elemental Magic, Shaman are those who specialize in Spirit Magic, Maya are those that specialize in Illusion Magic, Enchanters specialize in Engraving Magic and imbue special effects into items. Priests are those that use Holy Magic, priests generally fill the support category. Summoners are those that use Summoning Magic. Elementalers or Elementalists are those that utilize both Spirit Magic and Summoning Magic to summon contracted Elementals.

Then we have the truly impressive classes.

Magicians are those who have learned and can well utilize at least two different types of Magics. Wizards are those that have mastered three or more different types of Magics. And then Leonard's class, Saint Wizard is for those that have mastered Holy Magic, an impressive feat as the higher levels of Holy Magic require tremendous amounts of faith.

"Well met Leonard. It's good Hinata has a reliable subordinate like you, to be blessed by an Elemental of Light must mean you have a pure heart. An Enlightened of your caliber is welcome in practically any Nation." I praise.

Hinata looked at me in surprise. Heh, I can be nice too.

"Ah, thank you for your praise Lord Felix." He bowed again and stepped aside.

The next one to introduce himself was a large sturdy looking man, he had a mace attached to his waist so I assume he specializes in close combat.

"Lord Felix, this one's name is Bacchus, one of the Captains of the Crusaders." Short and straight to the point huh?

He was blessed by an Earth Elemental.

I gave him a nod. "Hello Bacchus."

The next one to approach me was the strongest of all three. I would have assumed that the strongest would be Hinata's Vice Captain but I was wrong.

And this guy was a tad special.

I could sense the blessings of multiple Elementals on him, and the strongest blessing was from an Elemental of Space. Heh, that's ironic.

"I am Arnaud Bauman, one of Lady Hinata's subordinates. If I find you to have untoward intentions to My Lady then I will not hesitate in doing my duty."

I smirked at his greeting. "Oh? And what can a weakling like you do?" I taunted.

I could see Hinata try and intervene but before she could I slightly let out my Demon Lord's Haki, focused on all three of them.

The three of them instantly kneeled, I saw Bacchus try and steady himself with his mace, while Arnaud and Leonard did the same with their swords.
"Teacher!" I ignored Hinata's plea.

"Before you say something make sure you can back up your words. Who knows, one day your words may get you or my adorable student killed."

I didn't take his words personally, after all he was someone raised in the Cardinal World, a world where legends about Demon Lords are widespread.

To the world Demon Lords are beings of evil, unrepentant monsters. And they may be right in some cases.

In fact I can even admire this guy for the sheer balls of threatening a Demon Lord in the territory of another Demon Lord.

"You can't even withstand 1% of my Haki. That should show where you really stand in this cruel world."

I reigned in my Haki and let them get up.

"Though good on you for having the balls to defend your Mistress." I complimented.

They slowly stood up, I could see fear in their eyes, but more than that I could see conviction.

These three really believed in what they were doing, and there was something admirable about that.

I ignored Hinata's glare as she made sure her subordinates were okay.
As we were walking towards The Dungeon Hinata said, "You didn't have to be so rough on them."

I snorted. "Rough? That was less than a single percentage of my Haki, they are the ones provoking an unknown Demon Lord. Any other Demon Lord except for Rimuru might just kill them for the insult."

Even Milim would, hell most of my subordinates would kill him on the spot for the insult. They don't play around.

Hinata sighed. "I know. Thanks for going easy on them I guess."

"Ah, my little tsundere student."

Hinata grit her teeth. "I. Am. Not. A. Tsundere!"

Heh, Veldora told her about tsunderes when he overheard me call her that one time

Hinata ignored me and continued marching towards The Dungeon. Ah, she's much more fun to mess with than Luminous, her reactions are far better. Luminous has had thousands of years of experience, whereas Hinata is practically a newborn compared to that.

Heh, maybe I should call Luminous a hag sometime.

I quickly caught up to Hinata. "You know I can teleport us into The Dungeon right?" I asked.

She took a deep breath and sighed. "Of course you can." I took that as the signal to teleport us to Floor 100, Veldora's lair.

Moments later I heard, "Ah! Felix what are you doing here?" Asked the chunni True Dragon.

"Sup Veldora. I wanted to spar with Hinata and wanted to see if I could borrow the area you will face challengers in. Then maybe after if you're up for it we can have a spar ourselves."

"Ghaha! Of course my brother! Feel free to use my lair to teach your student a lesson." That doesn't sound ominous at all.

"And what about sparring with you?" I've been very curious about how Veldora scales against his sister Velzard. I know he isn't at her level, but how large of a difference is there between fellow True Dragons?

"Indeed, we shall have a spar! Our battle will be legendary!"

"Alright, just hang around for a little bit then. Ah, what about that bug Zegion, what's he up to? He's your student too, right?"

Veldora nodded with a smug smile on his face. "Indeed! He is currently training against the Tempest Serpent a few floors above."

I nodded. I don't make a habit of sensing every single Floor of The Dungeon. But still that's quite impressive. And he still has a lot more potential to be unveiled, especially since part of him is made up of Rimuru's flesh.

Honestly he reminds me of a shonen protagonist. He has his latent potential in his exoskeleton, he has a mentor that is one of the strongest beings in the world, his very body is made up of the flesh of a Demon Lord, and then he is also learning a martial arts style known to only a few, the Veldora Style Killing Arts.

Dude is a bonafide shonen protagonist.

"Alright, come on Hinata." She nodded and followed me to the center of the arena on this Floor.

I noticed Veldora appear in the spectator's area, Zegion was also teleported in as well. It seems Veldora was going to try and have Zegion learn from this fight as well.

Veldora has all he needs to be a successful mentor, after all he has knowledge of all the badass teachers from his manga. It wouldn't surprise me if his training methods are blatant copies of someone like Bang, Rayleigh, Roshi, or even Whis.

Hinata withdrew her blade and got into her stance as she activated her armor's special effect elevating her body.

I plan to rely more liberally on my Magic in this fight, after all I would consider myself more of a Mage than a Swordsman, though I am proficient in both.

I withdrew the same stick from earlier and coated it in my Divine Aura.

"Alright, let's get started now."

The moment I finished speaking, Hinata appeared in front of me at speeds most aren't capable of seeing.

Sadly for her I am not most.

I casually parried her strike to the side and then jumped up into the air and breathed scorching hot flames down in Hinata's direction.

Crimson red flames splashed out in all directions, hot enough to burn the very oxygen in the air. I could see Hinata summon her Contracted Elementals and use them to try and direct the Flames elsewhere. Unfortunately the Magicules she was supplying was not nearly enough to overtake my own controlling the Flames. Something she should have known by now.

Seeing her plan wasn't working she leaped backwards to gain some distance on the flames.

It seems she just wanted to try and dispel it with her Elementals in the safe environment of a spar. Which is understandable, she wants to gouge the difference between us if she can, in any way possible since her Unique Skill: Mathematician doesn't work on me. The more information she has the better this spar will go for her.

Honestly fighting against Ultimate Skill wielders without something equal to that is basically a pointless endeavor.

I could tell Hinata was drawing on the power of her Elementals.

"Wind Blade!" I lightly blew in the Wind Blade's direction dispelling it.

"You're gonna need a lot more than that if you want to affect me with Magic."

I wave my hand and send several Ice Blades towards Hinata. Let's see how she will deal with these.

Each of my Ice Blades are equal to the attack of a Legend Grade weapon, something Hinata can deal with but not without trouble. Perfect for training her.

Hinata manages to cut two of them apart but the last two end up getting dangerously close to her before Hinata dodges to the left cutting another Ice Blade apart in the process while letting the last Ice Blade strike behind her.

Good, if she couldn't even do that much it would be quite disappointing.

Still, Hinata has been on the backfoot the entirety of this fight, let's see what she can do if I give her the chance.

-

I look down at Hinata as she lays on the ground catching a breather.

"That was better than before." I comment.

"Hah, you're one to talk, you don't even look slightly winded." Hinata says pouting.

I roll my eyes. "It takes a lot more than that to exhaust me, I can fight for weeks on end without feeling exhausted, you're a long way from that."
Hinata sighed as she got up. "I know." She seemed to be a bit upset, after all it seems like she hasn't made any progress, but it's hard to tell progress when you get slapped around no matter what.

I'm sure if Hinata went and sparred with someone who used to be her equal she would see the difference.

Her reaction time is quicker, she is far more aware of her surroundings, I've been teaching her some useful tricks with Spatial Magic. Overall she has grown a fair amount.

"Alright why don't you stand to the side, maybe you can learn something from my fight with Veldora." I order.

Hinata nods and goes to stand beside Zegion.

Veldora takes the cue to appear in front of me as I am storing my stick for future beatings on Hinata.

"Finally! Our battle will be legendary Felix!" Veldora boasted.

"You already said that." I commented.

"Indeed! Now let us get started!"

I nodded and took my spot across the room from Veldora.

I'm curious about his Veldora Style Killing Arts, I've seen some of the moves it contains but not all of them. It will be fun to see what other moves he has recreated.

Veldora was in his humanoid form currently, though I'm not exactly sure if he is stronger in this form or his True Dragon form.

I'm going to have to take this fight seriously, though I'll stay away from Time shenanigans so the spectators can actually see what is happening.

I assume Veldora is a Digital Lifeform as well, he is a True Dragon after all.

'Incorrect, the Storm Dragon Veldora is not a Digital Lifeform.'

Huh, that's surprising.

'Got it, thanks Odin.'

I guess even True Dragons have things they actually need to learn.

Veldora and I looked at each other, and then the battle started immediately.

I tilted my head to the side avoiding one of Veldora's punches while kneeing him in the pelvis sending him flying back.

All of a sudden I felt a massive Aura erupt from Veldora, I contested it with my own Aura and rushed at Veldora, my fists coated in Stardust.

It would be foolish not to go all out against a True Dragon.

My earlier attack didn't seem to do much damage which isn't all that surprising.

I noticed Veldora gathering a massive amount of his Aura into his fist.

The moment our fists collided I felt Veldora release all the Aura he gathered at once, sending me flying all the way across the Floor. Though the Stardust coating my hand did far more damage to him than it did to me.

My entire right arm was gone alone with some of my shoulder.

No biggie though.

I flexed my newly regenerated arm and then teleported to where I sensed Veldora and unleashed a barrage of punches and kicks while he was down.

All of a sudden I was about to be struck by Black Lightning, fortunately Odin had me covered and placed a barrier to block it.

'Notice. Due to the Ultimate Skill: Faust, Lord of Investigation Veldora was able to hide his intentions from the Master.'

'But not from you huh?'

'Correct. Due to the data gathered on Faust it was possible to detect.'

'Nice, thanks Odin. Now let's do this!'

"Hah! As expected of you Felix! It is no wonder my Skill warned me that fighting you would be difficult." I looked towards the voice and was met with a slightly wounded Veldora.

Of course the wounds weren't enough as I could see Veldora regenerating in front of my eyes.

That Probability Manipulation of his is going to be a pain.

Heh, well I could just make it so that no matter how much he tries his Probability Manipulation will keep failing to change his odds against me. Of course I'd have to be far far stronger than I currently am for that to happen.

"Now let's get serious!" He yelled as claws grew out of his hands.

'Notice. It is detected that the Intrinsic Skill of the True Dragon Veldora is Dividing, allowing him to utilize his claws to cut through anything.'

Huh?

Fucking True Dragons.

'You can't copy it?'

'Negative. Due to the Skill being so entwined with Veldora's nature it is impossible to copy.'

'Dang it.'

I dashed backwards just as Veldora dashed forwards, his claws are capable of casually breaching Infinity so it's best if I avoid being hit.

I aimed my palm in Veldora's direction and fired off a Nuclear Canon which Veldora casually cut through with his claws.

I began drawing on Satanael and felt myself grow stronger. Once I was ready I dashed towards Veldora, a hidden surprise in my palm waiting for him.

Veldora slashed at me with his claws which I casually avoided with Future Attack Prediction. Unfortunately for Veldora he doesn't have such a Skill as I used Death Streak right next to him.

Death Streak is a Magic capable of penetrating almost all matter while not having any physical destructive power.

The Dark Light immediately went rampant and began attacking in all directions as I dashed back to avoid it. I made sure to place a barrier around Hinata, Zegion and Ramiris who showed up so they wouldn't get hurt.

I expected for at least 70% of Veldora's body to be destroyed or corrupted by the Dark Light. The only reason I used it was since it was impossible for Veldora to die to it thanks to his nature as a True Dragon.

But I was wrong, it seems Veldora's control over Faust exceeded my expectations. Normally to master an Ultimate Skill you need years of effort. Even Guy hasn't mastered Satanael to this day, but Veldora was able to manipulate the probability the Dark Light would hit him.

Veldora still roared out in pain since a tiny bit of the Dark Light nicked him, not even Pain Nullification could negate it all as it was an attack on the soul.

Of course I didn't feel pity for him, he was a mighty True Dragon after all. I'm sure he's had far worse wounds.

"Gah! What a painful Nuclear Magic Felix!" He roared out.

But he got it together quickly.

Round 2 of our spar was far more chaotic. I used Ouroboros to change the distance between us making it so I was capable of easily reaching him while it was far more difficult for him.

I ended up getting a few cuts on him by cutting him through Space.

He ended up getting angry, deciding to just use his Divider to cut through Space itself to reach me.

Fucking cheat.

"How about one last attack Felix! An energy clash!" He wanted to do an energy clash? Count me in!

"Let's do it Veldora!"

He nodded with an excited look on his face. Now I'm sure he will use a kamehameha, but what should I use?

Stardust would be too much as it would easily overwhelm him.

Screw it, I'll just throw a Red at him.

"Kaa-mee-haa-mee-haaaa."

I aimed my palm in the direction of his beam. "Red!"

Our two attacks met, both fighting for supremacy, but before we could see the results Rimuru appeared.

"Beelzebub!"

Party pooper.

"What the hell are you two doing?!" He yelled.

I gave him a half lidded stare. "What does it look like? We're sparring of course."

"You call this a spar?! Look at both of your states?"
Eh I wasn't all that injured, Veldora wasn't either though.

Rimuru glared at the two of us angrily.

"So what do you have to say for yourselves?!"

Veldora brushed him off. "Ghaha, do not worry, me and Felix were just messing around!"

I nodded, backing him up. "Indeed, we were just having a fun, casual spar."

"Gah! I can't with you two!"

Seeing as the mood was ruined I gave Veldora a pat on the back, letting him deal with Rimuru's nagging and then went to check on the spectators.

The Dungeon itself seemed to be doing okay, I guess that's to be expected from a World System Skill though.

Hinata was frozen in shock. Huh, maybe she hasn't seen a fight like that before?

Zegion however seemed to have stars in his eyes. "As expected of Teacher!"

I nodded. Credit where credit is due, I'm pretty sure I'd beat him if I had gone at him with the intention to kill, after all I didn't use most of my abilities since they each have a high chance of killing him. Whether it is my Spatial Abilities, Temporal Abilities, Gravity Abilities, and especially Beelzebuth.

All could significantly wound him according to Odin. Hollow Purple especially.

But he was fun to fight still.

I gave Hinata a pat on the shoulder. "You still have a ways to go." I commented.

She really is a kind girl. But life is cruel after all she was basically enslaved and forced to do someone else's dirty work.

That thought only made me more determined to seek out strength. In the end strength is what matters, no one can force you to do something against your will if you are stronger. Morals and rules are determined by who is stronger, after all look at the Demon Lords. They each have territories where they are basically worshiped as gods, Luminous is literally worshiped as a god.

Strength is all that matters in the end, though I don't want to lose myself in the pursuit of it.

But I always have Odin to count on to keep me sane.

I swear I could almost feel Odin smile happily.

'Odin will always be there for the Master.'

'I know you will, thanks Odin.'

It's crazy to think that she has been with me basically my entire journey as a Daemon. At first as just the Extra Skill: Sage, then the Unique Skill: Cursed Sage, and then finally her current self.

Having a partner isn't too bad.

Interesting.

Ah, Lycanthropes are so simple, I like that about them. Just be stronger than them and they will do whatever you tell them.

Chapter 34: Prelude to the Festival

- Felix -

The Reception Ceremony should start sometime tomorrow, after that the Festival will officially begin so we have some time to explore and mess around then.

"Come on Felix! Let's go!" Said an overexcited Milim.

"Why don't we check out Veldora's Takoyaki stand, I'm sure his stand is ready by now. He seemed to be taking it super seriously too so it should be good."

"That sounds wonderful Master." Said Raiden.

Might as well let her do what she wants today since tomorrow she will be forced to mingle a bit.

Heh, that's one method of advertising.

'Dragon Body is an Intrinsic Skill rarely possessed by Dragonewts. The Skill allows the user to enter a temporary battle transformation which greatly increases their combat capabilities similar to its Lycanthrope counterpart.'

'Intriguing, how does that work?'
Answer. By absorbing the Magicules surrounding them to supercharge their body. This results in a large offensive and defensive power increase.'

Once our orders were taken and alcohol was served I took a look around the hall. The banquet was quite chaotic with dignitaries from various nations all around conversing. But that had its own charm to it.

I could see Rimuru going from table to table introducing himself and having quick conversations.

He really has this whole politics thing down huh? Good on him.

It didn't take long for all of our dishes to be served.

Rimuru seriously went all out on this. All of these extravagant dishes were made by Shuna and that other chef too.

Very impressive.

Milim was the most visibly excited. "Woah! This looks good. Hehe, I can't wait to try it!"

"Please keep your decorum Lady Milim." Pleaded Arc. Man he really has it tough, maybe I sentenced him to an eternity of suffering when I had Arcueid bring him as a servant for Milim.

"Indeed, this looks incredible." Commented Middray.

"This is the minimum requirement when serving our Lord." Declared Arcueid with Megumin, Lalatina, Raiden, and Saeko nodding along with her.

"Heh, I bet I could do better!" I don't know if you could Saeko. Saeko has improved her cooking but that's mostly due to her Skill rather than her actual ability to cook.

"Woah! This is some high tier stuff Boss!" Said Glenda.

Ingvild looked quite nervous, it seems she wasn't quite used to this kind of atmosphere. Hell I'm not either, I just don't really care what others think.

"Just eat however you want Ingvild, if someone stares just think about the fact that you could kill them with a flick of a finger." I comforted.

I think I nailed it too!

Ingvild nervously nodded.

"Indeed, My Lord is correct. Utilize what I have taught you in our lessons."

I looked at Arcueid curiously. "Lessons?"

Arcueid nodded. "Indeed, I have taken it upon myself to make sure Ingvild and Glenda know the proper etiquette so they do not embarrass you My Lord." Said Arcueid with a proud smile on her face.

Huh, well I guess I should have expected something like that from those Primordials, each was a go-getter in their own way.

"Well, thanks for that, I didn't consider if such a thing was necessary. My bad Ingvild, Glenda."

Ingvild nervously waved her hands. "It is no problem! It is understandable with how busy you are!" Eh, I'm not that busy. In fact I barely do any real work but I'll take whatever excuse I can get!

Glenda nodded. "Yup! It's no problem Boss!" Though I sensed an undercurrent of fear in Glenda.

I noticed out of the corner of my eyes Arcueid was staring at Glenda without blinking.

I'll just pretend I didn't see that.

There were a variety of dishes presented in front of us, Smoked chicken-duck meat and sandwiches filled with vegetables, cow-deer steak, fried vegetables marinated in sauce, karaage fried chicken, roast beef salad, each was guaranteed to please whomever consumed it.

There was also a sherbet made with various fruits and refreshments. It seems Rimuru analyzed the food the Guy's maids served at the Walpurgis as he also had black tiger meat stew and grilled fairy-leather bird.

We all quickly began eating.

"Woah! So good!" Exclaimed Milim.

Even Raiden seemed to be enjoying the food, and she was always super critical about this kind of stuff. It seems she doesn't like it when I eat anything prepared by someone else.

Cute.

Arcueid of course kept her manners even as she was eating. Ever the graceful one.

Lalatina and Megumin also knew the proper etiquette. It can be hard to remember sometimes but those three are Queens in their own right, each ruling a significant portion of the Daemon Realm for eons.

I noticed the people seated at the tables around us also seemed to love the food, heh at the very least Rimuru will win everyone over through their stomachs.

Even the higher up aristocrats were satisfied.

Though it is quite amusing watching those aristocrats trying to keep their cools surrounded by various Demon Lords and Monsters.

Still, the fact that they are even trying to keep their cool shows that Rimuru has been able to get through to them, that even they agree that coexistence is possible, or else they wouldn't be putting in this much effort, benefits be damned. Though I don't doubt that most of these aristocrats' have been swayed by the sheer benefits Tempest is offering.

From the new food culture to the modern roads and other inventions Tempest is making. Even the railroad idea that Rimuru brought up is practically unheard of in this world.

Rimuru told me on the side that he was considering having vehicles created but decided against it due to the potential pollution. I didn't think it was that big of a deal, tons of people in this world have the ability to just erase the smog and all the other harmful effects of pollution.

But eh, this is Rimuru's jam so I'll leave him to it.

Rimuru eventually came by our table and sat down in one of the empty seats.

He groaned and flopped down onto the table. "Man, this is such a pain." He muttered. I noticed that he placed a Barrier the moment he sat down, one that will isolate all the sound inside so no one will hear what we are talking about.

Looks like he's here to vent.

I nodded. "Yeah, I don't know how you do it. Playing nice to a bunch of sleazeballs does not sound like something I'd want to do."

"Ugh, tell me about it." Said Rimuru.

"I think this banquet is quite wonderful Lord Rimuru, it gives everyone the chance to appreciate Tempest's culinary experience as well as get to know other major figures that will be attending for future deals that will undoubtedly be made during the Festival." Added Arcueid.

"Ah, thanks Arcueid. I'm glad I'm doing something right." Said Rimuru.

"Umu! The food is good Rimuru!" Said Milim.

"Thanks, I'll pass on your praise to the chefs." Replied Rimuru.

Milim nodded along.

"Hmm, ooh! What's that?!" Asked Milim.

I looked towards where she was pointing and was met with a few Elves rolling a fish of some kind in on a cart.

'The A Rank fish, Spear Toro is a fish most commonly found in the ocean and is notoriously hard to catch.'

So it's called a Spear Toro huh?

'Thanks Odin.'

The fish itself was quite large and had a large horn on its face, it even seemed to have some armor.

"Oh, that's a Spear Toro that we plan to serve tonight. See ya, I need to make sure everything is going as planned."

All of us gave Rimuru our goodbyes as he ventured back into the shark's den.

Hakurou was the one cutting the fish, and he was making a show out of it too.

Our waitress, Elusia, brought us some sushi that was made using the Spear Toro.

I could hear some exclamations from the other tables mentioning how the Spear Toro was an A Rank.

Seafood was not very common in this world as there were multiple difficulties. For one, keeping the fish frozen was quite difficult while on carriage, and then the sea monsters that inhabit the ocean can be quite the pain for normal merchants as well.

Once every table was served Rimuru made his way back to our table, though this time he brought a guest with him.

He was a sleazy looking Japanese man.

"Everyone, this is Yuuki Kagurazaka, the Guildmaster of the Free Guild." Introduced Rimuru.

So this is the guy huh?

'Odin.'

'Already on it.'

Yuuki gave us a bow. "Greetings to you Demon Lord Milim, Demon Lord Felix. I'm not quite sure what exactly your subordinates' names are so I apologize for the insult. Though that's excluding Miss Glenda there." Said Yuuki with an apologetic smile.

Ah, it seems that he knows Glenda then huh? Not much of a surprise as she is one of the former Ten Great Saints. In fact I'm surprised she hasn't been recognized yet, though that might be due to my other subordinates drawing more eyes.

Who knows, some may have recognized her and are just keeping it to themselves for whatever reason.

Glenda raised her brow challengingly. "Yuuki." She greeted neutrally

"I'm quite surprised to see you at this table Glenda." Commented Yuuki.

Glenda scoffed. "Well let's just say things happened."

"Eh? Who's this weakling?" I sighed hearing Milim. She was likely measuring Yuuki's abilities through her Milim Eye, but it would be foolish to underestimate what sort of Skills he could have.

I can tell he has a Unique Skill at the very least.

"Ahaha, well I assume when compared to your abilities almost everyone would be considered a weakling Lady Milim." Appeased Yuuki.

Damn, he was good at asskissing, probably a skill he developed after being involved with politics for so long. After all, the Free Guild's funding has to come from somewhere.

Milim nodded proudly. "Umu!"

My subordinates went ahead and introduced themselves in quick succession.

"It is a pleasure to meet you all." Said Yuuki after being introduced to my and Milim's subordinates.

Rimuru then left with Yuuki off to some other tables.

'You get anything Odin?'

I'm surprised Odin is taking so long to get an analysis on him.

'Notice. The individual Yuuki Kagurazaka has an unusual attribute, Anti-Skill. Anti-Skill is a spiritual attribute that can shut down Magic and Skills.'

'Even Ultimate Skills?!'

'Correct.'

Dude… what the fuck.

This guy can straight up negate an Ultimate Skill, that's one of the most bullshit abilities I've ever heard of.

He should easily be able to get through any kind of Barriers, can make any sort of Magic or Skill harmless, even Aura won't be of use against him.

'Is there any restriction to his Odin?'

'Answer. Anti-Skill can only be applied through direct touch,and it must be active at the time.'

I see, so it still has some limitations. I could always jump him before he has a chance to react if I need to. Temporal Manipulation can also likely affect him seeing as how does one negate Time?

'Hmm, so is Anti-Skill interfering with your analysis?'

'Correct. Even when disabled the Anti-Skill attribute negates most analysis abilities based on the user's will.'

Hmm, so the fact that Odin was even able to get anything at all is impressive. So that means Yuuki can show whatever powerlevel he wishes while suppressing the rest, and Anti-Skill will stop anyone from finding out.

'Correct.'

Hmm, so I won't be able to copy his Unique Skill nearly as quickly, and it is basically impossible to analyze his Anti-Skill attribute at this point.

Man that sucks, I can't immediately find out if Yuuki is behind the attack it seems.

'....'

'No need to be upset Odin, we all have off days. Yuuki's ability is just uniquely suited to keep you from gathering information.'

Eventually the truth will come to light, so I just need to wait.

All of a sudden I noticed someone decently powerful approaching Tempest, it seems they were arriving by air.

"I'll be back." I told everyone at the table.

I headed towards where Rimuru was chatting with some Monarch of some random Nation.

"Rimuru." I interrupted. The table I had approached immediately stopped talking and began looking at me. Some with fear, some with interest, and some with curiosity.

"Did you need anything Felix?" Rimuru asked formally.

I nodded. "Yeah, let me pull you to the side."

Rimuru nodded and gave the table an apologetic smile before we left to an isolated area of the banquet hall.

"What's up Felix? You wouldn't call me like this unless it's important." Questioned Rimuru.

"I can sense someone approaching Tempest at high speeds. It seems to be a Dragon Lord that is pulling a carriage of some sort." I commented. Talk about fancy, using a Dragon Lord as a steed is something I hadn't even considered.

Rimuru's eyes widened. "Dragon Lord?!" Rimuru whispered.

I sighed. "Keep your composure Rimuru, even now we have eyes on us, if they see the Demon Lord panicking they will also panic."

Rimuru quickly got his expression under control. "Yeah, you're right."

Before he could continue, Gazel interrupted us. "What's going on Rimuru, if someone is causing trouble for my Junior they'll have to deal with me."

"Ah, Felix said he could sense a Dragon King of some kind pulling a carriage towards Tempest."

Gazel's eyes widened marginally before he sighed. "I think I know who your guest is. Erald has not arrived yet has he?"

Rimuru shook his head.

"Then it is as I feared. The Empress of Sarion, Elmesia El Ru Sarion is making her way to Tempest." Hearing this Rimuru looked gobsmacked.

Though I was mostly curious, I've heard quite a lot about the Elves, whether it is from Rimuru or Ramiris.

The Elves are all descended from the True Ancestor of the Elves, Sylvia El Ru according to Ramiris.

Sylvia El Ru is another result of Twilight Valentine's experiments on Veldanava's orders. Sylvia El Ru, Luminous Valentine, Guran Dwargo, along with a couple others are all the Progenitors of the various races that inhabit the Cardinal World.

Each race was created in Twilight's experiments for creating the ideal race for Veldanava, apparently according to Ramiris that ended up being Humans.

This world's history was quite something, and Ramiris knew a whole lot about it seeing as she was one of Veldanava's earliest creations.

"Ugh, I thought only Erald and Eren would come but I guess I didn't put any specific names on the invitation." Said Rimuru.

"I don't think that would have stopped her. If the Divine Empress Elmesia is coming here that is bound to draw attention. I'm sure everyone in attendance will send word of her arrival here back to their home countries. Elmesia is an opponent none would willingly provoke." Commented Gazel in a defeated tone. He must have some history with her.

Hmm, Elmesia must have made quite the reputation for someone as strong as Gazel to be wary of her.

From what I know the Sorcerer's Dynasty Sarion is ruled solely by Elmesia. Though just as the term Dynasty applied it was a federation formed by 13 royal families. Elmesia has declared herself a descendent of god, which is kind of true seeing as she is a descendent of a True Ancestor, though I'm unsure if Elmesia herself has awakened attaining Divinity.

Since Elmesia has claimed to be a descendent of god she has forbidden worship of other gods in Sarion which has put her on the bad side of the Western Holy Church.

Sarion has been around for over 2,000 years and was restored by Elmesia after the original Ultra-Sorcery Kingdom which was the home of the Elves was destroyed by Milim during her awakening.

They are the ones basically responsible for Milim's awakening after all.

Anyway, after the Ultra-Sorcery Kingdom was destroyed, Elmesia gathered all the royal families together to create a Dynasty. According to Ramiris, Elmesia's father used to be a True Hero, though he vanished after he went to slay the Chaos Dragon that was rampagin in the Ultra-Sorcery Kingdom on Milim's orders.

I assume he is dead.

Once all of the royal families were united under Elmesia they each formed their own kingdoms under her Dynasty. The thirteen kingdoms are left alone and are allowed to do as they please, though they are not permitted to have any sort of military as the sole command over the military remains with Elmesia.

One of Sarion's main specialties was homunculus, homunculus allow individuals to imbue their spirit into the fake body allowing them to venture somewhere without any true danger to their person as their spirit will just return to their original body whenever the homunculus is slayed.

"Well let's go greet our guest then." Rimuru then turned to look at me. "Did you want to come Felix?"

Hmm, I am curious about the Empress of the Elves, so why not.

"Yeah, I'll tag along."

Rimuru nodded and led us out, though I made a quick stop at our table and told everyone I'd be back in a little bit. Milim looked ready to protest but I distracted her with some of the sweets that were now being served.

We made our way to the entrance to the Capital City of Tempest as there was more open ground available. Hopefully Elmesia will sense us waiting here and direct her Dragon King to land here.

Having a Dragon King landing in the middle of Tempest is bound to catch a ton of attention after all.

Still, to have tamed a Dragon King this Elmesia must be at least at Gazel's level, likely far higher seeing as she is far older than him.

The three of us continued to chat a bit while we waited, though we didn't need to wait long.

All three of us looked up as a massive bipedal Dragon descended into the clearing in front of us with a carriage connected to it.

That's quite the entrance, I can give her points for that much at least.

"Do not get careless Rimuru, she is like a vulture who will pounce on any sort of weakness." Advised Gazel.

Rimuru nodded.

The door to the carriage opened and out walked an androgynous High Elf, one with the standard pointed ears the Elves are known for as well as pale blue-silver hair and green eyes.

Her appearance was one that could be mistaken for that of a childs, though through my Milim Eye I could tell her soul was over 2,000 years old.

The so-called Divine Empress confidently walked towards us with Erald and Eren trailing alongside behind her, both with apologetic smiles on their faces.

Heh, I could tell this would be an interesting time.
