They really were quite badass, even more badass than Diablo's, in my totally unbiased opinion.

I had gotten so used to teleporting everywhere that I hadn't had the chance to enjoy a good old-fashioned flight. So, to stretch out my wings, I decided to fly to the Ice Continent.

With a single flap of my wings, I soared far past the clouds, forcing them to disperse, and just looked down at the world from above.

After a moment, I flapped my wings once more and began flying towards the Ice Continent, breaking the sound barrier multiple times over and causing a booming sonic explosion. A single sonic shockwave alone would be enough to destroy entire cities at the speed I'm flying at. It's a good thing I'm high up in the air.

However, I could always use Law Domination to make it so that there are no shockwaves.

I really am busted, huh?

Too OP, please don't nerf.

I grinned as I felt the wind blast against my face. The air pressure and resistance alone would destroy a normal Human's body. They just weren't built to move at speeds this high.

I flew over the Great Jura Forest, straight up, ignoring the security measures Tempest had in place. I imagine if any of Rimuru's people were able to detect me they would be quite spooked by now.

I passed over Dwargon and the Caanat Mountains. As I was flying over I noticed one of the Dragon Lords notice me since I had slowed my speed.

It roared to the heavens in defiance, insulted that I had completely ignored its presence.

Ugh, why couldn't all Dragons be like Raiden? Nice and reasonable while also not excessively prideful.

I decided to humor it and allowed it to fly up to my level. It had piercing blue eyes, as well as blue scales. I smirked. This was a Wind Dragon with some control over the weather due to its mastery of its abilities.

I could see a light of intelligence behind its eyes. To become a Dragon Lord, it is said that a Dragon needs to live for centuries unless they are abnormally talented and have other benefits like Raiden. Raiden was named and got Gifted from my Harvest Festival, boosting her evolution.

It is said that Dragon Lords have intelligence and wisdom on the level of Humans, but even among Humans, there are smart and idiotic ones. It seems the same could be said for Dragons.

It seems this was one of the more idiotic ones. I was suppressing my Aura to the absolute maximum, but beings like this Dragon should have developed instincts. Either this one was a fool and was ignoring his instincts, or he just got to his current stage due to luck.

I raised a brow as the Dragon stared into my eyes, challengingly.

"What?" It was almost cute how he got upset at my disrespect.

I rolled my eyes. "If you're just here to throw a temper tantrum about how you're a Dragon and the most badass creature in existence, you can fuck off." I snorted.

For some reason, it was not happy about what I said.

Weird.

"ROOOOOOAAAARRR!"

Its roar boomed throughout the surroundings. The sheer force of the sound would have been enough to knock down trees if we weren't in the air.

I simply rolled my eyes. I appeared above the Dragon at speeds it couldn't hope to follow and simply kicked him downwards, creating a sonic boom.

I watched as the Dragon crashed back into the Caanat Mountain range, normally causing a significant amount of damage to both the Caanat Mountain range, as well as Dwargon, which laid beneath, however I placed a Barrier as hard as diamonds where it landed, causing no damage to the environment, no reason to make a mess for Gazel to clean up, though that can't be said for the Dragon though.

It would be in pain… for a while.

Hopefully, it would learn its lesson. Just being a Dragon did not, in fact, make you the coolest kid on the block, no matter what various fictional works of my past lives said.

The Dragon Lords of the Caanat Mountains were far too used to being king of the hill it seems, and had not developed their combat prowess other than just simply using the raw power they possessed to overwhelm their opponents.

Similar to Veldora before he met Rimuru, in fact.

It's lucky I was in a good mood, or I would have Cleaved its head off and hung its head up in my room.

I rolled my eyes at the waste of time that turned out to be, I was expecting it, but I was also a bit curious about how the Dragon would react to me, I hadn't explored the higher levels of the Caanat Mountains.

The only Dragons I've interacted with are Raiden and her Draconic subordinates, who are very obedient, and the True Dragons. Neither of those groups really gave me an accurate picture about how regular Dragons acted.

I shrugged my shoulders and stopped thinking about that insignificant Dragon further.

With another flap of my wings, I boomed forward, leaving behind multiple sonic explosions. Moments later, I appeared right above the Ice Continent.

I could feel the chill in the air due to Velzard's Aura. Thanks to being released to a True Dragon, this casually released Aura was capable of even getting through my Thermal Fluctuation Nullification.

Fucking True Dragons, though I imagine many others are capable of doing something similar if they have an Elemental Ultimate Skill. Perhaps Raiden will be able to branch out and be capable of burning me with Lightning in the future.

I released the tight leash I kept on my Aura, allowing it to ravage the lands, that should be enough to signal my presence.

As I approached the Ice Palace, I suppressed my Aura again. I didn't want Velzard to get mad at me for destroying her precious palace.

She ribbed at me a bit due to her palace being damaged from our Haki clash, though I could tell she was joking at that time.

Still, it's best to be safe. I don't want to be on the other end of an angry True Dragon for no reason.

It didn't take long for Guy's green-haired maid, Misery, to come out and fly up to me. She gave me a respectful bow as she approached. "Lord Felix, my master was not expecting you today."

I shrugged, not particularly bothered.. "He said I could come by whenever."

Misery nodded. "Very well, if you would please follow me, I will guide you."

I rolled my eyes but nodded. I don't know why Guy is adamant about maintaining these boring formalities.

I flew down behind Misery. "So, has anything interesting happen lately?" I asked.

Misery shook her head. "No, nothing has been unusual, except perhaps the ongoing chaos in the Western Nations. Word has reached us that the Guildmaster of the Free Guild has passed." Misery said, her eyes briefly scanning me as if gauging my reaction.

I shrugged my shoulders. "How tragic."

We didn't talk any further as Misery led me through the icy halls. I saw the icy gates to the throne room up ahead, guarded by the same trolls as before.

Misery walked straight through the now opened gates.

"Lord of Darkness, Demon Lord Guy Crimson, the Usurper of Black, Demon Lord Felix White has arrived." Declared Misery.

Up ahead I could see Guy lounging on his throne with a carefree smirk. He was in his male form this time, and I didn't spot Velzard anywhere. I didn't bother sensing further for her, she'll show up if she wants to.

Misery led me past the legion of Daemons standing by, once I was standing in front of him, I gave Guy a nod. "Guy."

"Felix, I didn't know you would be arriving today." Remarked Guy.

I shrugged my shoulders in response. "Well you said to pop by whenever, and I had nothing else to do."

Guy nodded. "I did say that, didn't I? You've gotten more powerful it seems."

I shrugged. "I recently had some growth."

There was consuming the body of the Chaos Dragon which increased my EP by a bit, then devouring Yuuki's Soul, though I didn't gain nearly as much from that due to Odin repurposing that energy in Yuuki's Soul.

Guy nodded and got up off his seat and gestured to follow him. "Well come on now, no point in talking here."

Guy then looked to Rain and Misery who had taken her position behind him. "Prepare some snacks for us you two."

Rain gave Guy a salute. "Yes!"

Misery just sighed and bowed. "As you wish master."

Rain tried to discreetly give me a thumbs up, but going by the look Guy was giving her, she wasn't very successful in keeping it discreet.

Guy just sighed and gestured to me to walk next to him.

"So Misery told me that you noticed some interesting stuff happening in the West." I commented.

Guy nodded. "Yeah, looks like the order in the West is beginning to become disrupted."

"I didn't know you kept informed about the West."
Guy shrugged his shoulders. "Part of the job, if I want to stop things before they go out of hand it's best to keep informed."

I nodded. "That's true."

"Even Luminous has gotten involved, it seems, going by the announcement her group of fanatics made."

"You talking about how the Church announced the Moderate Harlequin Alliance as responsible for the death of Yuuki?"

Guy nodded. "Mhmm." He then looked at me. "You know anything about that?"

I debated on whether to give Guy a rough overview of everything; that way, I could at least control what he heard. If I don't give him anything, he may go digging on his own.

And it's probably best if Guy doesn't dig too deep into things. I'm sure it would turn out fine, but it sounds like a pain in the ass, I might as well solve that future problem now.

"Sorta, I killed Yuuki Kagurazaka." I admitted.

Guy raised a brow. "Oh? I didn't think you would have a reason to kill that guy. He seems to be revered as a saint back in the Western Nations."

By now, we had arrived at the lounge, so I took a seat with Guy sitting across from me.

I leaned back in my seat. "Ha! So much for that. Nah, all of that was an act. He wanted to conquer the world or something."

Guy nodded. "People like that turn up from time to time. So what made you personally interested in killing him?" Guy asked with interest written across his face.

Before I could answer, Misery showed up and served us both a glass of wine.

I took a sip of the wine. "He was involved in the death of someone close to me, and so I killed him."

"Ha! As simple a reason as any, but also as good a reason as any." Guy said as he raised the glass in cheers.

I raised my own glass. "Yeah, sometimes you don't need any complicated reason to kill."

"Said like a Daemon," Guy said with a smirk.

"Well, I am a Daemon, aren't I?" I retorted.
"That you are." Guy nodded.

We both sat in a comfortable silence for a few moments before I broke it. "Well, I shared a bit of my story. Now it's your turn."

Guy raised a brow. "My story?"

I nodded. "Hmm, what about your story with the first True Hero, the Hero of the Beginning, Rudra?"

"Ah? You want to hear about that guy, huh? Sure, why not." Guy laughed out.

"Do you know the basics? I was born from the Great Spirit of Darkness as one of the reflections of the Primordial Angels. I got Summoned, became a Demon Lord, met Velda, fought Velzard, and then just did whatever I pleased."

I nodded. "Yeah, Ramiris gave me a good amount of background information on everything."

Guy clicked his tongue. "Tch. That Pixie is always talking too much."

"Heh, well, don't blame her. You know how she is."
Guy sighed. "Indeed, her original Incarnation was far less annoying, though."

I tilted my head. "Her original Incarnation? You mean the original Fairy Queen? What was she like?"

Guy laughed. "Well, she was mature for one, motherly, caring, and strong, she was damn strong."

"Hah! Well, at least that fits my image of what the Fairy Queen should be like. It's a shame what happened to her."

Guy winced. "Yeah, that incident was a pain in the ass. Fighting Milim for seven days and seven nights was enjoyable, but it was a pain to mitigate all the collateral damage."

"Yeah, I imagine. An out-of-control Milim does not sound fun to deal with. Even I'd likely be caught with my pants down, helpless to do anything but stall."

If that happened, maybe, just maybe, I could eat her with Beelzebuth and calm her down. It all depends on how much willpower Milim has left in her berserk state. The more willpower an individual has, the more they can resist Beelzebuth's consumption.

"Haa! You can't even imagine how strong she was back then. You'd really have to be there to feel it. She did inherit a lot of Velda's power. Back then, she stopped suppressing her inherited power and went wild."

I nodded. At first, I didn't even know Milim was suppressing her power even in our spars, but Odin was able to notify me about it after I had her do another scan of Milim. It turns out that the 10,000,000 EP that Milim is showing, isn't even her full power. No, her full power is comparable to that of a True Dragon. Odin hypothesized that Milim had sealed the majority of her strength deep within her to prevent another incident like the one that happened in the past from happening again.

Odin thought that Milim didn't want to lose control of her power again.

Fucking True Dragons.

"Anyways, it seems we have gotten off topic. Sometime after I settled down on the Ice Continent, Rudra showed up."

I tilted my head. "Ah yes, the age-old story of the Hero confronting the Demon Lord."

Guy snorted. "Something like that. I still remember that day clearly. I remember I was extremely bored that day when three visitors showed up at the Ice Palace, Rudra, Lucia, and Velgrynd."

I raised a brow. "Lucia?"

Guy nodded. "Lucia is Rudra's sister, Velda's wife, and Milim's mother."

"Huh, well, I didn't know that."

Guy shrugged his shoulders. "Ramiris' tends to forget a lot of things when her Incarnation is as young as the current one is. It's not surprising that she didn't tell you everything."

I nodded. "And Velgrynd? What is her relationship with Rudra? I know that she is the Guardian of the Eastern Empire."

Guy laughed. "Their relationship, huh? Well, they're lovers."

"Oh? Veldora did say that Velgrynd had a partner, though I didn't ask who."

"Heh, those two have been obsessed with each other for as long as I've seen them together."

I nodded. "Well, that's good to know."

"Back to my story now." Before Guy could continue, he was interrupted by the sound of wheels rolling across the icy floor.

Guy sighed and looked at Rain, who was rolling a food cart. "The food you have asked for has been prepared, Lord Guy."

Guy sighed but nodded. "Well, I don't need to tell you to serve us, do I?"

"Gah! You don't have to be so mean about it!" Responded Rain.

Guy sighed. "Just do your damn job."

Rain quickly served us and then left. I took a bite of the Mystic Chicken she had served and gestured for Guy to continue.

"When Rudra first showed up, he demanded for all the treasures I had in my possession."

I snorted. "Seriously? That guy wanted your gold? That wasn't the image of him I had in mind."

"Heh, most wouldn't imagine him to be like that. He was a rather playful and goofy individual."

Guy continued. "Anyways, during our first fight, I introduced myself. I could remember his words exactly. Wait a minute! That's not a name! How is that a name?! If I defeated a Demon Lord with such a funny name, it would be so uncool. It would be better to record the story of my bravery with a cooler name!!"

"Hahaha, he paused the fight because he did not like your name, huh?"

Guy nodded with a reminiscent smile. "Indeed, he was a presumptuous one. After taking a good look at me, he added Crimson to my name, and from that day on, I became Guy Crimson."
"So that's how you got your second name, huh?"

Guy nodded. "Indeed, Rudra used his Spiritual Energy rather than Magicules after he selfishly named me. He ended up falling unconscious due to the strain of naming me. He was always a fool, but I had taken a liking to him."

"After that, we would battle many times, our battles being mostly even, but over time I began to overpower Rudra. Despite the tricks he used to weaken me, his Skill just wasn't suited for him." Guy sighed.

"His Skill?" Part of me did wonder what kind of power the first True Hero had.

Guy nodded with a smirk. "Indeed, Rudra was a student of Velda's. Once his training was complete Velda bestowed upon him a weapon named Deva, and then traded for his Ultimate Skill."

"They traded Ultimate Skills? Well, I guess it makes sense that Veldanava of all people could do that."

Guy nodded. "The Skill Velda bestowed upon him wasn't nearly as compatible as his original Skill, and so he could only use it for seconds at a time. He only managed to fight against me with pure skill with the blade."

"Which Skills did he have?"

Guy looked thoughtful for a moment before shrugging. "Eh, why not share? Who knows, this information may come in handy for you in the future."

I raised a brow at the end of what Guy said. Why would knowing Rudra's Skills come in handy in the future? The only explanation I can think of is if Guy expects there to be a confrontation between us, which, going by the Eastern Empire's clear desire to expand their territory further, may actually happen.

My territory was on the borders of the Eastern Empire after all.

"Rudra's original Skill doesn't matter much. It was Uriel, Lord of Vows. It was very compatible with him as it was the crystallization of his beliefs and the various promises he had made."

I raised a brow at that. "Uriel, Lord of Vows? Interesting."

"Oh? What's so interesting about that?" Guy asked with interest.

I didn't see any harm in sharing, and so I answered. "I had manifested Uriel, Lord of Vows."

Guy's eyes widened. "Seriously?!"

I nodded. "Yup."

"Huh, it was always focused on Spatial Management, so that must be that Spatial Skill you have then." Guy declared with certainty.

I waved my finger at him. "Not quite. Uriel evolved into a new Ultimate Skill." I shared.

Perhaps it was foolish to share something like this with the first Demon Lord, but for all I knew, he may have already further evolved his own Ultimate Skill. Plus, even if he knew, unless he had a Sage-like Skill, I don't think he would be able to evolve his Skill at this point.

It is possible to force it with Information Particles, but if Guy could do that, he already would've done it.

Guy's eyes somehow widened even further. "That… that is… very impressive, Felix. Velda had once said that it was theoretically possible to further evolve an Ultimate Skill if one has enough desire and willpower. To think you would be capable of that."

I did cringe slightly since I'm pretty certain that the only reason I was able to evolve Uriel as effortlessly as it seemed was because of Odin.

'Correct. The Voice of the World approved, and then Odin used data that was gathered to further improve the Ultimate Skill: Uriel, Lord of Vows.'

'Well, thanks for that, Ouroboros is certifiably broken.'

"Well, thanks, I guess."

Guy was looking at me with a new light in his eyes, which I wasn't quite sure if it was good or not.

Guy shook his head. "Heh, I'll have to keep that in mind then. Do you mind sharing exactly how you did it? I do not mind owing you a favor for this."

A favor from the legendary Guy Crimson, huh?

"Deal." I may not have evolved my Ultimate Skill solely on my own, but I still had a general idea based on how it works.

"There are a few ways to go about it, I think. One is to just have an overwhelming desire, to the point that the Voice of the World assists with the evolution. Then the second method, which is what I did, is to do it by manipulating Information Particles."

"So you even know about Infons, huh?"

I nodded and continued. "It is possible to fuse and separate Skills by manipulating Infons. Through this you could theoretically merge other Skills into an Ultimate Skill, evolving it, or even merge multiple Ultimate Skills into one."

Guy nodded with a smile growing on his face. "I see, I will have to train it seems then, I doubt such a high level of manipulating Infons comes easy."

"It likely doesn't. You will need data to work with though."

Guy nodded. "I have a feeling that won't be much of a problem for me."

I rolled my eyes. "Yes, yes, you can copy Skills, how special."

Guy smirked and raised his glass in toast to me. "Well then, you now have a favor from I, Guy Crimson."

I cringed slightly. "Did you just refer to yourself in the third person?"

Guy smirked confidently. "I did." Of course, this chuuni guy thinks that's cool.

Hopefully, I don't regret sharing this information with Guy, though I doubt it would have stayed hidden for long. The moment Guy caught wind of my Ultimate Skill, a Skill he for some reason couldn't copy he likely began theorizing how it was possible for such a thing to happen.

"Now wanna share more about Rudra's Skills like you were doing previously?" I asked curiously. I was somewhat curious about the power of the first True Hero, plus that very same True Hero's Empire may or may not become enemies in the future.

Guy nodded. "As I said earlier, Rudra traded his Uriel, Lord of Vows for Velda's personal Skill, Michael, Lord of Justice."

My eyes widened upon hearing that name.

Michael huh? Skills in this world are named after famous mythological figures, a Skill named after the strongest Arch Angel is bound to be seriously strong.

"Uriel's powers were based on the concepts of destroy and protect, and as it was formed from Rudra himself, its use came naturally to him. Michael, on the other hand, was focused on the concept of domination. It was a powerful Skill that allowed Rudra to truly become a pain in the ass."

Michael, Lord of Justice, huh? That was something I had to think about.

Guy continued. "But in the end, Rudra never managed to defeat me. Our competition shifted into something else."

"Something else?"

Guy smirked. "It doesn't matter. Now, why don't we finish eating and then have another spar? I have been itching for another fight."

I rolled my eyes at Guy's obvious change of topic, but I nodded nonetheless. "Sure, sure."

Chapter 60: The Otherworld

- Felix -

As Guy and I ate our meals, I thought back to everything I learned from this interaction and smiled.

This was more than worth it. Knowing more about the Eastern Empire is always helpful. Those guys are sketchy as hell.

Guy placed his knife and fork down and smirked at me. "Now then. Let us fight!"

I rolled my eyes at the battle junkie. "Yeah, yeah."

"Let me call Velzard to maintain the Barriers. That way, we don't need to worry about the global effects of our fight." Said Guy.

I nodded. "Fine by me."
A moment later, a portal appeared, and from it came Velzard. "Ara, I did not know you were here, Felix."

"You would have if you bothered keeping an eye on this palace of yours." I responded.

She gave a dismissive wave. "Why would I do such a thing? The only visitors that we get here are fools and those whom Guy approves of."

Velzard then looked at Guy. "Now, what did you need?"

Guy laughed out. "Sorry for bothering you, Would you mind maintaining a Barrier so that the two of us can have some fun?"

Velzard sighed, though it was more out of habit than real annoyance. "This is just like how it was with Rudra; I always have to maintain the barriers."

"Well, who else could do it? No one else is strong enough." Responded Guy.

Guy's response brought a smirk and a light dusting of red to Velzard's face. "Very well then, I will assist if I must."

"Heh, thanks Velzard."

I watched their byplay with a smirk on my face. Velzard is seriously into Guy, huh? She's barely even hiding it. And either he is too dense to see it or just doesn't feel the same.

None of my business either way.

Guy then waved his hand in front of him, creating a portal. "Come Felix. This leads to one of the edges of the Ice Continent."

I nodded and followed Guy with Velzard right behind me. The icy winds blew all around us, and there was a vast expanse of frozen wilderness as far as the eye could see. A perfect place to let loose without worrying about the consequences.

Once we were there, I snapped my fingers, creating a Barrier that expanded the Space within as well as kept any of our Aura and power from leaving the Barrier.

Velzard placed her own Barriers around my own, further reinforcing everything.

"Let us let loose a bit more than last time. What do you say to weapons?"

I nodded. "Sure, I don't mind."

Perhaps I can copy some of Guy's Sword Arts if I get the chance.

I created a hole in my Barriers allowing Velzard to maintain the Barriers from the outside.

I held my hand out, summoning my newly named katana. It was still slowly growing since more and more energy was being focused on it. Going by the amount of energy in it, its EP was easily over 3,000,000 now.

Heh, my weapon had more EP than Hinata did. I'll have to tease her about that.

I gently gripped the handle of Yamato. There was a nascent tool spirit growing within it. I could feel the spirit nervously stretch its own power out into me as I gently coaxed it out.

I tried to convey a feeling of reassurance and partnership. I may not use Yamato for all my fights, but it was still my weapon of choice.

When wielding it, that was an additional 3,000,000 EP on top of my already very high EP.

Guy whistled. "That's an impressive weapon."

Guy then withdrew his own longsword from his Spatial Storage, and I could immediately feel the power it gave off.

"Huh, what's that made of?" I asked.

"Hmm? Oh, this is made of Starheart, one of the strongest materials in existence."

"I can tell, it feels incredibly powerful." I responded.

Going by EP, it was greater than even my Yamato.

I then got in my stance, I planned on taking Guy seriously from the start, something he reciprocated.

'Odin, I may need your help here.'

'Affirmative.'

I wouldn't be surprised if Guy is more capable than me when it comes to swordsmanship. He's been around fighting for longer than I can even imagine.

I wasn't against cheating when facing powerful opponents; I was a fraud, and I would act like it.

"Heh, I have a feeling that this is gonna be fun." Said Guy. A moment later, he was already upon me, his longsword aimed for my neck. The sonic explosion left in his wake boomed outwards as I quickly reinforced my katana with an overwhelming amount of Fighting Spirit and blocked Guy's attack. I twisted Space teleporting backward and sent an Aura Slash toward Guy, which he easily blocked.

'Continuing analysis on Guy Crimson's fighting style.'

I smirked as I coated my katana in a miniature gravitational field, an anomaly that defies the conventional Laws of Nature. This field simultaneously attracts and repels, creating a rather chaotic force around the blade. When I cut someone with it, the effect mimics that of a miniature black hole, causing their body to collapse in on itself.

Law Domination made it fairly easy to balance these two opposing forces of nature.

"Now that looks scary," Guy commented without worry.

"And yet you don't seem to be afraid at all." I shot back.

Guy smirked. "Well, you still need to hit me." Right after Guy spoke, he dashed forwards, breaking the sound barrier multiple times as he appeared behind me. I could sense the displacement of the air behind me as Guy prepared to hit me with a devastating blow.

But before Guy could react I expanded the Space between us.

I turned around to face Guy with a smirk, Guy himself looked rather disgruntled. "That was annoying." I eyed his blade which was now coated in pure spiritrons, likely meant to bypass my Infinity, though I don't know what Guy's plan to get by my Multi-Dimenisonal Barrier is.

He'd probably brute force it, enough power can bend reality itself after all.

Well, the whole point in this fight was to see what I can learn from Guy. 'Odin, are you analyzing his swordsmanship style?'

'Affirmative.'

'Good.'

–

Guy and I stood across from each other, both of our outfits damaged due to the various cuts and slashes we had hit each other with.

The wounds we left on each other had already healed up, even my attack that mimicked the effects of a miniature black hole only caused Guy a little trouble before he adapted to my attacks and recovered.

He was seriously a load of bullshit.

"Hey, Guy." I called out.

"Hmm?" Guy called out, pausing the Nuclear Magic he was forming in his hand.

"Mind if I try out something new that I'm trying to get the hang of?"

Guy's smirk widened hearing me. "A new move, huh? Sure, let me see what you got."

I smiled. "Excellent."

Hopefully I don't attract any attention by doing this.

I snapped my fingers and evoked an authority I've never used before. The world around us froze as I stopped time. Instantly, I felt a massive drain on my Energy, more than anything I had ever experienced.

'Notice. Using data from Metatron, Lord of Purity to maintain efficient use of Energy to Time Stop. Odin is assisting the Master with maintaining and applying the Time Stop.'

'Great, thanks Odin.'

Then, I felt it. Guy's intent reached me even within the stopped time. 'Pfft, hahaha, I didn't know you could do this, Felix!'

'Why am I not surprised that you can move in the Suspended World Guy.' I sighed. 'Well, that's good. I can get the hang of moving around in this world.' I finished.

Even talking in Time Stop was different. We were communicating by imbuing our intent into the Information Particles and then flinging them to each other, so we weren't even really verbally speaking.

Information Particles were the sole thing we used to perceive the world around us now.

Time Stop was definitely a game ending move in most cases. Those who cannot move in Time Stop are helpless against those who can and even more helpless against those who can activate Time Stop on their own.

Theoretically I could stop Time and then go massacre an entire Kingdom and then leave, and no one would know what happened. Everyone would be helpless to resist.

Time Stop is just that busted, at least if you ignored the absolutely outrageous amount of magicules needed to sustain it.

'To think you would be one of the few beings capable of moving in the Suspended World, you truly are extraordinary, Felix.' Guy transmitted with a slight hint of admiration.

Diablo nodded. "Indeed, my esteemed master saw fit to name me so I can be more useful to him." Responded Diablo.

Before Diablo could continue his Rimuru glazing session, I intervened. "When did you get back Diablo? I heard you were off recruiting Daemons for Rimuru?"

"Ara? Rimuru too?"

I nodded to Velzard. "Yeah, Daemons are useful, so why not."

Velzard nodded.

"I had just returned earlier today. I had not even gotten the chance to give Lord Rimuru a detailed report about the minio– cough Daemons I recruited." Diablo responded.

I nodded. "Right, I guess he would be busy making preparations for Velzard. Anyways, are you here to guide us, Diablo?"

Diablo nodded. "I am Lord Felix. If you would please follow me, I will be giving a brief tour of Tempest before taking you to meet Lord Rimuru and Lord Veldora."

Velzard nodded. "Very well."

Diablo went on to show us the main attractions in Rimuru City, the colosseum, where fights were still regularly taking place, some of the highly rated restaurants and food stalls. The Adventurer district of the city, which was filled with high-quality inns for cheap, hot springs, blacksmithing shops, potion shops, basically anything an Adventurer may need.

"Thank you for the tour Diablo, but I wish to see my little brother. These tours are beginning to bore me." Said Velzard.

Diablo bowed. "As you wish, Lady Velzard. I was just finishing up the tour. Next up is The Dungeon, Lord Rimuru and Lord Veldora are both waiting within."

Velzard nodded.

- Rimuru Tempest -

"Let me go Rimuru! I need to hide! Run! Find somewhere safe! Do you think Felix will let me hide with him for a century or so?!" Veldora yelled in panic, throwing his things in the air as he looked for a good hiding place.

He forcefully held Veldora back. "No! Stay Veldora!" He seriously didn't want Velzard to go on a rampage in Tempest because the person she was coming to see wasn't here.

"Come on, just imagine showing her how much you have grown! Don't you want to look cool?!" He tried coercing him with his one weakness. But that only appeared to make him panic even more.

When Felix had warned him about Velzard's imminent arrival he had panicked a bit. He didn't know how one was supposed to receive a True Dragon, and so he had a feast cooked up.

However, one odd thing he noticed was that Veldora had somehow teleported when he wasn't looking even though he felt no Spatial Manipulation, something practically impossible to hide from him since he had Uriel, Lord of Vows.

But before he could ask Veldora began panicking because he sensed Velzard in Felix's territory, and then Veldora further panicked after he told him what Felix said over the Thought Communication.

"Come on, Veldora! It will be fine! I'll even give you some more manga!" He tried once again, dodging a bed that flew by his head.

"I've read all the manga, you know!" Shouted Veldora.

"Perhaps, but this is one from Felix's world!" Hearing him, Veldora froze causing Rimuruto smirk.

He had asked Felix for some ammunition to use against Veldora should he need it. Manga that Veldora had never heard of would do the trick.

"Do you promise you'll give me the entire manga? All the volumes you have?" Veldora asked sheepishly. Finally calming down for a moment.

"Yes, yes! Just stop trying to get away from me." Rimuru muttered as he felt Veldora finally stop shaking.

"Fine." He whispered.

He sighed in relief. "I'll only give it to you once Velzard leaves, though!"

Veldora nodded and began hyping himself up. "It's no big deal, just seeing my big sister, who I haven't seen in a long time. Plus, I have you by my side, and you won't abandon me, right? If Velzard starts to hurt me, you'll jump in and protect me, won't you?"

"Uh…. Yeah…." Rimuru muttered, somewhat unsure, as he began to step back. Leaving Veldora to his personal glazing session as he went to receive Velzard. He sensed Felix and Velzard at the entrance to The Dungeon with Diablo.

- Felix -

"And this has all been done using the Authority of Ramiris?" Asked Velzard.

Diablo nodded. "Correct."

"It is quite impressive what the Pixie has done. She is far from her true self, and yet she is still capable of such wonders." Said Velzard.

"Yeah, her Small World is quite overpowered."

Velzard gave me a look. "You even know what that is, hmm?"

"Ramiris talks."

Velzard nodded in understanding.

We were currently at the main lobby where all the Adventurers checked in, sold items, and bought items.

Diablo was currently using his Tempter to make it so no one would recognize us and bother us. He could use that Skill to a fearsome degree.

"Welcome to Tempest, Miss Velzard." A voice called out.

We all turned to the direction the voice came from. Rimuru gave me a nod.

Diablo bowed. "Lord Rimuru."

"Ah, thanks for escorting them Diablo." Said Rimuru.

"It is my pleasure to serve at your whims, My Lord." Diablo said reverently.

"Okay, now you're just making it weird." Rimuru said with a shake of his head.

Rimuru looked at Velzard. "It is a pleasure to meet you Miss Velzard. Veldora has said a lot about you."

"Ara ara, you may call me Velzard. You seem to have the Blessing of Veldora, so it seems the tales of how close you two are are true. It is nice to meet you as well, Demon Lord Rimuru." Said Velzard.

Rimuru nodded. "Well, let me escort you to Veldora. He's the whole reason you're here, right?"

Velzard eyed me for a moment before nodding. "Among other things, yes."

Weird.

Rimuru gave me the stink eye before nodding. "Alright, follow me then!"

Spoiler: Lalatina

Story: I'm a Daemon, so what?

Disclaimer: I do not own the original setting.

Chapter 31: A Student!
__________________________________________________________________________

- Felix -

Guy led us to an extravagant dining room, of course everything was made out of ice, but it was still quite beautiful. The table was in a long oval shape with over 10 seats.

Misery and Rain were already here waiting for us with the dishes ready to be served in a cart.

Guy took a seat at the head of the table with Velzard sitting in the middle. I decided to sit at the opposite end, opposite to Guy.

Once we were seated, Rain wheeled the cart around while Misery served us the dishes.

There seemed to be a stew of some kind along with some Dragon meat and some other grilled meat.

We all began eating once we were all served, I took a bite of the steak first seeing as it is what I am most familiar with.

From the taste it seems to be some kind of Fire Dragon, or at least it tastes similar to when Raiden cooks up some Fire Dragon for me.

Huh, the meat in the stew is something I've never had before, and it's incredibly delicious.

'Report. Component analysis complete. It is now possible to recreate the recipes Gryphon Stew, Grilled Spark Panther, and Roast Fire Dragon Steak.'

'Nice! Thanks Odin.'

"So what do you think Felix?" Asked Guy.

I assume she's asking about the food. "It is quite delicious, probably as good as the food my Maid cooks and I love her food."

Guy looked interested. "Oh? You have a maid as well?" For some reason Guy was acting like we were comrades all of a sudden.

"Yeah?"

She shook his head with a sigh. "Nothing nothing." Guy said as she shot a glare to an innocently whistling Rain and a serious looking Misery.

"Hmm, maybe I should stop by sometime to try your Maids food if you are comparing it to Misery's who has been cooking food for me for millenia." Guy asked.

"Hmm, as long as you don't go on a rampage or anything I don't mind. Just make sure you show up when I'm there since I visit Rimuru and Milim relatively often." I responded.

"The Slime eh? He has an Ultimate Skill too, truly this century is becoming quite interesting." Guy muttered.

So Guy knows that Rimuru has an Ultimate Skill huh? I doubt she is aware of what those Skills are though, not to mention I don't think Guy would even consider Rimuru having 4 Ultimate Skills he acquired on his own merit.

Hell even I have only acquired two Ultimate Skills on my own, the rest are copied. And even that's debatable since Odin helped push things along.

As we were finishing up the meal I said, "By the way Velzard."

She paused her eating and looked at me. "Yes?"

"Whenever you decide to visit Veldora come see me first, who knows what will happen if you just show up in Tempest, Veldora will panic, that's for sure. Not to mention Rimuru's reaction to another True Dragon showing up. It would just be easier if you come to me and then I can take you to Tempest and introduce you to Rimuru. Veldora listens to Rimuru so maybe he'll be willing to talk to you if Rimuru encourages it." I respond.

"Hmm, I see. Okay then, I will see you before I visit Veldora." Velzard acquiesced.

I nodded. "Good."

It's good that she listened, who knows if she just shows up in Tempest a fight might just start due to multiple overreactions. Velzard has more raw power than me, even when I'm using Satanael at 40%.

Hmm speaking about unsealed form, Odin had detected that she was limiting her power output for some reason.

I wonder why?

"Velzard." I called out.

She looked at me. "Yes?"

"Why is a portion of your power sealed?"

"Ah, you can even sense that. It is far easier to control my power in this sealed state. In my true form accidentally waving my hand may obliterate Veldora or Velgrynd. Not to mention another side benefit that I will not be talking about." Ah, so similar to what Freeza had done huh?

I nodded. Controlling one's power is a real issue in this world huh? Not everyone is fortunate to have a Skill that can control your own power for you.

In her current form I'd say her raw power is a decent bit greater than mine, but who knows about how strong she really is in her true form?

I'd like to think I'd still have a chance seeing as she fought Guy to a standstill, but who knows. I'm sure Guy fought her to a standstill with pure technique rather than raw power, after all Milim wasn't even born at that point so he couldn't have used Satanael to power up.

It's probably just best to avoid a fight with her in general.

We quickly finished our meal at which point I decided it was about time to leave.

"Alright, I've been far from my territory for long enough now so I am going to head back."

"I see, then feel free to visit me whenever you wish, I could use the distraction." Guy responded.

"Yeah yeah." I turned towards Velzard and gave her a wave, one she responded to.

I snapped my fingers and appeared inside of my bedroom back in my territory.

No matter how much I teleport it still feels surreal.

"My Lord!" I heard someone say from outside the door.

"Come in!" I respond.

The door opens and in comes all of my direct subordinates, Saeko, Raiden, Kurumi, Arcueid, Megumin, and Lalatina. I could even see Ingvild hiding out in the back.

"You didn't all have to come and greet me, I told you I would be fine."

"Haha, I knew you'd be fine!" Megumin said enthusiastically. "So how'd it go! Did you fight?!"

Of course that's what she wants to know. "We did spar a bit though nothing serious."

"Ah, I wish I could have watched that." Said Megumin.

"I am happy for your safe return My Lord." Said Arcueid.

I gave her a nod.

Kurumi just shifted into her fox form and took a seat on my shoulder while Lalatina said, "As expected of my Master!" Man these guys took my meeting with Guy as a really big deal huh? They seemed quite confident in my return too.

"Ah! Felix-sama, I am glad that you have returned!" Said Saeko.

"Thank you Saeko."

Raiden just assumed a position behind me, not saying anything.

Ah, someone is missing huh? "Where's Sukuna at?"

Arcueid is the one who responded this time. "As your butler it is his duty to make sure your reign is unimpeded, or so he said. So I sent him to deal with some bugs who were not following the rules of your territory My Lord."

Oh, so he is sort of acting as a prosecutor or something?

"I see, good work Arcueid. Now as much as I appreciate you guys greeting me I need to head to the training dimension. I want to fully understand the new Skills I got from my fight with Guy."

"Of course My Lord." They all left, though not after each giving me their own version of a goodbye.

I teleported into the training dimension to begin fully understanding what truly changed. The moment I got Gabriel I could feel my understanding over the concept of Time improve astronomically, my understanding of Infons also increased, though I'm pretty sure that's due to Odin.

Ouroboros on its own is primarily focused on Space with some power over Time, but Gabriel's power over Time makes Ouroboros' former power over Time a complete joke.

Of course now that Ouroboros has been upgraded using data from Gabriel that is different.

Honestly gaining Gabriel has been a massive boon, my raw power might not have increased but I am far stronger than I was before for a few reasons.

Gabriel's sub-skills include Fixation, this is what Velzard used on Guy and attempted to use on me.

It basically locks something to its current state, essentially putting something into a temporal stasis.

I was capable of doing something similar using Magic from Black Clover but this is far superior to that, and far harder to break out of, after all it was able to freeze Guy Crimson, if only temporarily.

Gabriel also has Space-Time Manipulation, more specifically under Space-Time Manipulation was Temporal Manipulation. This allows Gabriel to have far higher power over Time which was added to Ouroboros along with Fixation.

Odin disassembled Gabriel and used the data from it to improve Ouroboros so everything that Gabriel was able to do, now Ouroboros can too.

Except for one Skill.

The next Skill is actually a World System Skill called Eternal World. This is a World System Skill that brings everything inside the user's domain to an absolute halt, locking them in place and nullifying all kinds of attacks.

There were a few reasons that this was not added to Ouroboros, for one thanks to the data Odin gathered I have something far superior to Eternal World, but Eternal World is basically Fixation just applied to everything inside the user's domain. Not something I need, if I ever do need it I can instantly have Odin recreate the ability.

Hmm, maybe I can have Odin work on a Skill that allows me to use all the Skills I have completely analyzed without actually having the Skill in question.

This way I can use a ton of Ultimate Skills but not have to suffer the strain on my soul.

'Sufficient data has not been gathered to accomplish such a feat. Odin will gather the data and create a Skill that fulfills the Master's requirements.'

That's about what I expected, the Skill I have in mind is more broken than most other Ultimate Skills after all.

'Still, good work Odin.'

Now the biggest gain out of this visit by far was one single ability, an ability that made me almost unbeatable.

Time Stop.

Time Stop is by no means a simple feat, and this isn't some fake Time Stop like the one Gasper Vladi from High School DxD is capable of.

This is a bonafide Time Stop, as in it completely stops the flow of Time throughout all of Veldanava's Creation.

If I were to use Time Stop now, the world of Jujutsu Kaisen would be frozen, hell each and every universe will be affected.

This is absolute Hax.

Of course I have not actually used this ability yet so there may be a bit of a learning curve, even with Odin, but still, Time Stop!

Not to mention it costs an absolutely obscene amount of energy, but I can afford that thanks to Magicule Breeder Reactor.

The only way to "move" in a Time Stop is by being a Digital Nature which I recently became thanks to Odin's help.

Digital Natures are a subspecies of Divine Natures that can shift their entire beings into purely digital form between sets of Infons.

Digital Natures are able to move in a Time Stop since they don't actually move their particles from place to place, they instead move their information between different sets of static Infons. It's due to this that the laws of physics are not broken and the speed of light is not exceeded.

During the duration of a Time Stop, the flow of time is completely frozen for all worlds, resulting in a place where the laws of physics don't fully apply called the Stopped World. Within the Stopped World, matter and energy of any kind cannot move and things such as molecular binding forces do not exist, making physical durability meaningless.

This is what makes it a real Time Stop rather than something like Forbidden Balor's View.

This is why only beings who can think with their hearts and are able to manipulate Infons are able to perceive the Stopped World, and only those who have managed to gain the ability to transfer their entire existence in information form between sets of Infons, Digital Natures, are able to "move" in the stopped world, everyone else is stopped, they won't even realize Time has stopped either as they aren't even capable of perceiving it.

Since in the Stopped World particles can't flow emission type attacks are practically useless. Of course while Magic can't be cast in a Time Stop the effects of already cast Magic still apply, like Barriers. But the only real way to damage someone who is capable of moving in the Stopped World is by bombarding them with Infons, rewriting the target's information.

Basically battles in the Stopped World are almost entirely determined by who can manipulate Infons better, and I have Odin, a master at manipulating Infons now thanks to the detailed analysis she has done ever since I became a Digital Nature.

Of course for those who can't perceive a Time Stop all I would need to do is stop Time and then bombard them with Infons when they can't defend.

Power doesn't matter in the Stopped World after all.

That isn't even all I got from my visit, I even got Metatron!

It's safe to say that my trip to the Ice Continent was worth it despite the potential dangers.

I really love golden gooses like Guy and Velzard.

Hmm, now that I have sufficient data about World System Skills I have an idea.

'Odin can you create me a Skill utilizing the data from Higuruma's Technique and any other data you think is suitable?'

'Acknowledged.'

Intrinsic Skill: Ruler's Authority has been gained.

Heh.
___________________________________________________________________

I snapped my fingers and created a brand new Dimension. I've been planning on this for a while and I finally got around to it. It's been about a week since I got back from the Ice Continent now.

I turned towards Raiden and Porunga. "There, the gravity will get stronger and stronger the closer you get to the center of the Dimension, use this to train up the Dragon Corps physiques and speed."

"Yes Master." Said Raiden.

"Hmm, this will be incredibly helpful for those young ones, they are always so rowdy and complaining about how they aren't getting stronger. Thank you My Lord, this training room should help improve their strengths a fair amount." Said Porunga with a bow.

That guy has been taking his duties super seriously, he has also grown in strength quite a bit, after all he is Megumin's sparring partner. Though he's more of a test dummy at this point for her since Porunga isn't capable of fighting Megumin equally.

"Alright, good work you two."

Hmm, I should probably let Rimuru know about Velzard's inevitable visit, the more time he has to prepare the better.

"I'm going to be visiting Tempest, though I don't plan on staying there so I shouldn't take too long."

"Yes Master, I shall inform the others." Said Raiden.

I nodded. I snapped my fingers and appeared in my residence at Tempest.

It seems Rimuru is in The Dungeon, normally I wouldn't be able to sense him as easily if he was in The Dungeon as The Dungeon itself is an entirely different Dimension, on top of that each Floor is a different Dimension as well. Thankfully Rimuru had Ramiris basically gave me Admin Access allowing me to freely teleport in, shift some floors around as well as visibly see what is going on inside The Dungeon without being there.

Ramiris' Small World is broken. It suits the name, it is basically a small world where Ramiris is god.

As I was walking to The Dungeon I took in the sights. Everyone was moving about setting up everything that is necessary for the festival. After all, it is going to start in a couple weeks. Multiple Monarchs will be attending so Tempest really needs to go all out.

Once I was in The Dungeon I sensed a disturbance from Floor 100. Is someone fighting Veldora?

Rimuru seems to be minding his own business on Floor 60 so it probably isn't a big deal, but I want to watch this fight anyways.

It's not every day that you get to see a True Dragon fighting after all.

Once I arrived at Floor 100 I started at Veldora's challenger in surprise.

Fucking Hinata is trying to take on a True Dragon?! I'd laugh if it wasn't so pitiful.

She was actually putting up a decent fight, though Veldora seems to be barely even trying.

Hinata might be the youngest Saint in history, even if only an Incomplete Saint. She even has a Hero's Egg but that isn't enough. Maybe once her Egg hatches.

Veldora wasn't even in his True Dragon form and he was still toying with Hinata with ease.

Still that didn't mean Hinata wasn't impressive, she was masterfully manipulating the Elementals she was contracted to. She had multiple Greater Elementals summoned and working with her.

The Greater Elemental of Earth War Gnome, the Greater Elemental of Fire Ifrit, The Greater Elemental of Space Aether, The Greater Elemental of Water Undine, and The Greater Elemental of Wind Sylphide.

Each Greater Elemental is around the Special-A Rank, for most Hinata's current lineup would be unbeatable.

Along with that Hinata was using her Holy Mail to temporarily elevate her flesh to the status of a Complete Saint.

Unfortunately for Hinata her Unique Skill: Usurper isn't going to help much against Veldora as the difference between them is far too vast, Veldora doesn't even need to use his Ultimate Skill.

"Hadoken! Hadoken! Hadoken!" Hinata actually had to take Veldora's casual attack incredibly seriously.

Man it's pretty boring watching these low level fights.

I wonder who this other bug is though?

I turned to the little Beetle that was watching the fight alongside me.

"And who are you?" I asked.

I could sense his Exoskeleton was partially made out of Rimuru's Slime body so he definitely wasn't an invader, I just haven't met him before.

"Greetings Lord Felix. The name bestowed upon me by My Lord is Zegion, it is an honor to meet one of Lord Rimuru's close friends." The Beetle sounded out.

"I see, it's nice to meet you as well Zegion." I responded. Though why is he watching this fight? Is he going to be a Monster in The Dungeon? Oh well, none of my business.

Though his armor is incredibly interesting.

'Answer. The Insect known as Zegion is part of a Species that possess the rare ability to Incarnate themselves in the Material World by automatically forming a body out of the surrounding Magicules and natural Elements. Their thick metallic exoskeletons are infused with metals that grant them a sturdy physical defense in addition to a strong resistance to magical attacks. Depending on the specific sub-species they might possess extraordinary abilities like high-speed flight or deadly venom, but even the weakest among their kind reach a solid B-rank. It is theoretically possible after evolution for their Exoskeleton to be made up of the Legendary Metal, Hihi'irokane.'

I could feel my eyes slightly widen as I heard what Odin said. Not only could they incarnate themselves but their Exoskeletons have the potential to reach the God Grade.

I definitely need to keep an eye on this Zegion, I'm curious as to how far he will grow.

Veldora yawned. "Are you done yet? I have some manga to catch up on."

Hinata's brows twitched. "Fine! I'll finish this with one strike then!"

I noticed Hinata begin to cast Disintegration, but rather than use it how it normally is she imbued it into her sword.

Is she going to pull an Artoria?! Now I'm interested.

Hinata then began charging at Veldora.

"Oh? You're approaching me? Instead of running away, you're coming closer to me?"

Did he just? Damn, all I can say is that it was clean.

"I can't beat the shit out of you without coming closer!" Hinata responds.

I can't tell if she has just been educated in meme culture or if she actually meant what she said.

Veldora seemed to become excited. "Oh! Then by all means come closer!"

"Melt Slash!" Yelled Hinata.

Hinata then struck him with her Disintegration imbued sword. I'm not quite sure why Veldora didn't avoid her attack, probably confidence in his own abilities.

And he would be right, Hinata's attack barely even scratched Veldora even though the strike itself was approaching the Speed of Light.

Still, the fact that Hinata scratched Veldora as a Saint is a feat on its own. That's actually fairly impressive, I can see why she is called a prodigy.

Veldora of course ignored his wound. "Haha, you'll have to try harder to take me down!" He boasted.

Hinata just sighed in resignation.

I choose this moment to appear. "Say what you will Veldora but it is quite impressive that she was even able to wound a True Dragon like you."

"Indeed! She has even learnt about The Sacred Texts!"

"The Sacred Texts?" Hinata asked confused.

Veldora nodded. "Yes! I understood the reference you made!"

"The reference?" Ah, she really didn't mean to make a reference huh? That's predictable but disappointing.

It seems Hinata has been doomed to being uncultured, what a sad sad life.

"Still, that was quite impressive Hinata. You might just have a shot at becoming someone noteworthy if you continue to improve."

I could tell my comment pissed Hinata off a bit, after all I was indirectly saying she didn't matter as she was now.

Fucking Primordials man.

Ah, he must be talking about one of the passive abilities of my new Intrinsic Skill: Ruler's Authority.

It has a passive effect of giving me a far more authoritative Aura. If I wish to make full use of it I can make it so that those weaker than me will be extremely intimidated by me, along with being extremely respectful.

Teaching Hinata is just a side hobby after all. Though I am curious about how my intervention in her journey as a Hero will affect things.

"Welcome back Master." I turned towards the voice and nodded.

"Hello Raiden, thanks for making sure everything was taken care of while I was away."

"It is my duty Master."

"Yes yes I know. I'll go pick up your weapon tomorrow, that's when Kurobe said it would be ready."

Raiden nodded. "I see, did you wish for me to come with you?"

"Very well Master."

Chapter 32: Against a True Dragon!
- Felix -

I entered Kurobe's smithy and was greeted by the sight of the Oni hammering away at a sword of some kind.

He paused for a second to take a look at me before saying, "Welcome Lord Felix! Let me finish this katana and then I will get you the weapon you commissioned."

I nodded and decided to look around at the new weapons Kurobe had made. He is always coming up with new things so it can be quite fun to see what new weapons he comes up with.

After looking around for a bit I came across a few strange weapons, the weapons had a hole in them, some even had multiple holes.

Next to the weapons I could also see a couple marbles that seemed to be imbued with the power of Elementals. Maybe Rimuru asked them to design this, it seems like something from a video game.

'Answer. After analysis it has been detected that it is possible to imbue the Magic Marbles into the weapons giving each weapon magical properties.'

Huh, so you can easily swap enchantments basically then. That's pretty cool, also quite convenient. If someone comes across an enemy that is weak to fire they can put in a Magic Marble that has been imbued with the power of a Fire Elemental, and vice versa for other weaknesses.

"Thank you for waiting Lord Felix!" I heard a voice sound out.

I turned around to see a slightly sweaty Kurobe.

"It's no problem, I got to see something quite interesting after all."

"Ah! Are you interested in the Slotted Equipment? They were Lord Rimuru's idea, he wanted to add something that can only be found in The Dungeon, so he asked us to make those." Kurobe said.

"I see." Rimuru probably got the idea from something in his previous life. Otherworlders really do have an advantage over those naturally born in this world, though that's obvious at this point.

I nodded.

Theoretically certain combinations of Magic Marbles can likely create far greater effects than expected.

'Correct. Theoretically combining two Fire Magic Marbles paired with a single Water Magic Marble can increase the effects by at least 10 times.'

Damn. For weaker people that sort of power is a tremendous difference. Kurobe really made something crazy huh?

He was right to be proud of it. This weapon was a bonafide Legend Grade weapon with the potential to become a God Grade.

It was capable of channelling Lightning masterfully, along with that it would bind to its wielder so it could be freely controlled by Raiden from range.

I can probably also transfer a bunch of information on Raiden Shogun's various sword arts so that my Raiden can recreate them, and possibly improve them.

I remember there was the Musou no Hitotachi, it can be used as an instantaneous series of slashes that erupt into a torrent of energy, or a single massive slash composed of lightning. I remember when the latter attack was used it split an entire island.

There was the Chakram Wave where she slashes the air and fires three large chakrams composed of electro energy, followed by a large electro wave.

I'm sure Raiden can get a decent bit stronger overall by mastering all the moves I'll share with her.

"Thank you Kurobe, I'm sure Raiden will love this."

Kurobe gave a humble bow. "It is my duty Lord Felix."

I just nodded, non humans are incredibly loyal to their namers once named. It's just a cultural thing in this world.

It can also be a bit problematic in my opinion, after all generally none of my subordinates ever really question me which can be bad on its own. After all, if I'm doing something stupid I'll never know if no one tells me.

Thankfully Odin can fulfill that role.

'Odin will always have the Master's best interests in mind.'

'Thanks! I'll be counting on you.'

Now where is Hinata? I want to beat her up some more, though I've been wanting a good fight. Fighting Guy was incredibly fun but I can't just go there whenever I want and ask for a fight.

Or maybe I can? Still it's probably best if I find someone else.

Maybe Veldora? The Dungeon should be able to handle the both of us going all out.

Maybe I'll ask him for a fight after sparring with Hinata.

Yes, that sounds good.

It seems some officials from the Holy Church have arrived at Tempest. I think those are some of the famed Crusaders, each said to be equal to a Demon Lord.

Hilarious. Even a Demon Lord Seed would wipe the floor with them, though from what I am seeing they do have potential, each of them are Enlightened which speaks for itself.

I gave them a nod causing them to sigh in relief.

I'm not that scary, right?

It isn't really wrong but I'm pretty sure she is taking this whole teacher student relationship far too seriously. Especially when she said she would kill me if I attacked Humanity.

Weird girl.

"Nothing much, I just felt the sudden urge to bea- I mean teach you." She definitely bought it if the way she is giving me a half lidded stare means anything.

Man I'm too good at this.

A Saint Wizard huh? Humans have many classifications for Magic users.

Sorcerers are those who specialize in Elemental Magic, Shaman are those who specialize in Spirit Magic, Maya are those that specialize in Illusion Magic, Enchanters specialize in Engraving Magic and imbue special effects into items. Priests are those that use Holy Magic, priests generally fill the support category. Summoners are those that use Summoning Magic. Elementalers or Elementalists are those that utilize both Spirit Magic and Summoning Magic to summon contracted Elementals.

Then we have the truly impressive classes.

Magicians are those who have learned and can well utilize at least two different types of Magics. Wizards are those that have mastered three or more different types of Magics. And then Leonard's class, Saint Wizard is for those that have mastered Holy Magic, an impressive feat as the higher levels of Holy Magic require tremendous amounts of faith.

"Well met Leonard. It's good Hinata has a reliable subordinate like you, to be blessed by an Elemental of Light must mean you have a pure heart. An Enlightened of your caliber is welcome in practically any Nation." I praise.

Hinata looked at me in surprise. Heh, I can be nice too.

"Ah, thank you for your praise Lord Felix." He bowed again and stepped aside.

"Lord Felix, this one's name is Bacchus, one of the Captains of the Crusaders." Short and straight to the point huh?

He was blessed by an Earth Elemental.

I gave him a nod. "Hello Bacchus."

I can already do that with Ouroboros but I'm not going to say no to a free Skill.

Suphia gave me a look, seemingly wanting to ask if she can go hang out with her former co-workers.

I gave her a nod causing a happy grin to spread on her face.

While those three were catching up Carrion and I caught up.

I haven't directly seen him ever since he officially swore his loyalty to me after all, though we have sent some subordinates back and forth along with using Thought Communication.

"You've gotten a bit stronger huh Carrion?"

"Ghaha, and yet I still feel like a drop in the ocean compared to you!" He said boisterously.

I rolled my eyes. "You need more than just training if you even want to approach my level."

"Heh, I can see that. Wanna have a spar later Boss?" Asked Carrion.

Hmm, if he keeps facing me, someone who is a lot stronger than him, he won't be able to improve nearly as much.

"Hmm, tell you what, you can fight against one of my direct subordinates. You will probably learn far more from a fight with her than with me."

I think Carrion facing Raiden would be good for both parties. Raiden is far, far stronger overall but she can practice her swordsmanship and Carrion can use the fights to grow.

Him being stronger only helps me after all so no reason to prevent his growth.

"Alright Boss, you're the strong one so I'll listen to you."

Ah, Lycanthropes are so simple, I like that about them. Just be stronger than them and they will do whatever you tell them.

I looked around, it seems we're all ready.

"Alright everyone ready then?"

Once I got nods from everyone I snapped my fingers teleporting all of us to Tempest.

This time I teleported all of us directly into Rimuru's office so it was a bit crowded.

"Gah! Felix!" Rimuru shouted.

"Sup, we all came a bit early for the Festival."

The Festival itself was going to go on for a week or so, so it isn't a big deal that we came a few hours early.

"You didn't have to teleport directly to my office though! I can already sense Shuna on her way due to all the strong Auras that appeared."

"Ah, oops. Sorry about that." I apologized.

Rimuru sighed. "It's fine." I felt Rimuru send a Thought Communication, likely calming everyone down.

"Haha, I knew you would be okay with it Rimuru!" Shouted an overeager Milim.

Rimuru sighed again but this time it was incredibly depressing. "Please don't be… yourself at this Festival Milim." He said.

Milim looked confused. "Eh? What do you mean?"

I decided to ease her into the explanation. "I think what Rimuru is trying to say is don't cause trouble, this event is important for Tempest and Rimuru's dream, we don't want to mess it up by accidentally killing someone important."

Milim nodded in understanding. "Yup! You're right Felix! I don't want to ruin my friend's dream!"

Heh, Milim might be some evil Demon Lord to others but she is a loyal friend above everything else.

"Don't worry Rimuru, everything will be fine."

"Indeed there is no need to worry Demon Lord Rimuru. I will make sure to keep Milim under control." Said Frey.

Heh, imagine having a handler because you can't control yourself.

"I can control myself Frey!" Milim pouted.

Rimuru nodded. "I'll trust you then Frey. Ah, while you're here I wanted to discuss the rebuilding of the Harpy Kingdom." That's right, Rimuru and Frey did have some kind of alliance going huh?

Frey nodded. "Very well."

I choose this time to jump in. "You two can do that in private, I'll make sure to keep Milim under control."

"You too Felix?!" Yelled Milim.

We all just ignored her though. "Alright thanks Felix!" Said Rimuru.

"I will make sure not to take too long Felix." I waved Frey off.

"Take your time, we're just going to go mess around." Hearing me a grin crept up onto Milim's face.

"...messing around?" Rimuru whispered, fear evident in his tone.

Eh it can't be that bad right?

"Please just don't go around mugging my citizens for your own amusement."

I snorted after hearing him. "But that was funny! The look on Gobta's face was priceless, I'm sure he's always got his guard up now."

Rimuru smiled slightly. "Hehe, yup. Even Hakurou has increased his training so he doesn't get mugged again."

Hehe, sucks to suck huh Gobta?

"I'll make sure we don't do anything too crazy."

"Ah, is that a new subordinate of yours?" Asked Rimuru who was looking at Sukuna.

I nodded. "Yup, I wanted a butler. This here is Sukuna, my very own Diablo!"

Sukuna gave Rimuru a bow. "It is a pleasure to meet you Lord Rimuru."

Rimuru nodded. "It is nice to meet you as well Sukuna."

I turned to the rest of our large group. "Alright, let's go!"

Once we were outside the building where Rimuru's office was located I turned to Carrion and his group.

"Alright, feel free to wander around, just don't cause trouble." I ordered.

Carrion saluted me. "You got it Boss!"

I turned to Suphia. "You can go with them."

She gave me a grin and ran to catch up to them. "Thanks Boss!" I heard her yell as she was getting further and further away.

Now for my group.

"You guys can also do whatever you want, just don't cause trouble."

Saeko was the first to speak up. "Is it fine if I visit some of the Onis?" Ah she probably wants to see her old friends huh?

Ah, I haven't told her that Ponytail is going to be here have I? I told her he was alive, after all she has the right to know that but she doesn't know that he is going to be coming here.

He was like an older brother to her so I guess it can be a surprise for her.

I nodded. "Sure."

Once Saeko was off Raiden said, "I would like to stay with you Master."

I don't have any problems with free eye candy! I can also drag Raiden around so she can have some fun for once.

"Alright that's fine."

Arcueid, Megumin, and Lalatina were discussing something. Once they noticed my attention was on them Arcueid took the lead.

"My Lord, the three of us would like to visit this Dungeon you have spoken to us about."

Ah, they are totally going to fight each other huh?

"Alright, just make sure not to kill too many Monsters, those are needed for the demonstration later on in The Festival."

Even though there are hundreds of thousands of Monsters inhabiting The Dungeon I don't doubt they could easily clear the entire thing, except for Veldora of course.

Zegion has the potential to match them eventually, but as he is now, not a chance.

The three of them nodded.

"Got it Master!" Said Lalatina.

With that I teleported them directly into The Dungeon. I'm sure they can figure everything out. They are millions of years old Primordials after all.

"I would like to accompany you with Raiden Master." Said Kurumi.

I nodded. "Alright, that's fine with me."

I looked to Sukuna. "And you Sukuna."

"I wish to secure the area in case there is an attack on your person My Lord." I'm pretty sure I'm safe in Tempest but being careful couldn't hurt.

I nodded. "Very well."

I turned to the last two. "What about you Ingvild, Glenda?"

Ingvild is the one who responded. "Glenda heard about all the good food we tried here on our d-date and she wanted to try it so I'll show her around."

I nodded. "Alright have fun you two." I waved them off.

Though Glenda had a shit eating grin for some reason while Ingvild had a tiny almost unnoticeable blush.

Then it is just Raiden, Kurumi, and Milim with me huh?

I could sense a bunch of new attractions that weren't here the last time I came to Tempest.

- Rimuru Tempest -

Rimuru looked towards the seductive Sky Queen as she apologized for her delay.

"Thank you for inviting us to this Festival, I apologize that we had shown up unannounced but Milim was adamant about attending with her Best Friend." Aha, Milim is even causing trouble for Frey huh?

Somehow Felix is the only one who she doesn't really cause trouble for, though that's probably because they both cause trouble together for others.

"Ah, hahaha, don't worry about that Frey, just enjoy the next few days free of hassle. Felix might not look it, but he can control Milim very well."

Frey nodded. "Indeed, it is quite remarkable that those two get along so well. If only they didn't cause so much trouble."

Frey went on to explain that whenever Felix shows up he kidnaps Milim, giving both Frey and Arc a heart attack.

Haha, Felix really isn't making it easy for them huh?

"Ahh by the way I didn't have the chance to ask before but we have a multitude of dishes made. One in particular is made of bird, will that be a problem?"

For some reason Frey seems to be angry. Did he say something wrong?

"Eh? Are you putting me on the same level as a bird Rimuru?" Frey asked with a polite smile on her face. But for some reason he felt that smile was anything but polite.

"Th-That isn't what I meant Frey!"

She giggled. "Ara, I know, I was just teasing you."

Grr, damn seductress!
