Damn it. This is different from Mahito's bullshit, I just needed to restore the Soul to its natural shape. I'm not capable of healing souls outright. I would need some sort of Reality Manipulation to fix this, and even then it would be iffy. Saeko's Cook definitely isn't enough, it just doesn't have enough conceptual oomph.

All of a sudden a white glow caught my attention. I turned to look at who the glow was emanating from.

Chloe?

Fuck.

- Rimuru Tempest -

- Luminous Valentine -

Luminous made her way to her hidden sanctum which only her closest subordinates knew about. She needed some time to think and ponder on everything she had learned recently.

She had only left Tempest hours ago, she felt she had seen more than enough, she stayed for the main portion of the Festival at the very least. The continuing days were just going to be repeats of everything that occurred earlier on in the Festival.

She had made sure to check on the Church Branch that was in Tempest, everything was up to her standards, and she had some of Hinata's best subordinates staying there, each member of the Ten Great Saints had the potential to Awaken and become a Saint, two of them already had Awakened, Hinata and Saare.

She was quite surprised by everything she had learned from her visit to Tempest. The sheer technological advancements that Tempest had made in such a short period of time, was incredible, even the musical advancements they made were incredibly impressive.

There were many Vampires who enjoyed music, her included, the issue was that with immortality came a halt of progress, practically no progress has been made in the last five hundred years when it comes to music. No new innovation, no new inspiration, nothing.

She was quite put off by it but didn't push as inspiration and improvement is not something that can usually be forced, at least not for truly good things.

But once she had attended the concert in Tempest her mind was blown. She would need to get Rimuru to have some of his musicians come and teach her own.

Both were incredibly annoying, Felix more than Rimuru, but in the end she was thankful for them, as without those two she would not have met either of her friends.

They both had important roles to play in those two's lives after all.

She even initially formed the Western Holy Church to give the future Hinata a place to come to.

Luminous had come out of her centuries long isolation and attended the Walpurgis just to finally meet those two and gain some sort of understanding about them.

Both of them were incredibly powerful, far more powerful than a mere Slime and a Daemon like Felix had any right to be. Each was an Awakened Demon Lord that even she was unable to see through.

She was millenia old and yet she would have to take them extremely seriously should a fight happen, or else she would die.

Her first meeting with Chronoa was quite the odd one.

But she had won her trust when she had predicted Veldora's attack, though she still lost her most beloved palace Night Rose to the Evil Lizard. She understood why neither Chloe nor Hinata had helped her fight the True Dragon off back then, they were adamant of keeping things exactly the same so that they would return to the same future they left.

She slowly made her way to the deepest level of her sanctum, where no one but her and her closest subordinates, were allowed. Even Hinata was unaware of what lay within, though Luminous could tell Hinata was suspicious.

An enchanting smile hung on her face as she observed the nude figure within. She had spent countless hours just watching and caressing the coffin, even ignoring the severe burns that she would acquire.

The coffin was created through pure Spiritron Manipulation, it was infused with so much Holy Power that even an Awakened Demon Lord like her was still burned to the touch. Even with her full power she was incapable of breaching the coffin forcefully.

"Damn it! What has that Slime and Daemon been doing!?"

She quickly snapped her fingers causing her normal royal garbs to appear on her.

"Louis! Gunther!" She called.

Louis and Gunter were the only two who knew about this location and just who was sealed in the coffin. Her two most loyal and powerful subordinates. Especially now that Roy's power had rejoined with his twin, Louis was a force to be reckoned with.

"Yes My Lady?" Came Gunther with Louis following close behind.

"Come, we will be leaving, it seems our dear Hinata has had some… complications."

Over time a bond between her and Hinata had formed, and while weak it allowed them both to get subtle feelings from the other. In fact she was fairly certain Hinata knew of her attraction to her.

Luminous already knew what had most likely happened, though she hoped she was wrong. She did not know what she would do if Hinata was truly… dead.

- Felix -

"Felix! Could you please control your Haki! I'm not sure how much longer I can contain it!"

I sighed and forcefully calmed myself down. Hinata was not technically dead. I forcefully reigned in my Demon Lord's Haki and got it under control. Some Skills react intensely to emotional stimuli, Haki especially reacts to emotional stimuli.

I heard Rimuru give off a loud sigh once my Haki was no longer pressuring him.

"Sorry about that."
"It's fine Felix, I can understand why that happened." Said Rimuru.

Fuck. I hate Time bullshit. Still, my shoulders sagged hearing Odin. If Hinata's soul is tagging along with Chloe as a passenger, then that means Hinata was still technically alive, if only as a passenger of Chloe's.

I have no clue what sort of effects binding oneself to a Unique Skill could have, the closest approximation to that would be the Sin Series, each of them sort of have wills of their own.

But even then Hinata's current situation is different. For one will her Soul heal over time now that there are no Spiritrons actively trying to corrupt her Soul?

Who knows what sort of situation those two have appeared in.

Still, it's best I focus on things I can actually have a chance of affecting.

Still I'm just surprised that it is possible to pass on Skills. Hinata must really believe in Chloe if she was willing to pass on one of her Unique Skills.

The only issue is that I don't know if those two were sent to the past or the future. If they were sent to the past I'll have a far easier time finding them as long as they have survived to this day. If they were sent to the future however… well it'll be far more difficult.

"Do you know what just happened Felix?" Asked Rimuru.

Before I could answer I felt three presences teleport very close by, one of them was very recognizable.

"I'll explain everything to everyone, I don't want to repeat myself."
Rimuru nodded as he stared in the direction Luminous had appeared from. Rimuru snapped his fingers and dispelled the Barrier he seemed to have created to contain my Haki.

That was a good move, who knows how much damage my Haki could have done when let loose.

Normally I can just focus my Haki to a certain area so I don't cause too much damage. I guess Hinata mattered more to me than a simple test subject. Our relationship may have started absolutely horribly, and I even started teaching her as an experiment of sorts, but she's grown on me.

Like a fungus that absolutely refuses to leave.

The Clown was still bound by Fixation, I'm not a raging beast, it would be idiotic to kill the Clown when he is our only source of information along with Mariabell.

I just wanted to… hurt him a bit, no biggie. I extended my hand to the God Grade sword that was lying on the ground next to the Clown. I didn't even bother with it at first, far too angry at the Clown.

The sword floated towards me, once it was in my hand I could feel it accept me as its master. God Grade Equipment often had a will of their own and would reject those they found unworthy.

This one seems to have been actually forged rather than created with Material Creation as well. Not just anyone can afford to just hand out this kind of weapon to a subordinate.

I have no doubt that the Clown was just loaned this weapon, I'm sure there is someone pulling his strings in the background.

There is no way it is a coincidence that Hinata was attacked at the same time Tempest was… no this was planned.

'Notice. It has been detected that the Sword has the Anti-Skill Attribute.'

'What?!'

'The weapon has a weaker Anti-Skill Attribute than the individual Yuuki Kagurazaka, and it has been detected that the weapon is likely made out of Human bones. The body often reflects the Spirit, and so the Anti-Skill Attribute was somewhat engraved onto Yuuki's Physical Body. The weapon is capable of cutting through any emission attack from Magic or Unique Skills, however it will have a harder time dealing with an Ultimate Skill, but it is still possible.'

I could feel my fists clenching. I was no fool, a weapon made out of Human bones with the Anti-Skill Attribute, something that is imbued within Yuuki's Spiritual Constitution. No, I could reach the most likely conclusion quite easily.

Yuuki is involved in this somehow. How many others were there with Anti-Skill after all?

I had The Dungeon try and analyze him but I didn't get much new data, I already knew about Anti-Skill, and Small World was never meant to gather data on what Skills someone has by deep diving into someone's soul.

Perhaps if Yuuki demonstrated his Unique Skill that would be different, but he didn't do that is still a mystery.

Either way, even if he wasn't involved in Saeko's death, which is highly unlikely with all this information, he will still cease to exist for this, his Soul and all.

Looking back at everything it does make sense. Footman and Tear said themselves that they were mercenaries, they were hoping to deal with me so that Tempest would have less protection at the time.

Shortly after that, Tempest was attacked.

And then another similarly dressed Clown is once again involved in some sort of plot?

If they were hired by Yuuki, or maybe even his subordinates, it would all line up. It's possible that Yuuki incited Clayman as well.

I still need more information.

I would have to pick Mariabell's brain later. I'm sure she can be… convinced.

"Felix, are you alright?" Asked a concerned Rimuru.

I shook my head. "I'll tell you later." It's best that we focus on Luminous right now.

Yuuki may not know it, but he was living on borrowed time.

"Damn it! What has happened to Hinata!" I turned towards the voice. Luminous had arrived along with two of her subordinates. One was someone I knew of, Louis the Pope of Luminism. While the other was dressed in a suit and tie, he dressed fairly similarly to Sukuna and Diablo, I think it would be a fair assumption to think he is Luminous' butler.

Both were fairly strong too.

Both of their Existence Points are at around 1,000,000, they were about as strong as an Awakened Demon Lord and a Saint.

Quite the impressive subordinates Luminous has acquired under her, both are Vampires as well.

Luminous' gaze snapped to me and then to Rimuru. She quickly stood by my side.

"What happened?!" She asked.

"She was attacked." I responded.

"Of course I can see that! But how did this happen!? With all of your powerful subordinates, with all of your so-called security." Demanded Luminous.

Rimuru is the one that answered her this time. "Tempest was attacked, while my subordinates and I were handling that someone managed to infiltrate and teleport Hinata and Chloe to a discrete battlefield that was prepared beforehand. The Barrier helped isolate any sign of the fight making it hard to send help."

"Chloe?!" Shouted Luminous.

Rimuru looked at her with confusion. "Yes?"

Luminous sighed aggressively. "I… see. Damn it! There really was nothing that could have been done!?" Luminous seems awfully accepting. I would have imagined she would have declared war or something for Hinata "dying" in Rimuru's territory when she is basically a foreign dignitary.

Though I could tell from her clenched fists that internally Luminous was raging.

"Damn it, I have to try something!" Luminous said as she raised her hands and aimed them towards Hinata's body.

Luminous cast all sorts of Holy Spells, resulting in Hinata's body being healed back to peak perfect condition.

Even the Miracle Class Holy Magic wasn't working, which was what I expected. Hinata's issue wasn't her body, it was her Soul.

Luminous even casted a Resurrection Spell which practically evaporated midair.

"She hasn't been gone for long! Why isn't it!"

Hinata's body may have been present, but her Soul was no longer present.

"DAMN IT." Luminous gaze immediately snapped to the Clown still frozen in my Fixation.

"He is the one responsible, is he not!?" Questioned Luminous.

I sighed but nodded. "Don't do anything drastic Luminous." I told Luminous.

Luminous ignored my words and approached the Clown, her Demon Lord's Haki focusing on the Clown.

Of course the Clown was immobile, he could not do anything to defend himself.

Just before Luminous was about to touch the Clown, and likely drain him of his vitality I appeared and grabbed her arm.

Both of her subordinates appeared next to me to defend their mistress. I just ignored their attacks and let Infinity deal with them. I wouldn't blame Luminous for acting out a bit, she did just "lose" someone close to her.

"Don't do that Luminous. He is one of our only sources of information right now. And besides, Hinata is not gone."

If I didn't know that there was a chance to meet Hinata again I don't know what my emotional state would be like, I would probably be just like Luminous, wanting to get my revenge on the Clown.

Now I can think things through more rationally.

"I know she is not gone!"

What? How could Luminous know that? …Unless?

- Luminous Valentine -

As Felix held har arm, preventing her from draining the Clown's vitality she thought back on everything.

Luminous felt powerless, her beloved Hinata laid dead, and she was unable to do anything. For all her power, all her status she was helpless.

The only moment comparable was being helpless to defend her old kingdom when Veldora went and destroyed it, no matter how hard she tried to distract the True Dragon, he had just brushed her off, as if she were a bug.

That day is when she truly understood how powerless she was in front of the truly mighty.

She had never felt as helpless as she had back then, until now.

Confirmed. Conditions satisfied. The Unique Skill: Lust has evolved into the Ultimate Skill: Asmodeus, Lord of Lust.

Once the Voice of the World's voice resounded in her ears she could feel her power soar to new heights. Heights she couldn't have even dreamed of previously.

She could feel a new power forming in the core of her being.

Is this the power that individuals like Guy Crimson and the True Dragons have? Is this how they maintain their superiority?

She felt like a true Goddess.

Could… could this be enough? Could this revive Hinata?

She knew it was a fruitless endeavor, but she had to try.

She noticed Felix had loosened his grip on her arm and was looking at her with surprise.

"So you got one too now huh?" He muttered.

She looked to Louis and Gunther. "That is enough you two. You two are incapable of harming someone on Felix's level, so stop trying."

Both of them stopped sending fruitless attacks Felix's way. That stupid Barrier of his wouldn't even let their attacks hit him.

With her new Ultimate Skill she could command the passage of Life and Death as well as view and manipulate the lifeforce of others. Even the Soul was under her dominion.

Though her Skill was more focused on the aspect of Life.

Louis and Gunther were each incredibly powerful, but when compared to Rimuru their lifeforce was practically a small fire whereas Rimuru's was a blazing sun. And then when comparing Rimuru's to Felix's the difference was just as vast.

Felix was still more powerful than her, even with her new power, she was still below him, she could feel it.

Just how long would she be helpless to those stronger than her!?
Luminous walked to where Hinata's body lay with Felix following behind her.

She raised her hands to the sky, and commanded Hinata's Soul to return to her body.

The Art Re-Birth utilized one of Asmodeus' sub-skills, Life Domination to resurrect the dead.

She waited, and waited, and waited.

Nothing happened.

She felt a hand on her shoulder.

"There is no point Luminous, you should know that." Said Felix.

She knew that, Hinata's Soul was gone now, Hinata was in the past now.

But still, hearing Felix she snapped. "THEN WHAT IS THE POINT?! This new power of mine was not useful when it was needed most! Then why did I acquire this power in the first place!" She yelled, her heterochromatic red and blue eyes glowing in anger and despair.

She had no clue if when Chronoa was unsealed, if it would truly be Hinata and Chloe piloting the body, or if it would be the berserker Chronoa.

This was her best and only chance at reviving at least Hinata rather than risking it all in a gambit.

Now, that was her only choice.

"You finally got that off of your chest?" Asked Felix with a nonchalant smile.

She did not know why he was acting like it was no big deal, as far as he should know, Hinata was dead.

The present Hinata had never told her she was learning under Felix, but the one that was sent to the past had told her. Over the centuries they had grown incredibly close, so Luminous knew quite well how Hinata felt about Felix and what they had gotten up to.

For Felix to take this all as a joke, it infuriated her.

Before she could rip into him Felix opened his mouth. "Now why don't we talk about how we can save Hinata and Chloe."

" "What?" " Both she and Rimuru said at the same time.

Chapter 43: Back To the Past! Part 1

- Felix -

"Now, why don't we talk about how we can save Hinata and Chloe."

" "What?" " Both Luminous and Rimuru said at the same time.

Those subordinates of Luminous finally stopped with their pointless attacks on me. If it was in any other situation, I would have purged them for the slight.

They're lucky none of my subordinates were around.

Still, to think Luminous would evolve her Unique Skill: Lust, into an Ultimate Skill.

I got a once in a lifetime chance to observe the change happening in Luminous' Soul.

The Ultimate Skill: Asmodeus, Lord of Lust, basically just gave Luminous control over Life and Death, though it leaned more towards the Life aspect.

It allowed the user to manipulate the Infons of the Soul to an extremely high degree.

An incredibly powerful Ultimate Skill.

That's another Sin Series Skill reaching its full potential. It's a shame that Greed will never reach that level, at least not with Mariabell as its host.

I even got to analyze Asmodeus, Lord of Lust, when Luminous tried to use it to resurrect Hinata.

"By now, you should know what just happened, right Luminous?"

Rimuru was looking at the both of us in confusion. While Luminous was glaring at me.

If my guess was right, then Luminous should at least be aware of what just happened.

Earlier, when I told Luminous that Hinata was not truly gone, she said that she knew. Now, how could she possibly know something like that when she was not even present to see what had happened?

Sure she may have some absurd analysis Skill, but I know she doesn't. Maybe she recognized that Time shenanigans took place here, she is extremely old after all, but even then she would not say what she had with such confidence if she just had a suspicion.

No, she knew with complete certainty that Hinata was technically still alive, or at least she was not dead at the present moment.

The only way for her to think that is if she knew what truly happened, that Hinata and Chloe were transported through Time.

And for Luminous to know, then that means that Chloe and Hinata must have been transported to the past and formed some kind of relationship with Luminous.

Still, going by how desperate Luminous was to bring Hinata back, even knowing what truly occurred, tells me that something had happened leaving Hinata's fate uncertain.

Luminous glare finally gave way to annoyance. "Fine. I will explain everything to the both of you."

Atta girl.

- Hinata Sakaguchi -

Hinata felt extremely groggy, as if she was waking up from a nap that had lasted many years.

Her memories flashed, from her happy childhood years to her struggle-filled teenage years.

Back when she was just a normal kid who craved their parents' praise, to when she murdered her own father.

Her father's company had gone bankrupt, so he went gambling and put their family into debt. Even to this day, she hated that man for breaking up her perfect family.

She had always wondered if that sin that she carried was the reason she had never Awakened into a True Hero. Perhaps she couldn't forgive herself, even if she felt what she had done was justified.

Murdering one's own kin was not a light crime.

Perhaps that burden would always be carried within her. She knew that even if she returned to her original world, she would not be welcomed; her mother would not greet her with a hug.

Perhaps that is why she wanted to pursue justice in this new world.

In fact, she had felt that weight in her heart for a long, long time. It wasn't until she met Felix, and by extension, Rimuru, that that weight lightened.

Perhaps Felix's company had lightened that weight. At first, she saw him as a simple means to an end. She would have to be a fool not to accept the no-strings-attached offer that Felix had given her.

Training from a Demon Lord was something many Majin would do anything for. Even some Humans would desperately seek such a thing.

She had planned to quickly learn everything the Demon Lord was willing to teach and then move on.

She had not expected it to be so incredibly difficult, however.

She had learned many things under Felix's tutelage, but she was still far behind him, even she could see that.

So she trained, and trained, and trained.

Over that period of time, she slowly found herself becoming fond of Felix and Rimuru due to their continued interactions.

It may be due to her knowing of their previous lives as Humans that she saw them as different from the rest, even she herself did not know. But she grew closer to them all the same.

Perhaps, in another life, her and Felix could have become something more. She could have seen their relationship going in that direction if the stars had aligned.

Though that was probably due to his playboy nature.

His personality may have been annoying, and he was extremely arrogant, self centered, and an irredeemable playboy. But she knew he cared for her in his own way. He cared for those around him, she could see it in his actions.

When he would pause their training sessions to pick up flowers for one of his lovers, or when he would help Rimuru out with simple tasks, seeking to help take some of the load off his friend's back.

He was full of flaws, as all Humans were, but he had his good side.

Perhaps if she had encountered him during his tenure as an Adventurer that he had mentioned, then things could have been different.

Her most recent memories flashed in her head.

It was too late to change anything at this point. She felt like just falling asleep as she continued to fall into this mysterious void.

"Don't leave me now Hinata-nee!"

All of a sudden complete awareness came back to Hinata.

'Chloe?!'

She quickly came back to reality. She could not see anything, she was practically completely blind.

"Use your heart to see Hinata!"

Her heart?

She focused on sensing the outside world, it took her a few moments before she could truly see what was happening, not through her eyes but through her heart. She was in an incredibly dark area, with a light in front of her.

'Where am I?'

"You are inside of me!'

'Inside of you?'

Did she not die? She was stabbed by a dagger coated with Spiritrons, it was practically a miniature Disintegration.

She should have been completely erased.

Even when using her Unique Skill: Mathematician she could not come up with an explanation. In fact she was surprised she could even use her Skill in this kind of situation.

Felix had said that Skills were truly one of the most fascinating things in the universe, and now she could sort of see why he thought like that.

Truly how mysterious.

'I'll explain everything to you once you are stabilized. Do you see that white light? Walk into it.'

Hinata heeded Chloe's words and did as she said. She felt like she was moving her physical body even though she knew she did not possess one.

The moment she came into contact with the light, she felt everything change. She felt far more… stable.

"There we go, that's better. Do you feel better now?"

'Ugh, yes. Now could you explain everything to me?'

"Yes. Now listen here Hinata-nee. Right now you are basically inside of my soul, you were very close to being devoured by my Infinity Prison, but you are safe for now. You don't have a body anymore obviously and will be far more limited with your actions. I know this is something new for you but please don't do anything drastic."

Infinity Prison? That must have been the bottom of the darkness she was falling through.

'What do you think of me? Of course, I won't do anything drastic that might endanger you.'

"Aha, that's good. I was just making sure."

'Thank you for waking me up.'

"Hehe, no problem Hinata-nee!"

'But how did my Soul end up in yours?'

"Funny thing that. When you tried to pass on your Skill, your Soul sort of attached to it, so your Soul came along for the journey and ended up residing in my Soul, your Soul itself was injured but since the Spiritrons that were inside of you were left behind I was able to slowly heal you over a long period of time."

'If you inherited my Skill, then how am I able to use it?'

"Because I resisted it, if I fully inherited the Skill who knows what would have happened to your Soul. Now you still have your Skills and your Soul is safe inside of me."

'I see. You really saved me huh Chloe?'

"Of course! You believed that I could be a Hero, so of course I would save you!"

'I see… I see.'

'If we are both still alive, then what is happening in the real world? Was the Clown dealt with? What about the attack on Tempest?'

'Uhm, I don't know. I imagine with Felix-nii and Rimuru everything went fine.'

Hinata thought it was quite odd that Chloe removed the honorifics from Rimuru's name, she always used to call him Rimuru-sensei. She also never used to call Felix, Felix-nii.

But she ignored that and focused on what Chloe had said.

'You don't know.'

"Listen carefully, I don't know how to say this but… we are in the past. We are in the far far past, long before both Rimuru and Felix-nii show up."

'The past?! Time travel!?'

"Yes." Chloe then directed her spiritual vision in a certain direction. "Can you see that mountain?"

'Is that!?'

"Yup, it's Mount Liora."

'We truly are in the distant past then.' This entire area was considered a Holy Land back in the present time. There used to be a city here.

Luminous would move her center of power to this location in the future after Veldora destroys her original Kingdom.

"When I was originally sent back in time, I was just outside the Jura Forest. Whenever I travel back in Time, I end up staying in the same physical location."

'Then why are we here?'

"Uhm, because this isn't my first time in the past. I am just following the same path I took to reach the same ideal future that we had left from."

'What?!'

"When Rimuru took us to the Dwelling of the Spirits to contract with Elementals to save our lives, I awakened my innate power of Time Traveler. The Elemental that Blessed me was no normal Spirit, it was my power from the future. I can't consciously activate Time Traveler either as some sort of condition needs to be fulfilled for it to be used. I think I keep failing in the future, so my power keeps coming back to me in the past."

'So you've had your memories this whole time?'

"Normally no. I usually only regain my memories when I am sent back in time. This time however was different, I do not know what caused this miracle, but this time I regained parts of my memories at the Dwelling of the Spirits. Using this knowledge, I was able to lead things to a better situation than normal."

'...So you have been doing the same things over and over again?'

"Until this loop, I was yes."

Hinata did not know how to respond to that. Such a fate was incredibly cruel.

'I… I'm sorry you had to suffer through that Chloe.'

"It's okay! If I can save Rimuru and everyone else in one of these loops then it will all have been worth it!"

Hinata did not miss the affection in Chloe's voice when she spoke about Rimuru. She could tell, Chloe Aubert was in love with Rimuru Tempest.

'What did you mean by saying a better situation earlier?'

"Umu! Normally, Rimuru does not become a Demon Lord. Usually, you do not confront him during the Falmuth Invasion as he would be long gone by then, and so he reaches Tempest on time and quickly defends Tempest and kicks all the invaders out. Thanks to this he has no reason to become a True Demon Lord." She began, focusing for a few moments to make sure she remembered everything correctly.

"Felix also does not become a True Demon Lord at this point, though he does join the council as he confronts Clayman and his army. But from what Felix-nii told me, he did not kill the entire army like he did in the most recent timeline, he challenged Clayman to a fight, and Clayman's arrogance worked against him. He lost the fight and so Felix inherited his position."

'I see, so events were different huh? But I don't see what the issue is?'

Since Chloe had been continuing to try and change things, and the only future that she was happy with was the one where Rimuru and Felix became True Demon Lords, then something must have gone differently later on.

"Rimuru would save Tempest and slowly build relations with the rest of the world. Even you Hinata-nee would become one of his allies later on. You and Felix-nii had a weird relationship too, you seemed awfully close."

'Weird relationship?'

"Hehe, yes! Rimuru kept calling Felix-nii a lucky bastard for scoring a beauty like you or something, so maybe you two were together in that timeline? I don't know, I never bothered to ask."

'T-together?!' Hinata was sure that if she had a body, her cheeks would be glowing.

"Yup. Anyways everything was going fine for 5 years, we all trained together and grew stronger. Felix-nii would stop by and teach us things from time to time. We even went for a field trip to his territory! But the good times did not last, the Eastern Empire attacked. Rimuru ended up dying and Veldora was unleashed. Felix-nii also went on a rampage and ascended into a True Demon Lord. He ended up Summoning a Daemon, a Primordial at that. The Primordial of Yellow, Jaune."

'Megumin?!'

"That is what she was called in this iteration, but back then… back then I remember Felix-nii's words. He said he wanted the Eastern Empire to suffer, to feel despair. And so he told Jaune that she would be his bringer of Despair, his Aponoia. With Jaune named, he unleashed her on the enemy forces."

Hinata was sure the Eastern Empire was not in for a good time. She had met Megumin, and one thing she knew was that she loved to cause destruction and chaos.

"Veldora, Felix-nii, and Jaune killed over one million Humans in total. The Eastern Empire's Army was decimated."

'One million!?'

"I remember that day clearly even now. I begged Rimuru not to go, but he wouldn't listen. He passed on the mask to me and left and never returned."

Hinata took a moment to digest all that. To think one event going differently could lead to such a drastically different future.

"However Veldora was in a berserk state, he could not differentiate between friend or foe, and so he was attacking Tempest as well as the Eastern Empire's forces. The newly ascended Felix-nii was fighting him off, Luminous, you, and I as well as Rimuru and Felix-nii's subordinates were also there, helping to mitigate the damage."

'Felix was that strong even after just awakening?!'

To be able to take on a True Dragon right after Awakening was incredible.

"Yes, he did not even go into a slumber after his Awakening, he seemed to have immediately brought his power under his complete control and seemed to have perfect mastery of his Skills almost immediately, so he was able to lead Veldora away before a significant amount of damage was done to Tempest and its people."

'I see.'

"However, in the midst of the fight, you died. I only saw a flash of light, and then my ability activated, sending me back in time."

'After seeing me die?'

"Yes. It seems that the condition to activate my Time Leap is to see you die."

Hinata did not know how to feel about that, to think that she had died in every single one of Chloe's loops.

That was just… unnerving.

"I don't know what had happened after your death, but I imagine Felix-nii went on a rampage. Most of the loops go in a similar fashion. But this time was different, in every single one of my loops, Rimuru had been dead before Time Leap activated, this time he was alive and Awakened along with Felix-nii! If Felix-nii Awakened the same power as he always does then I am confident nothing will happen to everyone else!"

'Why are you so confident that Felix can protect Rimuru and Tempest?'

"Hehe, I've known everyone for a very long time. If you add up all my years, in some of my memories, I got to see a close-up view of Felix going all out after Awakening and battling Veldora. Someone as strong as that… should be capable of almost anything."

'I see.'

Felix was a monster even to Chloe's eyes, huh?

"Not to mention his subordinates this time around. Three of the Primordial Daemons, his other subordinates are extremely powerful as well. Not to mention Rimuru's subordinates! Normally, they wouldn't be half as strong as they are in this timeline!"

Hinata guessed that was from the Blessings they received from both Felix's and Rimuru's Harvest Festival.

Felix has explained a bit about True Demon Lords and the process of them Awakening. She was a bit put off at how… almost easy it seemed.

Killing 10,000 normal Humans was a breeze to a lot of Majin. Thankfully, such a condition was mostly unknown. Not to mention the other condition of possessing a Demon Lord Seed.

Felix truly was well-learned.

Still, for some reason, Felix seemed confident that even if it was well known everything would be fine. He had said that the Demon Lord Guy Crimson would take care of it.

Hinata did not know why that… Daemon would do such a thing, but she understood that Felix knew something that she did not.

'There is one thing that's bugging me is, how did Felix and Rimuru become True Demon Lords in the timeline if Rimuru usually makes it back in time to defend Tempest?'

"Hehe, that was because of me. Because I had regained some of my memories ahead of time, I felt sudden urges when I had to change something, at the time I didn't know what these urges were trying to do but I trusted my instincts. I made sure to… stall Rimuru enough so that you would encounter him. He even gave me the mask back then."

Hinata did not know what to think about that. Chloe had knowingly or perhaps unknowingly caused many deaths in Tempest, sure she may have known that Rimuru would do something to bring them back, but still… a woman in love was a dangerous thing.
She was sure that the constant Time Leaps had a part to play, any Human would become more and more desperate in her situation. In fact she might have done similar to Chloe, after all she could just retry if things didn't work out, so Hinata did not blame her for her actions.

In fact, Hinata could not even treat Chloe as the same innocent child as before, she had to have been far far older than she looked at this point, at least mentally.

"Because of that, you were able to stall him long enough for the damage to have already been done. So he went ahead and Ascended into a True Demon Lord along with Felix-nii to bring everyone who had died back."

'And so both Felix and Rimuru grew in power a tremendous amount sooner than they have before?'

"Yes. The future that we just came from seems to be the best one so far. If we can return back to that future… then maybe we can finally win this time, maybe we can find out who killed you and Rimuru. Everyone will still be alive and safe, we would have an actual chance."

'Indeed, when compared to all these other timelines you have mentioned, the most recent one seems to be the ideal one.'

"Yes, we must reach that future!"

'Very well then, you can count on my help then.'

- Felix -

I made my way to the Clown that was still stuck in my Fixation. Once I was standing in front of him I grabbed him by the throat once again and I dispelled my Fixation.

He immediately started pointlessly struggling.

"I don't understand why you continue to struggle. Your Magic Circuits are crippled, and I have you at my mercy."

My words only made the Clown angrier and struggle harder.

"Now, I'll deal with you later. Sit tight." And with that, I stored him in my Infinity Space, particularly in the prison area of my Infinity Space.

With it being basically infinitely large as well as my complete control of the Chaos World, I could create practically any sort of environment in there.

The prison of my Infinity Space in particular was surrounded in darkness, pure emptiness where no one but me and those I allowed could move.

They still had their own thoughts, but they could not do anything except stare into the void and contemplate.

The Clown and Mariabell can keep each other company there.

"Then Clown will be safe for now. We can interrogate him later." I told the group.

Perhaps Greed would be useful for that endeavor.

"That Clown… is the one that killed Roy. His crimes are many."

I snorted at that. "Well, get in line. It seems we all have a bone to pick with this guy."

"So it seems." Said Luminous, seemingly giving in, though I could tell she was angry at her position. While we both had things the other wanted, she knew she was in a weaker position.

I had the Clown, and Rimuru and I could easily take Luminous together. Though Rimuru would likely be very against that, not to mention I didn't even want to do such a thing. Though she did seem to need us for something.

So, we definitely held the position of power at the moment.

But Roy Valentine, huh? I remember hearing that Roy had fought the Demon Lord Kazalim evenly so he was probably pretty powerful.

That also gives me a rough estimate of Kazalim's own power. Going by the amount of energy I sensed Roy to have back at the Walpurgis he was probably about half as strong as Louis.

So this Kazalim was fairly weak all things considered, definitely not a True Demon Lord, likely just a Seed.

Doesn't matter anyway, as Guy had said that Leon killed Kazalim.

I turned around to look at Luminous. "Roy was about half as powerful as Louis, right?"

Luminous nodded. "Indeed, Louis and Roy were originally a single being that I split into two, Roy's power returned to Louis once he had passed away."

Huh, so Louis wasn't this strong originally, interesting. I do wonder how one would split a single being into two though.

"I see. Thanks for answering."

Though the Clown is incredibly powerful as well, he's around the level of an Awakened being, with an amount of Existence Points a fair bit higher than even that subordinate of Luminous's, Louis.

His Soul was a bit odd, too.

Luminous turned to her two subordinates. "Seeing as you two are not needed, return back to Ruberious."

They both bowed to her and then vanished.

I walked towards Hinata's body and knelt down. I placed my hand on her stomach and stored her in my Infinity Space. I have a feeling this body may come in handy later on.

"What did you do?!" Demanded Luminous.

I raised both of my hands up. "Peace Luminous. I am simply storing her body and keeping it safe. I have a feeling that this body will have a use at some point."

Luminous' glare was still present, but she took a deep breath and calmed down. "Very well. Then, should I not be the one safekeeping her body? She was my subordinate."

I waved my finger at her. "Ah ah ah. But I was her teacher. Not to mention I have a far better chance at keeping her body safe."

"What is that supposed to mean?!"

"It means that in case whoever is behind this sends someone to retrieve the body. They will have a harder time getting it from me than they will you. I stored her body in another Dimension, after all. Not to mention leaving it with you is the predictable option."

"We will talk about this again after I have explained everything." Said Luminous.

"Alright, alright."

"Well then? Will we be standing around all day?" Questioned Luminous.

I held my hand out, the God Grade rapier I made for Hinata floated into my hand, at which point I stored it in my Infinity Space.

"I'll teleport us back to Tempest." Said Rimuru.

And with that our group vanished and appeared in Tempest. I looked around to see where exactly in Tempest we were.

It looks like we were transported to one of the safehouses.

"Sensei!"

Rimuru and I turned towards the voice.

"Ah, Kenya. I'm glad to see you all are fine." Said Rimuru.

"Where is Chloe?" Asked Alice.

Rimuru gave them a fragile smile. "Ah, well, she's going to be gone for a little while. W-we need to figure out what happened to her."

I could see tears beginning to form in some of the kids' eyes.

I sighed. "She isn't dead. She was just transported somewhere for her own grand adventure. Heroes will never have an easy time, but trust in your friend to make it back okay."

Ugh, who knew I'd have to be the one giving them a pep talk.

Rimuru sent me a grateful smile.

"Chloe? A Hero?!" Shouted Ryouta.

"Keep your voice down." Said Rimuru.

Ryota nervously rubbed the back of his head. "Oops."

"Now we need to go talk about something important, make sure to be obedient." Rimuru then turned to the female Hobgoblin who was in charge of their class. "Could you make sure they don't get into any trouble?"

"Yes Lord Rimuru!" She responded.

Rimuru then turned to Benimaru who seemed to be the one protecting this safehouse. The attackers seemed to all be dealt with so he probably had some free time.

"Benimaru."

Benimaru kneeled in front of Rimuru. "Lord Rimuru!"

"You did a good job today. Thank you for keeping the kids safe."

"It was my duty, My Lord!"

"Still, thank you. Everyone will be rewarded once everything is sorted out. Now Luminous, Felix and I are going to be having a meeting. Can you make sure everything stays in order?"

"Yes, My Lord!" Responded Benimaru.

Hmm, I should probably check in with my subordinates.

"I just arrived back in Tempest. Is everything going okay?" I asked.

"Ah, My Lord! It pleases me to hear you in good health!" Said Arcueid.

"Hehe, of course, our Master would easily be able to deal with any threat! Ah! I did good today, Master! Can I be rewarded!" Of course, that is what Lalatina focuses on.

"Ooh, I felt a super strong Aura earlier! Could you tell me about it, Lord Felix?!" Asked Megumin.

"I'll tell you later Megumin. And yes Lalatina, everyone did well today, so I will reward everyone." Now, how should I even reward them? I already gave them weapons. I'll have to think about that later.

"I have fulfilled my duties, Master." Said my adorable Dragon Maid.

"Hmph! As expected of Felix-sama! No way any of those weaklings could pose a problem for him!" Said Saeko.

Ah, I truly have a team of glazers. I seriously need to make sure I don't get into my own head with subordinates like these.

"I have completed my duties as well, Lord Felix. Though I wish I was powerful enough to have been of assistance to you when you had gone to deal with the Chaos Dragon. You should not need to lower yourself to deal with such a bug. I will be increasing my training." Said Sukuna.

"Uhm. Glenda and I were able to protect some people!"

"Good job, Ingvild," I responded. Ingvild really was a cinnamon roll.

"What about Agera and Zonda?" I asked.

"Zonda was going around healing others while Agera was dealing with stronger foes that some of Lord Rimuru's subordinates could not defeat." Responded Arcueid.

"I see. I'll have to praise them as well, then. Anyways I'll be in a meeting, I'm not sure how long it will last so just head back to my residence."

"Very well, My Lord."

With that, I cut off the thought communication.

Rimuru seemed to have just finished his conversation with Benimaru.

Rimuru turned to look at Luminous and then at me. "Alright, are you two ready?"

We both nodded and followed Rimuru as he led us to the Chancellor's Building, where Rimuru conducted his duties as a Ruler.

"Did anyone die?" I asked.

Rimuru shook his head. "No, thankfully, no one died. Only some had minor injuries, but they were quickly healed. Ah, thanks for lending Zonda to Tempest. He was healing my subordinates' injuries as some of them got a bit wounded from their fights."

I waved him off. "It's fine."

I looked around as we were walking towards the Chancellor's Office. Many buildings were destroyed, and the ground was cracked and destroyed in certain areas.

It would take some time to rebuild. But I also noticed Majin helping Human, and Human helping Majin. Some were conversing over a drink, while others were joking around with each other.

Nothing grows people closer than fighting for your lives, huh?

"One more thing. Do you know where Yuuki is?"

Rimuru looked at me curiously before a look of realization appeared. "You think he is behind this?"
I nodded. "I know he is."

"Explain everything later, then." I nodded. "But Yuuki is in one of the safehouses. I just checked."

Good, that means that he hasn't caught on yet or I assume he would be trying to subtly leave Tempest.

"Excuse me. Do you mean Yuuki Kagurazaka? The head of the Free Guild?" Asked Luminous.

I nodded. "The very same."

"This plot is getting more and more interesting." Said Luminous.

"That's one way to say it."

It didn't take us long to arrive at the Chancellor's Office.

"This is a fairly… quaint building." Commented Luminous.

"Haha, I know it isn't some grand palace, but I'm fine with this." Said Rimuru.

Luminous looked at Rimuru weirdly. "Very well. It is your reputation, after all."

Rimuru ignored her comment and led us towards the Meeting Room. Once we were inside, we all took our seats.

Rimuru snapped his fingers and placed a barrier around the room to keep this conversation secret.

Luminous looked at the both of us. "Now, have you ever heard of the name… Chronoa?"

- Hinata Sakaguchi -

They had decided that their first stop would be visiting Luminous. It seems Luminous always had a part to play in Chloe's previous loops.

They did not have many potential allies in this era, none of her subordinates were around at this point, and none of the Demon Lords would lend a hand except for perhaps Milim Nava and Ramiris. But she did not know how to convince them of anything, she did not have any sort of close relationship with those two, rather Felix was the one who was close to them.

She did not think she was capable of persuading them, besides Chloe almost never encountered those two this early on.

If they were trying to make sure they arrived in the same future they left they would have to make sure they did not do anything out of the ordinary, they had to take actions similar to what Chloe always did.

It was a bit suffocating, knowing they had some of their freedom taken, to be restricted to a few choices. But they would have to deal with it.

They were currently heading to Luminous' old castle, Night Rose, which was destroyed by Veldora in the future.

"I will tell Luminous about Veldora's attack so she can evacuate her civilians. That should be enough to earn her trust."

'Very well. That is a good move. Though be prepared for rejection. Luminous may not believe you right away.'

"I know she'll come around."

Sometimes, having future knowledge can give you all the confidence you need.

Chloe already knew the way to get to Luminous' old castle.

'It truly is quite majestic. No wonder Luminous was always so angry at Veldora for destroying this.'

"Hehe, yup! Veldora may become Rimuru's friend in the future, but he is just a berserker now."

'Indeed.'

Hinata herself was rather put off by Veldora, even up to her death she could not get him to take her seriously throughout their many spars.

It didn't take long for a group of Vampires to appear in front of Chloe, guards by the look of it.

"Who are you?!" Asked the Guard in the lead.

"Hello there. I am here to see Luminous." Chloe boldly declared.

'Ugh, I don't think that was the right move Chloe. Boldly proclaiming their Ruler's name without any honorifics isn't likely to blow over well.'

"Don't worry, I know Luminous!"

'But you don't? You haven't even met Luminous yet.'

"Ah, crap! That's right, I always mix some of these things up with all these memories in my head. In fact, I think I remember you scolding me about the same thing before, hehe."

It was nice to know even her other versions were keeping Chloe in check. It was not a task for the light-hearted it seemed.

Though from what Chloe said, she did not always accompany Chloe back to the past. Sometimes it was up to Chloe alone to resolve everything.

Hinata was sure that the loneliness was killing her.

'Alright, how about I help you? Whenever someone asks you something, don't immediately respond, hear me out first.'

"Okay!"

That's good. If Chloe says something she is not supposed to, history could change. Even a slight deviation could mess everything up.

"That's from next time, though!"

After saying that Chloe dashed past Luminous' guards and quickly made her way to Luminous' chamber.

'Damn it! Did you not hear what I just said!'

"Don't worry, I've done this before already."

'Ugh, what a pain.'

"Hey!"

Chloe burst through the door. Luminous was sitting in the center of the room on her throne.

"Now, who do we have here?" Saidi Luminous with a haughty smile.

Chloe gave her a wave. "Hello! I am Chloe Aubert! I am here to warn you that Veldora will be attacking this place soon!"

Luminous looked at Chloe with interest. "The Storm Dragon will attack, you say? I'm sure you understand I can't just take you at your word."

This… this was going better than Hinata thought it would.

"Lady Luminous!" Yelled one of the guards who had just arrived.

Luminous waved her hand at them. "Leave. You have already shown your incompetence enough for today."

The guards cowered under Luminous' glare and quickly left.

Luminous then looked to Chloe. "Now, why don't we continue."

Chloe nodded. "The True Dragon Veldora will be attacking this place soon. I have no doubt about that fact. And while you are strong, you and I both know you are not capable of taking on a True Dragon."

Such a comment probably stung Luminous' pride, but from experience, Hinata knew that Luminous was capable of swallowing her pride.

She did care for her people, after all.

"Indeed, it pains me to admit, but the True Dragons are not a foe that can be beaten by conventional means. Only true monsters like Guy Crimson and the first True Hero would have a chance. But can I trust you?"

"Okay, now what do you think I should say?"

'Now you ask me? Well, give me a moment.'

Hinata then used her Unique Skill: Mathematician to analyze Luminous as best as she could. She drew on Chloe's own power to help give her the power she needed to do such a thing.

She knew what year it was thanks to Chloe's information, so she was able to roughly calculate when Veldora would attack.

'You can tell her when Veldora will arrive, once that happens we will have won some trust with Luminous.'

Chloe internally agreed with her and then looked at Luminous confidently. "At the earliest, he will arrive within a week, at the longest, in a couple of months."

Luminous sighed. "Very well. I will allow you to stay within my palace, should your words prove false though…."

Chloe waved Luminous off. "They are not false."

And so began their stay in Night Rose.

—

They watched as Luminous faced Veldora head on. Thankfully all of Luminous' citizens had been evacuated as Luminous had decided to trust them.

Luminous was putting up a good fight, but in the end the result was already determined the moment the fight started.

Even though this Veldora lacked all the skill he would acquire later on, he was still a True Dragon, an unbeatable enemy for all but a few.

Luminous was not part of that few, not yet.

"It's sad that we can't help her."

'Indeed, but it is how things must go. Luminous must fail here if we are to return back to our future. We must repeat the same things you did the last time, no matter what your other memories say. Perhaps it would be a good idea to share some of the future with Luminous to win her trust. Of course, nothing that could cause something to change.'

There were many things Luminous should not know about, if she knew of Gran's betrayal she would kill him long before he had played his part. She may look for her or Chloe ahead of time to take them under her wing.

In this scenario, while there weren't too many casualties, Night Rose was still destroyed, aligning with Hinata's own memories.

This was just one step in the right direction.

—

"You are from the future, you said Chloe?"

Since Chloe was right about Veldora's attack, she had won Luminous' trust, which thankfully made a lot of things easier.

Chloe nodded in response to Luminous. "Yup! Hinata-nee and I both!"

By now Luminous knew of both individuals inhabiting a single body, Hinata had multiple opportunities to talk to Luminous as Chloe was able to pass on control of her body.

"I see, and you said this is not your first time in the past?" Asked Luminous.

"Nope, but hopefully, it will be my last!"

"I see. What do you plan to do now that you are in the past? Do you plan to change things for your benefit?"
Chloe shook her head. "No, Hinata and I both want to make sure that we return to the same future we left from. It is the best one by far."

"The best future hmm. Would you mind telling me about it?"
Chloe nodded eagerly. "Uhm, I was a Stray Otherworlder at first, I appeared with my childhood friend. But the moment I appeared in this world I was Summoned to the future. I ended up going to a school and met my teacher, Rimuru. After that events varied depending on the timeline, but in almost all of them Rimuru dies."

Hinata noticed that Chloe was keeping the events that occurred in the future incredibly vague, which was good. The less Luminous knew, the better.

Luminous nodded. "I see, and what about Hinata?"

Hearing Luminous Chloe passed on control of the body over to her. "Hmm, well I was originally a Stray Otherworlder as well, I ended up meeting a nice teacher who took me in and taught me. I ended up leaving that teacher after I learned everything from her."

Hinata knew she did not treat Shizu-sensei as well as she should have, but fear often causes Humans to do things they regret in the future. Shizu-sensei was the closest thing she had to a mother figure in this world.

In her case, the fear of attachment. If she had met Felix back then, she likely would have done something similar, though, with his personality, he likely would have tracked her down and beat her up.

"After that, I journeyed around the world for some time before finding a place where I felt I could make a difference. That place was with you, Luminous."

Luminous blushed slightly, hearing her. How odd.

"A-ah, I see."

"After that, I grew in strength and eventually became the leader of your personal Knight Order of sorts. I would end up having a misunderstanding with Rimuru and it would lead to a fight. Thankfully everything ended up fine. Through Rimuru I ended up meeting my second teacher, the Demon Lord Felix."

Hearing that, Luminous looked far more interested.

"A Demon Lord would teach you?"

Hinata nodded. "Yes, I suspect he originally began out of his own petty desire to punish me for almost killing his friend. But we did grow closer over time." Hinata said with a fond smile on her face.

For some reason, Luminous' eyes narrowed at that.

"How strong is this Demon Lord Felix?" Asked Luminous.

Hinata tilted her head slightly. "I could not say. I had no way to measure his strength, he did tell me that he had beaten me with contemptuous ease while using 1% of his power."

"1%!?" Yelled a shocked Luminous.

Hinata nodded. "Yes, 1%."

"And you were a Saint then?"

Hinata nodded once again. "Yes, an Incomplete one but I was capable of elevating myself to the same level as a Complete Saint with the help of the armor you had gifted me. The one this body is wearing now."

Luminous nodded. "He must be incredibly powerful then."

"He was, even you had recognized him. He also seemed to have the approval of Guy Crimson."

Luminous' eyes widened. "Even Guy?!"

"Indeed. I also witnessed him sparring with Veldora, one in which Veldora had to take him seriously and even then wasn't able to push Felix back at all. I do not know how the fight would have ended as Rimuru stopped them in the midst of it."

For some reason Hinata felt satisfied at seeing the shock on Luminous' face. It was only right that she recognized how amazing her teacher was, for all Felix's faults, he was strong, no one could deny that.

It was fairly odd that she was proud of such a thing however. She had not felt anything similar for others.

"I look forward to meeting this Slime and Daemon in the future then." Hinata was sure Luminous would regret saying that. Luminous had ranted to her about how annoying Felix was on multiple occasions.

Hinata went on to give some more about her background.

"Well then what do you plan to do now?"

Hinata passed control of the body back to Chloe.

"Hmm, well I always end up being a Hero for sometime so I will do the same this time as well to make sure that the future stays right."

"A Hero hmm? Very well then. I will inform everyone here that you are my friend. Should you need something you may ask anyone." Said Luminous.

"Great! Thanks Luminous!"

As they were leaving towards the personal quarters Luminous had assigned them Hinata asked, 'What will you be known as? You can't be known as Chloe Auburt or that would be far too suspicious in the future.'

"Uhm, that's right. Leon-onii chan will definitely find out. I usually just pick a name, why don't you choose one this time?"

'A name huh? Since you have the Unique Skill: Time Traveler we can use the name of the Primordial of Time from Greek Mythos, Chronos. We can change it a bit to differentiate a bit. What about… Chronoa?'

"Okay then! I will be called Chronoa from now on!"

Chapter 44: Back To the Past! Part 2

- Felix -

Rimuru and I processed the story we had just been told.

"So Chloe and Hinata are… in the past?" Asked Rimuru.

Luminous nodded. "That is correct."

Who knew that Hinata and Chloe would together become the being known as Chronoa? Not much is known about that Hero, but it is confirmed that she existed. She is the one who had sealed Veldora after all.

Chronoa has been responsible for the demise of multiple Demon Lords as well. I imagine all of this was done to maintain the timeline, to make sure nothing changed so they return to the same future they left.

Rimuru turned to look at me. "Why don't you seem to be that surprised, Felix?"

"Because I already suspected it."

Rimuru's eyes widened. "What?!" Rimuru shouted.

"Yeah, ever since I first met Chloe, I knew she had an unusual ability. I knew she was likely capable of traveling through Time."

Hearing me, Rimuru looked at me with betrayal in his eyes, which did make me feel a bit bad.

"Then why didn't you tell me!?"

I sighed hearing him. "Because I did not know if that would change things. At the time I did not know how exactly her ability would work, if it took her to the future or the past. If it took her to the future then no big deal. But if it took her to the past…."

Rimuru looked at me with understanding in his eyes. "Then just you sharing that information with me might have changed things. I may have acted differently, I may have kept Chloe hidden somewhere, and then she would not have been with Hinata during the attack. And so Hinata would truly have been dead, and Chloe would not go to the past. And if that happened…."

I nodded. "If that happened then a lot of things would be very very different. Our present selves wouldn't exist."

Rimuru sighed. "Fine fine, I forgive you. But tell me important stuff like this from now on! I'm not as emotional as you think I am!"

Even though Rimuru said that I knew he would feel the sting of betrayal for some time, even I am self-aware enough to know that what I did was questionable.

The best I could do was continue being Rimuru's friend, hopefully, he'll come around.

Hmm, maybe I can make a copy of that super sexy lingerie Saeko wears sometimes and pass it on to Shuna.

"Alright fine I'll do that."

Seeing as our conversation was done Luminous looked at me with curiosity in her eyes. "I was not aware you could immediately know of someone's abilities."

"Well, it isn't something I share with many people."

Luminous nodded. "Understandable. I would do the same in your position."

I nodded in response. "It is a useful ability, it's how I knew to take you seriously from the start, one does not hold one of the Sin Series Skills without having some monstrous potential."

Luminous' eyes narrowed once she heard me.

Even Mariabell had that potential if she had the time to grow. A single Sin Series Skill was just that monstrous, the same with the Virtue Series Skills.

And that was true, there was Rimuru himself who had Gluttony. Milim I assume had Wrath, and then Luminous who is a True Ancestor herself with Lust. Of course, Mariabell has Greed.

That leaves Pride, Envy, and Sloth missing.

I'm not sure what it says about Rimuru that he has two Virtue Series Skills and a single Sin Series.

Dude is certifiably broken.

Well even I awakened Uriel before it evolved into Ouroboros. I assume that is fairly uncommon for a Demonic aligned being like myself, I'll just chalk it up to my previous two lives as a Human having some influence.

"Eh! I didn't know Luminous had that Skill?!" I rolled my eyes hearing Rimuru, I'm honestly surprised that he even knows what a Sin Series Skill is.

He can be clueless about things that he has no right being clueless about. In fact he didn't even know who or what Diablo was until I brought it up.

Luminous pursed her lips. "I see, thank you for the… compliment then Felix."

I tipped my nonexistent hat to her which only seemed to annoy Luminous.

"Heh, I wasn't wrong for that belief either, not just anyone can evolve their Unique Skill on their own." I had the assistance of Odin while Rimuru had the assistance of Raphael, I imagine it is normally far more difficult to acquire an Ultimate Skill. There is a reason it took over a thousand years for Luminous to gain an Ultimate Skill.

She needed an appropriate stimulus as well as sufficient willpower. Willpower truly separates the weak from the strong in this world.

Luminous sighed hearing me. "Of course, you know about that."

I rolled my eyes at her. "Practically anyone can tell something happened to you just by a quick glance." I pointed to Rimuru. "Only this guy is dense enough not to notice."

"Hey!"

I ignored Rimuru's shout and continued. "Though do be careful of Guy. Once he realizes your Skill has evolved he may… become more interested in you."

Hinata had also managed to become proficient in Distortion over the years. It was a very difficult Art to use; in fact, it took her over a decade to learn it properly and then decades to truly master it.

Both Chloe and her now knew Distortion Field and were capable of using it in the midst of combat.

With Distortion Field, Veldora will have a difficult time harming them. As far as she knew, the current Veldora did not have as much technique as he would have in the future. He had no mental attacks to make use of and was unable to manipulate Spiritrons to a high enough degree to penetrate Distortion Field.

Though Hinata did not doubt he could quickly learn how to do so, Veldora was extremely talented from what she had seen.

Luminous looked at them with worry in her eyes. "Are you capable of beating the Lizard as you are now? I know you are powerful… but even I must admit Veldora is not a foe to be underestimated. True Dragons are forces of nature. They may as well be natural disasters that cannot be stopped."

'Why don't you let me fight Veldora? Back in The Dungeon, I had fought him fairly often, I have most of his attacks and general combat style memorized. I should be able to take advantage of his flaws. Not to mention, I got him to show me all of the Skills he had. I know what sort of abilities he has and will have in the future.' Hinata suggested.

In fact Veldora should be weaker than he is in the future, in the future he learned to control his power, at this point he is just an idiotic berserker.

Felix even said that Veldora was capable of Probability Manipulation, but he also confirmed that Veldora did not have that ability for long. If Veldora was capable of that, then she would have a far more difficult time.

She would have her revenge. She clearly remembered all the taunts Veldora had used on her, she would make sure to get some pay back on Veldora.

He even said that Felix's students shouldn't be so weak.

If she was so weak, then why was he going to be sealed by her then?

"Hmm, okay then!"

"Eh, it should be fine. Hinata says she can take him."

Luminous sighed. "Very well, I know it is pointless to convince you against this course of action. It is necessary to keep events the same, correct?"

Chloe nodded.

"Very well then. I wish you luck. It will be quite enjoyable watching that Lizard get taken down a peg or two."

Hinata approached the rampaging True Dragon, who was in the process of returning to his well-known territory in the Great Jura Forest.

He had just returned from rampaging in one of Luminous's border towns. Along with that, he had recently repelled the Eastern Empire's forces that had invaded the Great Jura Forest, and he was quite angry at their audacity.

He was an intimidating sight, his massive frame trampling over the trees while breathing fire in every direction.

Thankfully the inhabitants of the forest were quickly evacuated by various Dryads, so Hinata did not need to worry about any collateral damage.

Veldora's eyes soon locked in on her.

"Ghaha! Has another weakling come to face me?!" Questioned Veldora.

Hinata's face twitched beneath her mask, but she kept her emotions under control.

Drawing out her God Grade Rapier, Moon Mistress, Hinata began to approach Veldora. The beautiful weapon began to glow a warm golden light. Once the attack was fully charged. Hinata looked at Veldora before vanishing, her speed unparalleled as she appeared in front of Veldora in an instant.

"Melt Slash!" Hinata shouted, releasing all her pent-up anger from her last fight against Veldora in this attack.

Veldora, who was always overconfident in his own strength, hadn't even bothered to dodge this attack. Giving Hinata a clear shot at his torso.

The rapier coated in pure rampaging Spiritrons focused in one single spot. Piercing him directly through the torso and leaving a massive wound that continued to rampage even as Hinata jumped back to prepare for her next attack.

"GUWAAAAAAHHHH!" Veldora shouted in pure shock as he felt the pain begin to eat away at him.

Hinata took pleasure in Veldora's suffering. This beating was a long time coming.

However, the downside of Melt Slash quickly became apparent as Veldora began gathering a massive amount of Magicules in his mouth.

Melt Slash could only do a significant amount of damage if her Melt Slash completely consumed the target, against larger targets it was impossible to consume the entire target with her Melt Slash, making it so that she only severely wounded them rather than erased them.

It didn't take long for a massive torrent of fire to make its way towards her.

Hinata casually walked towards the fire, trusting Felix's technique, Distortion Field, to deal with Veldora's fire breath. In an instant, the entire area around her became coated in a storm of Black Fire.

The fire burned and consumed everything in its path. Yet it couldn't reach her through the Distortion Field.

"W-What! How!" Veldora shouted as he saw the fire begin to die down, only to reveal Hinata walking menacingly, her rapier glowing brightly once again.

Using his own surprise against him. Hinata vanished once again, the fire around her extinguishing from the burst of wind she left behind.

Appearing behind Veldora, Hinata's rapier which was imbued with Absolute End struck Veldora's back, leaving a massive gash in his large frame.

"UUWHAA" Veldora shouted, feeling slightly panicked as he felt true pain for the first time since he had last pissed off his sister.

Unable to shake off the bad memory, Veldora stopped holding off. Releasing his entire Haki to try to pressure down Hinata. His Aura alone was enough to casually level an entire Nation, but Hinata continued to move unbothered by it. Veldora was far too sloppy at the moment, and this sort of brutish release wasn't strong enough to slow her down.

Had he focused his Haki solely on her, Hinata would have been in trouble. But this was a Veldora who hadn't met Rimuru yet. A brute that only knew how to use pure power to defeat his enemies.

Thankfully, she had placed a Barrier around them before the battle started to prevent any collateral damage, a Barrier that was being maintained by Luminous.

Thunder clouds began to form all across the battlefield as Veldora began to roar. Black Lightning flashed and shot toward Hinata in an instant, yet it never reached her. Felix's Art was truly bullshit, and the fact that he probably had a better version now only made Hinata more determined to grow stronger.

Veldora went berserk as he continued to swing his tail in an attempt to hit Hinata. Lighting and Thunder continued to echo across the entire forest, shaking it into silence as the destruction continued.

Hinata had fought Veldora enough times that she had memorized all of his weak points. Now, those weak points were far more noticeable. Almost as if he hadn't ever bothered to block in his life.

Hinata couldn't help but smile as she continued to vanish from place to place, moving in a weaving pattern and slashing at Veldora. She was an entirely beast now compared to their first fight.

She could see the end drawing nearer with every slash, though she couldn't hold back the beautiful yet terrifying smile on her face as she finally found the challenge she had been searching for this entire time.

Landing on the ground after using Absolute End once again, she looked on as Veldora began to slow down.

It had only been a few minutes since the battle had started, but Veldora was already starting to strain the barrier she had put up.

By this point, the storm above them had turned into an absolute catastrophe. Lighting crashed every second, trying to strike down Hinata. Sharp winds and small tornados tried to cut her up. Yet they were wild and uncontrolled, so as long as Hinata kept an eye out for them, she would be able to dodge them easily and reposition them.

"It's too late either way." Hinata muttered. She felt like she had weakened Veldora enough to use Infinity Prison on him.

Looking at the wild Storm Dragon trashing about trying to hit her, Hinata raised her rapier, taking a deep breath as she channeled a large portion of her magicules into this final attack.

As countless magicules began to charge on Veldora's mouth, Hinata pounced for the last time.

Veldora tried to swing to smack her out of the sky, but in one elegant movement Hinata landed on his hand before jumping and stabbing right through the heart of the True Dragon.

"GUWAHHHHHHHHRGHH" Veldora shouted for one last time, taking a step back from the shock of the pain.

Landing on the ground, Hinata raised her free hand and activated Infinity Prison. In one final attempt to fight back, Veldora's magicules burst with their full strength. He fought as best as he could against the Prison forming around him but it was too little too late.

With the dragon captured, she would take him to the cave in the Great Jura Forest and seal him within. All so that he would meet a certain Slime in 200 years.
