"Seriously? Just what is going on? An Insectoid here in the Cardinal World? That does not paint a good picture. Could Zelanus be prepping for an invasion?"

Velzard shrugged her shoulders. "Perhaps. However, I do not think that Zegion, the Insectar, is involved in his plan. He was very loyal to Rimuru and also looked up to Veldora. And an Insectar that weak and that young is incapable of deceiving me. He had potential, though. No, I think his arrival in this world is a coincidence. He may have fallen through a Spatial Distortion and appeared in this world."

Guy nodded. "Perhaps. I'll just keep an eye out."

"Did you go to Felix's territory?" Guy continued.

Velzard nodded. "Yes. He introduced me to some of his subordinates."

"Did you meet those three?" Guy asked with some amusement. Three of his fellow kin serving a single man was truly an oddity.

She nodded. "I did. Arcueid seems to be the one who manages Felix's territory for him. Megumin seems to train the military and perhaps lead it, and then Lalatina is in charge of intelligence. They seem to be doing fairly well for themselves. They are each quite powerful now that they have been Incarnated and Named. Arcueid seems to be in a Deathman body, while the other two are in a Bone Golem made of extremely high-end materials."

Guy sighed. "I see. At least those three aren't going out of control. Felix seems to have them well-tamed somehow."

Velzard laughed. "Indeed, it looked as if they were eating out of the palm of his hand. His other subordinates were fairly impressive as well. A Dragon Lord, a Wicked Oni, an odd mutation of a Daemon, another Daemon, and then a Cryptid. All on the Daemon Duke level, if not higher."

"Tell me about it. Though I didn't know he had other Daemons on the Daemon Duke level other than those three. That guy is seriously building one hell of a force under him. And you said he had a Cryptid under him? A Cryptid and an Insectar in this world at once? Both serving under two Demon Lords? How odd." Responded Guy.

Velzard nodded. "Indeed, I was also quite surprised to find one of them in this world. She was intelligent as well and had assumed a Humanoid form, which speaks of her power."

"How intriguing. He really is getting more and more interesting. First, his ability to copy Skills, and then his seemingly natural combat talent."

Velzard nodded. "He did copy my Skill, perhaps that was how he learned to move in the Suspended World as well as activate Time Stop."

Guy nodded. "You're probably right. Well, it's a good thing I have him on my side then."

Velzard nodded, realizing that she had accidentally gotten carried away when talking with Guy because she had been excited about Veldora's progress. "He is powerful. Now I will be going, do not disturb me, Guy." She told him coldly, the least he could do was learn his lesson. And he wouldn't if she just forgave him now.

Guy looked at her in confusion. "Okay?"

She rolled her eyes, the dunce.

She made her way to the lounge. Once she was there, she sat down on a frozen couch, which still remained surprisingly comfortable. She took out the book that Felix had given her.

"A day in the life of Veldora Tempest? What a quaint name." She said with a smile as she turned the first page.

- Arcueid -

"You said that someone entered our Lord's territory? I assume you would not bring this to my attention unless this invader has bypassed our border posts and failed to go through the necessary procedures."

Her beloved Lord had wished to have more control over who entered his territory, so he had outposts built at all of the roads and entrances that led directly into this territory. When passing by, one is supposed to pay a small fee as well as register their identity with the guards, though it is possible to bypass this with a special pass that is given to merchants and other important visitors so as not to hold them up.

Lalatina lounged across from her. "Yup! He snuck right by the border outpost and seems to be headed right to Master's castle." Chriped Lalatina. "He was stronger than the rest of the trash Master seems to want Megumin to train up. Glenda spotted him, and then I went to double check."

She looked at Lalatina with interest. "Oh? How strong exactly?"

"Hmm, not as strong as any of Master's other stronger subordinates, but almost at that level. I am not capable of measuring the precise amount of Energy within someone's body like Master can, but I'd say a little weaker than Moss is, at least Energy wise."

Arcueid raised a brow. "Ara ara, that is quite interesting. Not many could claim to be that powerful in this World, and those that do would know well enough to follow the proper procedures to visit our Lord's territory unless they are his friends."

"Well, I've never met the guy, I can tell you that, Master hasn't ever mentioned someone like him. He was very sloppy at hiding his intent. It was easy to tell he was coming here to cause trouble." Said Lalatina.

"I see. It seems I will not be able to send those Otherworlders our Lord decided to take pity on."

It would be a waste of resources to send those Otherworlders to simply die. They had joined the common military in their training, and each was very dedicated to growing stronger, seeming to not want their free will taken from them ever again.

She could not complain. The stronger they got, the more useful they would be to her Lord.

"Though Glenda seemed to know of him." Lalatina mentioned offhandedly.

"Oh? What did she know?" Glenda knew quite a lot about the inner workings of the Western Nations as a former subordinate of Granbell Rosso.

"She said he was known as Vega of Power, one of the three heads of Cerberus." Said Lalatina.

She sat up straight. "Cerberus? Is that not the criminal group our Lord informed us about? The group that was led by Yuuki Kagurazaka before our Lord purged him?"

"Yes, it seems to be the same group. From what Glenda knew, Vega of Power was said to be a brute, all brawn and no brains. She didn't know much about the inner operations of Cerberus, all she had was his general characteristics." Finished Lalatina.

"Hmm, that alone does not paint a good picture. Perhaps he was sent to get revenge for the killing of Yuuki Kagurazaka? If so, then this Cerberus organization is more foolish than I thought. To think someone as weak as Vega is capable of causing any sort of inconvenience to our Lord is a foolish mistake."

Lalatina then got up off the couch. "Well, do whatever you want, I've done my job, I'll trust you to do yours."

Arcueid firmly nodded. "Very well, thank you, Lalatina."

Lalatina was very professional when it came to fulfilling the role that her Lord had given, even ignoring her new… nature she would rather die than disappoint their Lord. Something Arcueid could respect and acknowledge.

Now, how should she handle this? She could send someone to take care of this threat, but she decided to go in person to deal with this invader. Perhaps she will take her target alive and interrogate him. If he truly was sent by this Cerberus organization, knowing what plans they had for her Lord would be helpful.

Her Lord had told her to do what she wished in these circumstances, he said he did not wish to micromanage her, and so she would do what she wished.

First, she would need to locate this invader though, her senses were not nearly as attuned as her Lord's.

"Moss."

Her closest attendant appeared beside her. "My Lady." He bowed in reverence.

"I wish for you to locate someone for me." Moss's Unique Skill was very well suited for surveillance work as well as discrete assassinations, he could easily scour her Lord's entire territory and come back to her with what she needed.

"Yes, Mistress."

She described Vega's looks to Moss. Now she would just need to wait.

–

"I have located him, Mistress." She heard Moss call out.

She nodded. "Take me to him."

Moss nodded and teleported the both of them to where Vega was located.

It seems he was camping out in the wilderness, close to where the old roads were. The old roads stopped being used after her Lord with the help of Lord Rimuru reconstructed far safer and more useful roads that connected Azeroth to various Kingdoms and territories.

"He is ahead, Mistress."

"Very well, stay close by, and if a battle begins, make sure to contain the damage." She ordered.

Moss bowed lowly. "As you wish, Mistress."

She sauntered forward, past the trees, and spotted a camp. She had not bothered to suppress her presence, so the man should be aware of her.

She sensed that he was inside the tent he had set up.

She heard a deep laughter come from ahead of her. The tent opened and out came a muscular brutish looking man.

"Ghahaha, fresh meat delivered itself right to my door."

She rolled her eyes at the brute's words. "It seems you will not be cooperating then." She voiced out.

The man's grin widened. "Why would I cooperate when I have such a juicy meal in front of me?!"

"Good, I was looking to let off some steam, as it were." She said with a bewitching smile on her face.

Lalatina's analysis was correct, the man, Vega, held slightly less Energy than Moss did, though she did sense something odd about him. He did not seem quite Human, it seemed he had taken in the Factor of some Monsters and somehow mutated.

Arcueid was not certain what sort of abilities to expect from Vega. She did desire to capture him so she could not go all out and erase him from existence.

There were many ways to knock the man unconscious or bind him, even if he did have some unique abilities due to taking in a Monster Factor.

"Are you a subordinate of the Demon Lord of this territory?" Asked Vega.

She nodded. "I am one of Demon Lord Felix's subordinates."

Vega smirked, hearing her. "Good, then perhaps I can learn just how strong he is based on the strength of his subordinates."

She raised a brow at his cocky remark. She was suppressing the majority of her power, only allowing a small amount of it to seep out of her, so she supposed she could understand why this man thought he had a chance against her.

"Oh? Do you mean to perhaps… assault my Lord?" She asked, a dangerous hint to her tone.

Vega only laughed in response. "Exactly that! If he proves to be too weak, then I'll devour him whole."

She could feel cold rage pulse through her entire being. She would not allow such disrespect to her Lord.

She released her Demon Lord's Haki ever so slightly, causing Vega to gasp at the pressure. She appeared in front of Vega, who had fought off a fraction of her Haki.

Unfortunately, his reaction speed could not help him defend against her. She was simply far too fast for his perception.

She raised her hand and lowered it on Vega's left arm in a cutting motion, causing Vega to scream out in pain.

She would have normally killed him for the disrespect shown to her Lord, but she had not forgotten her priorities. Vega could be killed after he gave her Lord all the information he had. Now that she knew that Vega was here to kill her Lord or something similar, the likelihood of it being Cerberus that sent him here had gone up.

"You bitch! You'll pay for that!" Vega roared.

"My my, it is quite impressive that you have managed to hold yourself together under a fraction of my Demon Lord's Haki. Even if I was holding back." She commented.

She watched as his arm regrew.

How intriguing. He had a fairly powerful healing factor then. Her surprise only grew when the other half of his arm that she had chopped off also grew. In front of her, the arm regrew into a full body, good as new, other than the fact that it had no Ego to speak of and seemed to be a simple Monster in Human form.

In front of her now were two identical-looking men.

Vega looked at his other self with desire in his eyes. Before his Monster self could react and rampage around, Vega, the original, grabbed the shoulder of the Monster and began absorbing him.

"Come! Your power shall become mine!"

A moment later, the Monster that had grown from Vega's arm was no more, instead Vega's total Energy had risen by a very slight amount.

She quickly thought of all the possible reasons for such a thing. The most likely scenario was that Vega could gain a portion of the power of the beings he seemed to be able to consume.

His earlier comments about calling her a meal and devouring her Lord did align with that theory.

Her mind then went in another direction, those Monsters that grew from Vega's chopped off body parts, could they perhaps be used as Incarnation mediums?

Her Lord was not lacking in Magisteel, but any way to conserve resources was something that was her duty to pursue.

She would think about everything further once she had captured this intruder. She lowered her Thought Acceleration and quickly came up with a plan to disable Vega.

Spiritrons were known to disable lower levels of regeneration, which Vega had. The only individuals she knew of that had higher tier regeneration were the True Demon Lord class individuals, and this Vega was far from that.

While she was no master at manipulating Spiritrons, she had picked things up over her long life.

She converted her anger at this bug's insolence into Energy, and then focused her killing intent onto Vega.

She was quite impressed that Vega managed to stay standing with a bit of effort.

Her killing intent was enough to kill any below the A Rank with just her gaze alone.

She finally got serious and cut off all of Vega's limbs in a singular motion and halted his regeneration with chains laced with spirits she forced into submission before he could even scream, leaving him a simple torso.

She then placed a collar on him that is meant to inhibit the circulation of Magicules within the body, leaving Vega powerless.

Now, to inform her Lord about this, perhaps he will even praise her!

Spoiler: Arcueid

Story: I'm a Daemon, so what?

Chapter 62: Brahma

- Felix -

I tagged along with Rimuru as we made our way to the Laboratory in The Dungeon.

According to Diablo, the Daemons he had brought were now fully Incarnated and ready to serve.

I was somewhat curious as to who Diablo recruited. Arcueid, Lalatina, and Megumin recruited most of the notable members of their Lineage that could be useful. I imagine that Diablo also has some useful fellows under him that he makes use of.

I was somewhat interested to meet some other Daemons of the Black Lineage. That was the Lineage I was a part of, after all.

The only Daemons from my Lineage that I had met were Diablo, who was… a bit eccentric, and Berreta, who was a very serious but understanding Daemon.

"So, how many Daemons did Diablo recruit?"

"700." Responded Rimuru.

"That's quite a lot. Do you have any idea what you are going to do with them?"

Rimuru nodded. "Sort of. I was thinking of making an elite unit composed entirely of Daemons, Tempest's most elite attack force, the Black Numbers."

"Other than the chuuni ass name, that sounds like a good idea. You will definitely gain quite a lot of Arch Daemons after naming those Daemons, and each of those is a certified country destroyer. When they all work together in a proper cohesive fashion, it would make for a deadly force."

"Yeah, that's what I thought too. What exactly do you have your Daemons doing?" Asked Rimuru.

"I have them pretty split up. The more combat-oriented ones are under Megumin in the military, there is an elite unit filled with them and then I also have some Daemons as commanders of some squadrons and in other leadership positions in the army. Then the more administrative aligned ones are with Arcueid, and the ones more keen on assassination and information gathering are under Lalatina."

"I see. You got them working to their talents, huh?"

I nodded. "Yeah, though keep in mind that most of the Daemons are working under their respective Primordial; their natures and talents line up with that of their Primordials in a lot of cases. Megumin's dependents are all skilled and prefer direct combat. Arcueid's dependents are good at planning, scheming, and management. Lalatina's dependents are good at information gathering and discrete killings."

Rimuru gave me a look. "Discrete killings? Really?"

"Saying assassination over and over again is lame." I retorted.

"Sure. So how are those Otherworlders that wanted to serve you after you didn't kill them?" Asked Rimuru.

"I think they are doing pretty alright. Most of them joined the military and are currently undergoing Megumin's, let's say, laborious training." That girl's training may as well be considered torture for most, but those Otherwordlers are taking it without complaint. They had a chance to acquire real power, to make sure they weren't stripped of their freedom ever again, so they grabbed that chance with both hands and refused to let go.

"They are already pretty strong as most Otherworlders are, A Rank to Special-A, with some have already broken through into the so-called S Class Rank that Tempest coined."

S Class is what one was called when their EP was between 400,000 and 800,000 range, basically Disaster Class. My Daemon Duke subordinates were in this Rank, excluding Arcueid, Lalatina, and Megumin. Those three were in the Million Class, as well as a few other subordinates of mine.

Though those among the Otherworlders that were in S Class were at the very bottom of it, but Disaster Class is Disaster Class.

It was amusing to see that I had a Rank in Tempest's database. Catastrophe Class, a Ranking based not on just EP, but overall combat power. To be in this rank one needed to have combat power in the domain of the True Dragons, or at least approaching that domain.

It did boost my ego a bit, I was well aware that I was a bit prideful about my strength. Even if I basically cheated my way to my level of strength, I was still proud of what I had attained.

Odin is my power. Plus, if you aren't cheating, you aren't trying.

"I see. Well, it's good to see that those unfortunate souls are doing well." Said Rimuru.

"They are all eagerly training, wanting to create their future with their own hands."

According to Arcueid, none were at risk of turning traitors. All of them were extremely grateful to me for sparing them when I had no reason to, and then on top of that, freeing them from their bindings.

Oftentimes, desperate people latch onto the first hope they have, and they stay latched on. Though Arcueid still had them sign contracts as an extra measure

It didn't help that the benefits I offered were very good. Access to the rewards center where they can exchange points for higher level stuff like Arts, Spells, Sword Arts, and everything else in between. Then there was the good food they could order for a very low amount of points, and the paid vacation and days off they got.

I really was a good boss. Umu.

All of the benefits I offer are easily paid for, too. I wasn't lacking money. The vault I got from Clayman was still very, very full. Then there were the taxes that were collected, the tolls and various fees visitors had to pay, and then of course the trade that my territory partook in.

All in all, my territory was doing damn well for itself. I was even a bit proud, even if I didn't do the majority of the work.

"What about Kenya?" I asked.

"Kenya? What about him?" Rimuru asked, confused.

"Elmesia seemed to want to take him on as a student due to his potential to become a True Hero."

"Ah, that's right. How'd you know about that?"

"Elmesia brought it up to me."

Rimuru nodded. "I see. Well, I asked Kenya for his opinion, and he was eager to learn from Elmesia. It seems that hearing that Chloe had gone on her own adventure made him want to go on one of his own."

"Hmm, learning from Elmesia would do a lot for the kid. For one, he'd likely always have Elmesia and, by extension, Sorcerer's Dynasty Sarion in his corner. That's not even mentioned that Elmesia would likely make for a damn good teacher."

"Yeah, I'll have to have him escorted to Sarion sometime soon. He's been bugging me about it nonstop." Said Rimuru.

"I was planning to visit Sarion sometime. I can take him if you want." I offered.

Elmesia owed me multiple favors at this point as well. I wasn't sure what exactly to use them on, but perhaps visiting Sarion would give me some ideas.

"Really?! That would be great, then. Kenya seems to like you quite a bit, you know? Says that seeing a real Demon Lord in person was awesome." Rimuru said with a pout.

I chortled. "Ha! A real Demon Lord, huh?"

The hidden meaning was obvious, Kenya didn't see Rimuru as intimidating or anything that the title of Demon Lord should confer.

"I'll pick him up before I go then. Though I'm not exactly sure when that will be."

"That's fine. I'll keep building up his foundations until you are ready." Rimuru responded.

Before long, we arrived at the Laboratory.

Towards the back, I could see a bunch of Magisteel Golem Skeletons that were not being used. I'm assuming those are the extras.

"Lord Rimuru!" Diablo appeared in front of Rimuru, already kneeling before him.

"Diablo."

"I have taken the initiative to have the Daemons moved into the extra room." Responded Diablo.

Rimuru nodded. "Good, that room should be large enough for them to gather and for me to officially meet them all."

Diablo looked at me and nodded. "Lord Felix."

"Diablo."

I saw Dino working on something with Vesta off in the corner. He spotted me and waved, and I waved back.

"Did you want to come with me, Felix?" Asked Rimuru.

I nodded. "Yeah, not much else to do at the moment."

I also wanted to see if any of the Daemons Diablo recruited had or would develop any interesting Skills which Odin could analyze.

This was the best time to give all of them a scan since they were all together.

"Alright, follow me then."

Rimuru led me to the spare room attached to the Laboratory. When Rimuru was showing us around, he said that the room was created to test any of the larger and more destructive experiments, like massive War Golems and the like, so the room was pretty empty, but it was magically reinforced.

'Odin.'

'Acknowledged.'

I could feel Odin gathering the data for various Skills, various Common and Extra Skills, but none of the Daemons present had any Unique Skills bar one.

A single Daemon had a Unique Skill, which wasn't surprising. Most of Arcueid, Megumin, and Lalatina's Lieutenants had Unique Skills, but they were either Daemon Dukes or on the cusps of becoming a Daemon Duke. They had powerful Egos.

This Daemon, however, was a mere Greater Daemon from what I sensed. A mere Greater Daemon with a Unique Skill is unheard of in all but two cases, mine and the Old Man's.
The one thing we had in common was that we were reincarnated, and we had powerful Souls.

Could this Greater Daemon also be someone who reincarnated?

How interesting.

I zeroed in on the Greater Daemon with a Unique Skill. He was standing towards the front of the crowd of Daemons and was now looking at Diablo nervously.

If he is an Otherworlder, he may have had a bit of an ego, an ego that Diablo had to beat out of him. In that case, fearing Diablo a healthy amount was normal.

Diablo was a scary guy, after all.

" " "Lord Rimuru!" " " All the Daemons kneeled down at once.

Rimuru looked down at them nervously, while Diablo looked like a proud parent.

I'm sure he made them do that.

I did notice that all of the Daemons here were part of Diablo's Lineage. I guess he didn't want to recruit from other Lineages due to the potential conflicting loyalties.

"Uhhh. Thanks for deciding to serve me, I guess. Seeing as you are all here, I assume you all agree to the terms and conditions Diablo told you about, so I'll be naming you all now." Said Rimuru.

Since none of the Daemons spoke up, Rimuru took that as an agreement.

Rimuru walked to the front and began listing off names left and right.

I walked over to Diablo. "You see that Daemon there?" I pointed to the potential Otherworlder.

Diablo followed my finger and nodded. "Ah, that one? Yes? Is something the matter? If he displeases you, then as my master's best friend, I am more than willing to purge him for you."

"Ah, nothing like that. I was just a bit curious about him. He seems to have a Unique Skill, something definitely abnormal for a mere Greater Daemon."

Diablo nodded. "Indeed. That is what caught my interest in the first place. He was leading a group of 100 Lesser Daemons and Greater Daemons when I came across him. He challenged me to a fight in which he lost. He was arrogant, but when he saw the difference between us, he quickly submitted. He seemed to have potential, so I brought him with me in the hopes that he would be useful to Lord Rimuru."

I nodded. "I see. I'll have to talk to him later."

"It seems he has been named." Voiced out Diablo.

I nodded. "I heard, Venom, huh? Can you ask him to come see me once he wakes up from his Evolution?"

Diablo nodded. "As you wish."

"Tell Rimuru I'm going to hang out with Veldora and Ramiris. I've gotten bored just watching Rimuru name Daemons."

Diablo's lips twitched, but he nodded nonetheless. I took that as my cue to leave.

As I was leaving, I spotted Dino waving me over, and I walked over to him.

"Felix."

I raised a brow. "Dino, what did you need?"

Dino nervously rubbed the back of his head. "Well, I wanted to know how Milim was doing. The two of us aren't close like that so I always used to ask Ramiris about Milim, but from what I've heard, you and Milim are pretty close."

"Milim? Well, she's doing fine, I think. Frey has been making her do work, much to Milim's dismay, but she's getting it done. She may whine about it, but in the end, she will do what is best for her people."

Hearing me, Dino gained a smile on his face and sighed in relief. "I see."

"If you are really that curious, you can ask her yourself, you know. Milim is always open to making new friends. In fact, I'm pretty sure she already sees you as a friend somewhat."

Dino sighed once again. "Well, you're probably right." He muttered, his eyes dulling slightly as he looked down. I could sense numerous emotions in his tone, guilt, sadness, rage, and a bunch of other messy things.

I didn't want to get involved in that at all. Dino and I weren't close whatsoever. We weren't even friends.

The guy is billions of years old. I'm sure he can figure his own things out.

"Anyways, I'll see ya."

Dino nodded. "See you, Felix. Oh, and thanks… I appreciate it."

"No problem."

–

"Lord Felix? Lord Diablo said to visit you." I heard a somewhat hesitant voice call out.

I looked up from the book in front of me to Venom.

He looked down at the book. "Ah, I apologize for interrupting you, Lord Felix."

I waved him off. "No need to apologize, I was just messing around."

I was currently in the Laboratory Lounge, those scientists did need breaks from time to time, and they had pretty good food in the cafeteria.

I looked back down to the book. While I was waiting, I created a few Spells of mass destruction and wrote them down to possibly put into the Rewards Center.

These were Spells that I created entirely on my own without Odin's help, excluding the massive amount of magical knowledge I possessed due to Odin's analysis and understanding of the world.

One of the Spells I created was under the Ice Magic branch, it involved using Ice Magic to imitate a cold fusion reaction, creating a massive explosion of freezing energy that devastates a large area.

This can easily be scaled to continental levels of destruction.

Everyone needs a hobby, and one of mine just happened to be Spell Creation. I felt very accomplishing to create a powerful Spell on my own.

No matter how useful and overpowered Odin is, she did make it feel a bit too easy to do basically anything combat-related. It was hard to feel fulfilled. So, I made up for it with other things since I wasn't willing to risk my combat prowess on something like that. Playing music as well as things like creating Spells and such, made me feel like I did still have some magical know-how and wasn't entirely reliant on Odin's abilities.

I wasn't completely hopeless without her, which was something I could feel satisfaction in.

'Apologies.'

I sighed. 'No need to apologize, Odin. Without you, I know for a fact that I wouldn't be where I am today. I wouldn't be as happy and satisfied with my life as I am now. Sometimes, it's just nice to relax and create things with my own merit and understanding, to feel like I do deserve all this power I hold. No need to be so serious Odin. No matter what, know that I appreciate you.'

'...Acknowledged.'

'Good. No more pouting, don't deny it! I can hear it in your tone!'

'It is the Master's imagination.'

'Liar!'

Lately, I've felt like Odin has become more and more emotional, more and more expressive. She almost seemed… Human.

Something that terrified me as well as intrigued me. Terrified me due to what sort of connotations there could be when considering that Odin may gain an Ego of her own, and then excitement that maybe, just maybe, Odin could become something more. Who knows, maybe I could get a real partner.

Someone who knew my ins and outs, someone who knew me better than I knew myself. Someone who truly understood me and worked with me in all things.

Ah, that's basically a wife, isn't it?

'!!!!!'

Then there was the fear that what if whatever entity Odin becomes isn't as accommodating and loyal as Odin is, what if she becomes something that is no longer bound to me?

I was honest enough to admit that I was very reliant on Odin and her abilities, if such a thing happened… there would be problems, big problems.

Not to mention my emotional attachment to Odin. It may be stupid but I was emotionally attached to my Skill.

Who's gonna blame me? I'm a big bad Demon Lord. I can feel however I want to.

She was there from the start, as the mere Extra Skill: Sage. She was there at my literal lowest point as a Daemon. She was my constant companion. Any normal person would become attached, even if they were getting attached to an emotionless AI thingy.

But I knew those were just my inner doubts speaking. I find it best when I have these sorts of doubtful thoughts to just process them and debunk them rather than let them fester.

I knew I liked to maintain control and that I hoarded power, and I didn't want that kind of thing to get to my head. I had a lot of knowledge from my previous life. I knew it was a bad idea to let those kinds of things fester and corrupt your mind.

Honestly, if I dwelled on it too much, I might end up becoming a paranoid freak.

After all Odin has done for me, I'd be a damn bastard to doubt her now. She was loyal to me, the least I could do is trust in her at this point.

It may be a risk but sometimes a man just needs to say fuck it, we ball.

Heh, in the end, I guess I still retain some of my Humanity, even after everything I've done.

'Odin will never ever betray the Master.' She said softly.

'Hah, I know, I know, but it is normal to have thoughts like these, you know? But I don't doubt you. I want you to know that.'

'Affirmative. Even if the World stands against the Master, Odin will be by Master's side.'

I felt Odin's sense of satisfaction and affection.

Ah, I think my heart just skipped a beat. I guess Yanderes are my type.

Odin must have acquired my amazing flirting abilities from my memories! Man, I really am too good.

'.....'

'Deny it all you want! You know it to be true!!'

For now, I would leave it at that. I'll have to think more about what's going on with Odin later.

I stored the book in my Infinity Space and looked back up to Venom. Not even a moment passed since I looked back down at my book thanks to Thought Acceleration.

"Now I was interested in something about you. That was the entire reason I had Diablo send you to me."

Venom stood up straighter, in an almost military stance, as he awaited my question.

"Are you a reincarnated Soul?"

Venom's eyes widened.

"Y-Yes, sir!"

I nodded. "That's what I thought. There is no other way a Greater Daemon would have a Unique Skill; their Souls are too weak, and their Egos aren't developed enough."

"Y-You know about my Unique Skill?!"

"Of course I do. It seems fairly useful and can get you far as long as you train well."

Venom nodded. "That is what Lord Diablo said as well."

"Take his word for it. He is very experienced. Now, why don't you tell me a bit about yourself? There aren't many chances for me to talk to another reincarnated Daemon."

Venom nodded. "I do not recall much of my memories. I know I was raised in an orphanage and died before turning 16. Other than that, I just recall vague things about my life. I don't even remember how I ended up here."

"Hmm, well, that's unfortunate. That was all I was curious about. You are dismissed."

Venom bowed and then left. He seems like an alright person.

All of a sudden, I felt a Thought Communication coming from Arcueid.

"Sup Arcueid, what's up?"

"My Lord, I have captured an intruder that you may be interested in. He did not go through the proper procedures to enter your territory and made his intentions clear once I confronted him." Arcueid said smugly.

"Oh? Who is it?"

"He is known as Vega of Power, one of the three heads of Cerberus, the secret society from the Eastern Empire."

"Ah, Yuuki's goons then. I remember learning a bit about Vega."

"Hey Rimuru, I'm going to head back. Something came up."

"Sorta, but it's already been handled."

"See ya."

I made my way down to the dungeons where we kept our prisoners, not that we had many of them in the first place.

Any spies and such were interrogated by Lalatina and her subordinates and then used to send a message, keeping live prisoners was costly after all.

You would need to feed them, make sure they drank water and didn't kill themselves, and all that stuff. Plus, there was even the very unlikely chance they escaped, and that would only make a bigger mess.

The Unique Skill: Scavenger was incredibly busted, if Vega had the right resources he could climb to the peak of this world.

Scavenger allowed Vega to consume anything and gain their properties as well as a portion of their power.

It could even be used to consume weapons.

Heh, Odin has gotten better at accepting my compliments.

Take my power for his own, huh? If he could consume me, that plan of his would probably work. The thing is, he would never be capable of consuming me, not as I am now.

Well, Arcueid did meet the strength criteria to be a member of the Nine Sovereigns, though she would be at the bottom strength-wise if you ignored Ramiris and perhaps Dino since I'm not sure how strong he is when he is sealed.

Ah, so they are working off false information once again huh? I would have thought Granbell would have learned his lesson. I suppose he is getting desperate.

Those defenses of Luminous were top-notch. It is practically impossible for someone not on the Ultimate Awakened level to get through them, and Kagali is most certainly not at that level.

Thanks to the Soul Corridor that now existed between Milim and me, Odin was able to analyze and Copy Milim's Ear, a Skill that enhanced all of my hearing capabilities many fold. Even discrete conversations would be picked up, such as those that take place through Thought Communication. The dude was a traitor through and through. And I would have just sent back someone who could become troublesome in the future for no reason.

Beelzebuth.

Perhaps I was being too paranoid but it's fine.

It's not like I ever agreed to his deal in the first place. He just assumed I did.

In the end, Vega was just not worth the effort.

Arcueid walked up and stood beside me. "What will we do now, My Lord?"

When a surprise attack is no longer a surprise attack, the attackers are put in a rather disadvantageous position.

Arcueid nodded and looked down to where Vega used to be. "The man was a brute, but he did have some interesting abilities. His regeneration factor was interesting."

"Oh? For something to interest you it must be special. What was so special about Vega's regenerative abilities?"

He didn't have Self-Regeneration, Ultraspeed Regeneration, or Infinite Regeneration, so it must have something to do with his body.

'What can you tell me about his body Odin?'

'It is highly likely that the individual Vega was modified in some way. Each of his living cells can be considered a type of bacteria capable of being manipulated at will, giving Vega a viscous physiology similar to that of a Slime. His body has powerful regenerative abilities superior to even Ultraspeed Regeneration in some ways. If a significant enough mass of Bacteria is separated from the main body, it will start growing into an entirely new body similar to the fissiparity possessed by creatures like starfish.'

'So he is basically an infinite vessel generator.'

'...Correct.'

That aligns with what Laplace had said, though Laplace also said his cells held a corruptive influence, corrupting anyone who attempted to use one of his bodies as a vessel.

"I had cut off his arm, which he quickly regenerated, which was not odd as I hadn't used any preventive measures to halt regeneration. What I found odd was that the arm I cut off had grown an entire body of its own."

"As you will My Lord."

I snapped my fingers, teleporting to my room to grab a few things before I left.

'Notice. The Unique Skill: Creator has evolved into the Ultimate Skill: Brahma, Lord of Creation.'

I felt a change take place in my very Soul.

"Pffft, hahahaha!"

This… this is such a broken Skill.

'Good job, Odin, this is honestly amazing. Though I thought you said that it would take three months to evolve Creator?'

'Odin had said that it may take up to three months.'

'Semantics.'

'However, data from the Unique Skill: Scavenger has been incorporated into the Ultimate Skill: Beelzebuth, Lord of Gluttony. Thanks to this, the conversion of Yuuki Kagurazaka's Soul had become much more efficient. Odin was able to make use of 100% of Yuuki Kagurazaka's Saint Soul to evolve Creator into an Ultimate Skill, as well as incorporate data from other Skills.'

'Data from other Skills, huh? Yeah, I can see that.'

With Brahma, I feel like a whole new world has opened up to me!

A world of Creation!

Brahma was beyond broken. I was totally on a power high right now.

I held my palm upwards, and crimson red flames flickered above my palm.

I had created fire, and not just that this was a fire at the Ultimate level. Nothing would be able to block or get past this fire unless that was also on the Ultimate level. Even Magic would find itself incinerated by this fire if the Laws behind the Magic weren't well-developed enough.

'Affirmative. Odin used data from multiple Skills in the creation of the Ultimate Skill: Brahma, Lord of Creation, including data from Odin itself to optimize the process completely.'

'I see.'

The next sub-skill was Skill Duplication, which Odin was already capable of, it basically allows me to recreate Skills that I have the data for.

Next up was Skill Gifting which allowed me to grant any Skills to a target as long as they are compatible with the Skill. I was capable of this beforehand through Beelzebuth, but this allows me to grant Skills to those I don't even have a Soul Connection with, which Beelzebuth did not allow.

There is Creation, which allows me to Create practically anything as long as I have enough energy.

It was basically my Intrinsic Skill: Material Creation, but on absolute steroids.

I could create top-tier bodies for Spiritual Beings to inhabit. I could even create Equipment that easily reaches God Grade, and unlike those made through Material Creation, the Equipment made through Brahma matches if not surpasses naturally made God Grade Equipment.

If I buff the Equipment with Stardust, well they will be in a whole other league.

And earthly things weren't the only things I could create, I could create stars, solar systems, even galaxies and universes! Though I felt that creating any sort of celestial phenomena would be rather difficult due to the sheer energy cost.

Before I couldn't create an entirely separate Dimension with its own unique Laws of Nature, I had to have those Dimensions connected to another primary Dimension.

But now… now I could theoretically create an entirely new Dimension, one where I govern over and decide the Laws of Nature.

Souls weren't off limits either. I could theoretically recreate and potentially create Souls as I pleased, though creating Souls from scratch would have to wait until Odin acquires more data and understanding over the concept. For all I know, maybe I can't really create souls. Brahma didn't give me a guide about its limits and whatnot. That was for me to discover.

I could use any Unique Skill, Extra Skill, or Common Skill through this without having to recreate the Skill itself. Though in theory I could already do this as the way Skil Retrieval works is that it recreates a Skills effect by manipulating the Laws of the World manually. This basically just optimizes that process.

And since all these lesser Skills were being used through Brahma, an Ultimate Skill, they were also buffed to the Ultimate level by default without having to buff anything on my part.

And that wasn't all. I could even use all the Ultimate Skills Odin has analyzed through this sub-skill without recreating them, therefore not straining my Soul.

However, for some reason, this sub-skill only allowed me to make use of Skills that already existed or had been created.

'Affirmative. It was not possible to allow the Master to mix and match data to make use of conflicting Ultimate Skills at this point.'

'Still, you've done great work.'

'Appreciation.'

I could also only wield the Ultimate Skills at 70% of their full power. There had to be some catch after all, even if this was manually creating the effects of an Ultimate Skill, I could only do that to a certain extent. But this was still huge. I'll have much more adaptability in my fights with this. I was already getting excited to surprise Milim with this in our next spar.

My combat potential had quite literally just skyrocketed. My current self would destroy my 5 minutes ago self.

That goes to show how big a single upgrade can be.

This was way too much fucking power. I took a deep breath. I was already able to bend over the Laws of the World. This is no different.

'Notice. The sub-skill Infinity of the Ultimate Skill: Ouroboros, Lord of Infinity, has been modified.'

I could already feel the change. Brahma, Lord of Creation, makes it far easier for Odin to modify Skills now, it basically streamlines the process and has also basically allowed Odin to reach enlightenment.

Before, Infinity wasn't really an absolute defense, but that isn't too big of a deal. I had more defenses layered underneath it, so I don't need to worry if Infinity is ever broken through, which isn't all that hard to do for the top levels of this world.

But it seems Odin took that as a challenge. Now, Spiritrons aren't even capable of bypassing Infinity. Those attacks will now be subject to Infinity's Spatial effects.

I'm seriously loving all these new upgrades.

Now, enough hyping myself up. It's best if Rimuru and Luminous are informed of the situation as soon as possible.

Chapter 63: Spiritual Surgery

- Felix -

Now, enough hyping myself up. It would be best if Rimuru and Luminous were informed of the situation as soon as possible.

…

Well…

Before that….

I'm sure she has misunderstood the situation, but whatever.

"Come in, Lalatina."

The door opened, and in came my purple-haired Daemon.

"Master! Did you wish for me to service you~!?"

I shook my head. "Not now. I actually need you to do something for me."

Seeing that I was being serious, Lalatina straightened up and looked at me seriously.

"At your service, Master."

That's why I like Lalatina; she is a degenerate, but she doesn't let that get in the way of her duties.

"I hear you Luminous. I'll be careful."

Luminous nodded, a satisfied smile on her face. "I assume that one of the Factors you were able to acquire was the Storm Factor? You are rather close to the Lizard after all. I am not quite sure how such a thing is even done, but I imagine acquiring the Lizard's Factor is far easier than acquiring that of his sisters."

I nodded. "Yeah, there is the Storm Factor, the Frost Factor, and the… Star King Factor."

Luminous' lips twitched. "I am not even going to bother asking how you managed to acquire the Frost Factor, let alone the Star King Factor."

"Well, I'll answer you anyway. I managed to get some hair from Velzard, and through that, a Skill of mine was able to analyze her Factor and recreate it. As for the Star King Factor, well, Milim and I have a Soul Corridor, through that a Skill of mine was able to analyze the Star King Factor."

Luminous raised a brow. "A Skill of yours, hmm?"

I nodded. "Yup, a Skill of mine."

She rolled her eyes. "Very well, if you do not wish to share, then so be it. But since when did you and Milim Nava have a Soul Corridor?" Luminous asked with a pout.

"Not too long, we established one during the Chaos Dragon's attack."

"Very well then." Said Luminous, straightening up. Her tone suddenly became more serious. "Let us establish one then."

I froze for a moment and looked Luminous in the eye. "Seriously? You should know such a thing isn't done lightly."

Through the Soul Corridor I could easily analyze all of Luminous's Skills, though I already analyzed all the Skills she had. Not only that, it was possible to interfere with the other person to a certain extent. You shouldn't establish a Soul Corridor with someone you don't have the utmost faith in.

"I know what I said." Responded Luminous.

"Alright then." I wasn't really worried, in the worst case Odin can protect me from any harmful effects that could be sent through the Soul Corridor, though I didn't think Luminous would do anything like that.

I felt Luminous reach out to me on a Spiritual level.

'Odin.'

'Affirmative. A Soul Corridor has been established with the individual Luminous Valentine."

I could feel the connection between the two of us now, and going by the smile on Luminous's face, she could feel it as well.

"There, happy now?"
Luminous nodded like a child who had gotten what they wanted. "Indeed, I am."

At least now it will be a lot easier to keep in contact with Luminous, and if Granbell and Kagali attack while I'm not here and place a Barrier preventing Thought Communication, then Luminous can always use the Soul Corridor between us to communicate.

"Alright, enough cuddling, Saeko. I do want to get up at some point today."

Saeko pulled back with a pout on her face, clearly reluctant, but relented nonetheless.

Once she was off me, I sat up with my back against the headboard.

"So, what have you two been doing the past two days?"

Luminous cringed slightly. She coughed into her hand. "Saeko had wished to surprise you with a meal."

I could already see where this is going.

"Ah, I see. I'm sorry you had to go through that Luminous."

Hearing me, Saeko's pout was magnified ten fold. "I am getting better!"

I nodded. "Yeah, you're self-aware now, for one! Before, you didn't even see an issue with how your food looked! Progress is progress, Saeko, and I really mean this, I am looking forward to eating one of your perfected meals."

Hearing me, a beautiful smile bloomed on her face. "Yes, Felix-sama! I shall go and practice now!"

And with that, Saeko left the room.

"She truly does adore you." Luminous said as she looked at the door.

A small smile formed on my face. "I know she does."

"Hmph. I do not know what goes on in that Oni's mind. Your insistent teasing is very bothersome. I do not know how she deals with it on a regular basis." Said Luminous.

"Hah! Well, you're the only one I bulli cough mean tease."

Luminous gave me a side-eye before rolling her eyes.

"Also, were you guys seriously drinking while I was in a pseudo-coma state?" I asked with dry eyes.

"Do you expect us not to enjoy ourselves when we have the opportunity?" Asked Luminous.

"I never said that, but seriously, you couldn't have waited for me?! I want to get wasted too!"

A smirk formed on Luminous' face. "We can arrange that later."

I nodded. "Good! I'll hold you to that!"

Luminous took a seat at the end of the bed. "You now have Anti-Skill, correct?"

I nodded. "Yeah, I do."

"Very well, rest first, and then we can free Chloe and Hinata." Said Luminous.

"Nah, I don't need any rest. I can go grab Rimuru, and we can take care of all this now."

Luminous glared at me. "Rest, one does not undergo Spiritual Surgery lightly, rest well, and then we will speak about the next step."

"Geez, fine, mom."

Luminous nodded, seemingly satisfied.

"Now, I will leave and allow you to rest uninterrupted. Before I leave, I will call Gunther to come and clean this mess." Said Luminous.

I nodded. "Got it, thanks."

Luminous nodded and got up off the bed. "Gunther." She called out.

Gunther appeared from the shadows and bowed. "Yes Mistress."

"Clean this mess up." Said Luminous.

Gunther nodded. "As you wish."

A moment later, all the leftover trash all over the floor was picked up and Gunther was gone.

Luminous turned to give me one last look. "Rest well Felix." And with that she walked out, though was it just me or did her hips have a bit of a sway?

Well I wasn't going to complain, I definitely appreciated the view.

Just as Luminous walked out the door, she turned around again and gave me a smirk, before closing the door. It seems she noticed my gaze on her backside.

I laid back down on the bed and closed my eyes.

'Exactly how much stronger am I now Odin?'

'The Master's physical capabilities have increased by multiple magnitudes, the Master's durability is now likely on par with that of the True Dragons.'

What the hell?! Seriously?!

'Affirmative.'

Even before I gained these Dragon Factors, I had one hell of a physique, to the point that I could casually tank a hit that surpassed the speed of sound just with my body alone, but even back then, I'm fairly certain Guy had a better Physical Body than me, his Deathman body was made out of the corpses of around a million High Humans after all.

Then, of course, Milim has a superior Physique compared to me. She inherited her Dragon Factor from Veldanava herself, and Dragons were always known for their powerful bodies.

Though that wasn't a very big deal, I'm not much of a physical fighter after all, and I can always reinforce my body with my Aura and Magicules further strengthening it, but a better base is always helpful.

Now I have an even stronger body, one on par with the bodies of the True Dragons. I think that's more than enough to measure up to those two in the Physical Body department.

True Dragons are seriously busted if their Factors alone buffed me to this point, though I did need three of them.

'Along with that the Master's Physical Body's improvements, the Master's Spirit and Soul have been strengthened.'

My Soul has been strengthened? I don't feel any difference other than the obvious increase of power, but feeling the strength of my Soul would be a bit difficult to do.

'Does that mean I can handle more Ultimate Skills now?'

'Affirmative.'

Huh, well that's neat. I don't plan to recreate any Ultimate Skills since I can already use all of the Ultimate Skills I have data on through Brahma, but the extra room in my Soul may come in handy in the future.

'The Master's internal Energy has also grown by a significant portion, Magicule Capacity, and Magicule Output have grown significantly. The Master's Magic Power, Aura, and various other energies have improved in quality and in strength.'

That's not too surprising, but still, my Magicule Capacity and Magicule Output increased by multiple times? I was expecting such a thing, and I'm still surprised by just how much it increased. I couldn't get an exact estimate, but I could feel the difference between the current me and my former self from before the Dragon Factors were integrated into me.

'What is my total EP now?'

'The Master's total Existence Points is at 73,834,234 and will continue rising until it stabilizes.'

Well, that's not as large of a gain as I thought I would get, at least when compared to how much stronger my physical constitution got.

But I shouldn't complain; that's still about a gain of 30,000,000 EP, more EP than all my direct subordinates have combined, and it still hasn't stabilized. When compared to that, I went up by a pretty tidy sum, so there is no need to be too greedy.

'Query, would the Master like Odin to reactivate Satanael at 40% of its total power?'

What. The. Fuck.

'You're telling me my EP is as high as it currently is, and Satanael isn't even active?!'

'Correct. Odin had disabled Satanael in order to prevent any unforeseen situations from arising while Odin granted the Master the Dragon Factors.'

I take everything I said earlier about my EP not going up enough back.

'Not yet Odin.'

'Affirmative.'

If my current EP is over 70,000,000, then I have no clue just how high it would get with Satanael added to the mix. I would likely easily surpass Veldora's 88,000,000, though I'm not quite sure if I'd surpass Milim's base EP if she stops suppressing her power. Even Odin isn't quite sure how strong she would be if she truly let loose.

But, this has quite literally been the most amount of raw Energy I have gained at a single time… ever.

Even my Harvest Festival didn't give me as much raw Energy as gaining the Dragon Factors did.

I was seriously going to get a big head with all this power in my hands. More Energy than I know what to do with, Brahma, which allows me to bend the concept of Creation over my knee. Even other Dimensions aren't off-limits for me.

I really got lucky with my isekai adventure, didn't I?

'Affirmative.'

Hah, even Odin thinks so.

I seriously want to go and test this new power I got out, especially the new abilities I now have access to from the Dragon Factors, but Luminous was right. I should take some rest and let my power stabilize as much as possible.

- Kagali -

She took in the information Tear provided her with a calm look on her face, but internally, a storm was raging.

What did that damn buffoon get into now?!

"And the guards were unable to learn anything?" She asked.

Tear shook her head. "No, they weren't. I did some digging around myself but whoever did this covered their tracks pretty darn well. Though something to note is that the bases under his purview have been ransacked, though nothing was there that could lead back to us."

Kagali sighed.

Vega's death was a large loss in manpower. The man may have been an idiot and an uncivilized monkey, but Kagali would give him one thing, he was strong.

The entire reason she put up with him was due to his pure brute force would have been a useful distraction while she and Tear snuck into Demon Lord Valentine's palace to obtain the Hero.

And now he was dead, killed by an unknown force, and for unknown reasons.

"I see, thank you Tear."

Tear bowed and left the room, leaving Kagali to her thoughts.

Kagali's mind wandered to the possible people responsible for Vega's death. The list was fairly large. Vega had made a fairly large amount of enemies in his free time back in the Eastern Empire. It could even be an enemy of Cerberus, and Vega was merely the easiest target.

Perhaps some of his enemies saw an opportunity to kill him in the Western Nations and took it.

And Kagali did not doubt it was an assassination, a hole in the back of his head, and a suicide note?

It was like the killers weren't even trying to hide the fact that he was a targeted assassination. Not to mention, it was done in a way that prevented his regeneration from taking effect. There was something truly odd about this situation. She couldn't help but get worried that she was missing something.

There was the more troubling possibility. The possibility that Vega was assassinated by one of her personal enemies, she had kept a fairly low profile, and so she had not made many enemies, and if she did, they did not know of her.

The only ones who could possibly know about her and also be considered her enemies are Demon Lord Rimuru, Demon Lord Felix, and possibly Demon Lord Valentine, the very people they were planning against.

In which case, that suggested a far more dire situation, that perhaps those three knew of her plans against them, and this was either their way of warning her off or of getting rid of a threat before it became one.

Kagali sighed. She simply did not possess enough information about the situation to come to an accurate conclusion.

At the very least, Kagali was confident in their combat power, especially since Granbell Rosso had said he would be calling back the Guardian of the West to assist in their plans.

The Guardian of the West was a being that could hold off all the Daemons of the Ice Continent single-handedly. Even she, in her prime, was incapable of that.

Kagali imagined that only the true legends could do something similar… Guy Crimson, Milim Nava, the True Dragons, and the First Hero, Rudra.

Razul should be enough to deal with their enemies should the worst happen, and they show up in the midst of their operation.

As she was deep in her thoughts, she heard a knock on the door.

"Come in." She called out.

The door opened, and she turned to see who it was that was interrupting her and was surprised to see Damrada.

"Damrada. You usually do not leave your area. Did something happen?" She asked.

Damrada shook his head. "I heard that Vega has been killed?"

Kagali nodded. "Indeed."
"And it was from a hole in the back of his head?" Damrada asked.

Kagali nodded. "Indeed, do you know something about that?"

"I do not know who could be responsible for Vega's death, but I am fairly certain that I know what was used to kill Vega." Said Damrada.

Kagali raised a brow. "Oh? Well, I suppose that information could be useful when searching for who the killer is."

"I believe that it was a gun that was used to kill Vega," Damrada states.

Kagali's eyes widened slightly before a look of realization came across her face. "I see. I suppose that would match, wouldn't it? I had not considered such a thing due to the possible traces a gun would leave. Those traces were not found this time."

When a gun powered by Magicules is used, the Magicule Bullet leaves a residue that was not present at the scene of Vega's death. Even the Eastern Empire had not found a way to get rid of the residue altogether.

"That does paint a rather bleak picture. Guns are not very common in the West. In fact, they are almost unheard of, which means the likely suspect is…."

"The Eastern Empire." Damrada finished.

"There are other possibilities, but the Eastern Empire is the biggest suspect." Kagali stated.

"What do you know of your home country?" She then asked.

Damrada was a merchant originating from the East. He is one of the biggest reasons Cerberus was able to establish itself so quickly and find such success, if anyone knew something, it would be Damrada.

Damrada looked thoughtful for a moment. "It is well known that the Eastern Empire is looking to expand; perhaps they have built up enough forces, and they are simply getting rid of people they see as possible threats to their invasion. It would be a different approach than the standard for the Eastern Empire, but that only goes to show that the Eastern Empire is taking the threat of the West very seriously if they are resorting to subterfuge."

Kagali nodded. "I see. Thank you for the insight, Damrada."

Taking the dismissal for what it was, Damrada left.

- Damrada -

As he left the room Kagali was inside, he began to wonder what Kondou was up to.

The odds that First Lieutenant Kondou was behind Vega's death were fairly high. He didn't doubt Kondou's ability to acquire information about many things going on in the West; he had all of the Double 0 Digits except for Damrada himself under his command, and he was willing to complete any orders.

Each of them was a Complete Saint. Not many could hide information from beings as powerful as them, especially when each of the Double 0 Digits possessed Alternative, giving them the bare minimum authority to fight against an Ultimate Awakened.

Damrada also knew guns were circulating in the West. He was the one that distributed them after all, so there was a chance that Vega's killer was from the Western Nations and was simply armed with a gun.

But Damrada felt that would be too convenient. For Vega to be taken out, just a little bit before their plan would finally take place?

No, Damrada suspected there was something more that was occurring behind the scenes, and he simply did not have enough information to determine everything.

What he had told Kagali earlier was not a lie. He truly thought that perhaps the Eastern Empire had changed tactics. After their failure against Veldora, they were finally taking the West seriously, taking out the larger threats one by one before the big invasion.

If so, Damrada could only praise Emperor Rudra's foresight.

Now, if only his Emperor would stop messing up his plans, but Rudra never liked to make anything easy for him.

At least Vega was finally taken out. Damrada had not seen him for some time. According to some of Vega's subordinates, Vega had been bunkered up in his base and waiting for orders like a good dog.

It seems like he went on a stroll and was put down. Damrada could not find it within himself to care.

He personally no longer cared for the success of Kagali's plans. His only goal after all this planning was to hopefully get in contact with the Masked Hero and get a measure of her as a person.

From there, he could figure out how to convince her to be his final countermeasure against Emperor Rudra, should his Emperor lose to Michael. But that was all dependent on if he managed to successfully make contact with Chronoa.

- Felix -

I yawned as I opened my eyes. That's enough rest for me now.

I sat up with my back against the headboard. I was still in the room Luminous let me stay in.

'How long was I out for?'

'Approximately 10 hours.'

I took one hell of a nap, but I can't find it in myself to be disappointed at the loss of time. Sleep is great, after all.

Besides, I have eons ahead of me. What's 10 hours compared to that?

Now, why don't I experiment with my new powers a bit? I could sense two distinct abilities within me, the ability I got from the Storm Factor and then the ability I got from the Frost Factor.

'What is the ability of those with the Star King Dragon Factor?'

'The Star King Dragon Factor increases the Master's control over Stardust dramatically.'

'I see.'

Well, I'll think about that later, then.

'Tell me about the abilities from the Frost Dragon Factor and the Storm Dragon Factor.'

'Affirmative. The Intrinsic Ability of the Frost Dragon Velzard and those with her Factor is Deceleration. The ability to slow down anything the Master wishes or bring anything to a complete halt.'

The ability to slow down or halt, huh? It is sort of similar to Infinity, at least if you squint your eyes. I could already think of a few uses for this new ability.

At least with this, I think I know what Aspect of Reality Velzard represents.

The True Dragons are each embodiment of an Aspect of Reality, that concept given form, they will continue to be reborn as long as the concept they embody continues to exist.

I'm not quite sure what Veldora embodies, but I'm leaning towards Chaos itself. It could be why he has a hard time staying still and staying in one place, as well as his random desires to bring about mass destruction.

Of course, his nature doesn't influence him as long as he fights it off, as proven by his peaceful residence in Tempest.

In the past, Veldora simply had no reason to fight his nature.

While Veldora might be Chaos, I think Velzard is Deceleration, the very embodiment of Deceleration.

What a terrifying woman.

If I imbue this effect into an attack and hit someone with it, then I could likely completely stop the circulation of Magicules within their body, basically crippling them. I could instantly bring the surrounding temperature down to absolute zero, slow down enemies,

'Notice. Odin will begin coming up with effective ways to make use of Deceleration.'

'Got it. Now, what about the ability I got from Veldora's Factor?'

'The Intrinsic Ability obtained from Veldora Tempest's Factor is Divider. Divider is the power to cut through anything in the World. It is possible for the Master to imbue the power of Divider into themselves or Equipment.'

A very useful ability. It would enhance my piercing and cutting power by a lot if it really could break through anything.

The abilities I gained from the Dragon Factors aren't the only gain I got. Of course, there is also the True Dragon Magic I now have access to.

There is Veldora's Storm Magic, which can be very powerful if used well. Rimuru even created an Art using Storm Magic.

He calls it Storm Break. Rimuru uses the Sword Art Melt Slash and combines it with Storm Magic rather than Disintegration. It seeps into the target's body and corrodes them from within. It's different from Melt Slash by nature alone, but it's just as effective.

I already knew quite a bit about Storm Magic thanks to Veldora, Velzard's True Dragon Magic; however I did not know nearly as much about.

But from what I understand, it is very powerful. It can be used to easily buff any casually used Ice Magic to the Ultimate level.

Even now, I could easily create a Blizzard that could freeze a Spiritual Lifeform in an instant, their Soul included.

Velzard's Frost Magic is very suited to AoE attacks.

I decided to test one of the abilities I gained thanks to the Dragon Factors of Veldanava, Velzard, and Veldora. I grabbed one of the pillows behind me and chucked it up into the air.

I watched as the pillow fell back down towards me.

'Deceleration'

The pillow came to an almost complete stop.

I had slowed the pillow down to a point that it seemed like it wasn't even moving, similar to what my Infinity does to incoming attacks, though slightly different in nature.

No wonder Velzard has Gabriel, Lord of Patience. She must have been very compatible with it.

I loosened my hold of the pillow and allowed gravity to take complete hold of it once again.

Now that my basic experimentation was done, I got out of bed and grabbed my coat from the chair next to me.

Once my coat was on, I opened the door and began walking through the halls of Luminous' palace.

I passed by one of Luminous' maids who ran off, presumably to tell Luminous that I am awake.

I could sense both Saeko and Luminous in the palace, so they were at least both present.

It didn't take me long to hear the sound of Luminous's footsteps, I stopped in my tracks, waiting for her to catch up.

Once she was right next to me, I turned to greet her with a nod. "Luminous."

She gave me an enchanting smile that caused me to freeze for a moment. "Felix." A smug smirk formed on her face as she saw my expression.

I shook my head. "Did you need something Luminous?"

She raised a brow. "I am simply checking on one of my honored guests."

I nodded. "Fair enough."

She huffed and locked her elbow with mine. "Come, let us take a stroll."

I looked at her in confusion. "A stroll? Sure I guess."

Luminous began leading me around her palace, I assume she was taking me somewhere. "What's Saeko been up to?"

She huffed and looked at me with a pout. "You have a woman such as me in your arms, and you are still thinking of another woman?"

I rolled my eyes at her obvious teasing, I doubt Luminous cared that much. "Sorry my lady, I will endeavor not to commit such a cardinal sin in the future."

Luminous looked at me with a haughty smile. "Good, my subject, your loyalty must be to your mistress first!"

"Fufufufu." Luminous laughed as she covered her mouth.

"It wasn't that funny."

She slapped my arm. "Hush you."

"Aye, aye."

It didn't take long for us to reach our apparent destination. "A garden, huh?" I voiced out.

Luminous nodded and pulled me towards a small circular table with two chairs.

"Indeed, I enjoy spending time here occasionally. It helps me relax." Said Luminous.

I laughed at that. "Aren't you always relaxing, you NEET?"

Luminous pouted hearing me. "I am not a NEET. I am a Goddess!"

"Being a Goddess and a NEET are not mutually exclusive." I retorted.

A certain Hikki NEET that I recall from Japanese Mythology would also agree.

Luminous ignored me and took a seat at the table, I sat across from her.

I took a good look around the garden. There were various plants that increased the Magicule concentration in the area and some plants that promoted relaxation. When Magic exists, you can bet that there are many abnormal plants that also exist.

Most of the plants in Luminous' garden have been mutated by Magicules in some way.

"Impressive garden you have here."

"I have spent centuries building it up. If it was mediocre, it would shame my status." Responded Luminous.

"Yeah, yeah, noble etiquette and whatnot. So what have you and Saeko been doing while I was out?"

Luminous tilted her head. "Saeko told me some stories."

"Stories?"

Luminous nodded with a mysterious smirk on her face. "Yes, stories. After that, she wished to practice cooking, so I led her to the kitchen." Luminous' face took on an ugly look, making me sympathize with her.

Saeko's cooking tasted excellent, but it sure as hell did not look good.

"I see. I'm sorry you had to go through that."

"She said she could cook with such confidence that I was not expecting the dish I had received, but no, she had served me some monstrosity that somehow tasted divine!" Luminous said, completely flabbergasted.

"You ate it?!"

"Indeed, despite how it looked, I was willing to give it a try, the texture was absolutely horrid, but in the end it was a decision I do not regret. As I said earlier, it tasted absolutely fantastic, it is just the appearance that leaves a lot to be desired." Said Luminous.

I nodded. "Yeah, that would be the work of one of Saeko's Unique Skill's sub-skills, Certain Outcome."

Luminous nodded. "I thought so. Certain Outcome is a very very powerful Skill, one can completely dominate the Laws of the World and leave everyone else helpless."

I nodded. "Yeah, it's busted."

Even Odin said it was a Skill that had the possibility to threaten me if it evolved into an Ultimate Skill and Saeko gains enough experience, and energy. The last part was key, and at this point Saeko would need well over 20,000,000-30,000,000 EP to have a chance at threatening me with Certain Outcome.

Luminous sighed. "It had gotten to a point where my chefs were attempting to replicate Saeko's dishes out of amusement!" Luminous bemoaned. "I had to stop them before Saeko's dishes ruined the food culture I had developed in my palace!"
"Heh, it's just like Saeko to ruin something you've spent centuries perfecting. She is a fun girl." I commented.

Luminous nodded with a twitch of her lips. "One of the Seven Great Nobles foolishly decided to try out her food, believing his Undead nature enough to counteract the effects of Saeko's poison, but now he will have to lay in bed for at least a month… somehow."

Before Luminous could respond Saeko walked into the garden while rolling a cart.

…Ah, so she made us food then. Well, I guess I'll just have to cross my fingers and hope she magically improved her cooking.

"I am glad you are awake, Felix-sama!" Saeko greeted.

"Haha, yeah, I'm glad to be up and around again." I glared at Luminous. "Someone, I don't know who, demanded I rest more."

Luminous hmphed and turned away.

Saeko nodded. "You may not have liked it, but it was for your own good."

"Yeah, yeah, I know, I'm just joking."

Saeko rolled the cart next to us. "I have prepared a meal for you, Felix-sama!"

"Do I just not exist anymore, Saeko?" Asked Luminous.

"Ah, right! For you, too, Luminous!" Saeko responded.

Luminous rolled her eyes, but there was a good-natured smile on her face.

Huh, I guess those two got along while I was asleep, well, that's good.

Saeko placed two plates on the table, one for me and one for Luminous, before serving tea to both of us.

I gave the tea an inquisitive look.

"This looks fine." I voiced out.

I carefully took a sip of the tea and was pleasantly surprised. "Huh, this is actually pretty good, Saeko. You made this?"

Saeko beamed at me proudly. "Yes Felix-sama!"

"Well, look at that. You can improve more!"

Luminous nodded. "At first, her cooking was atrocious; she relied on her Skill as a crutch, but I ordered some of my chefs to teach her, and it seems she had benefited from their teachings."

I looked at Luminous weirdly. "Huh, well, that's odd. Whenever Shuna tried to teach Saeko, it didn't really amount to much. Maybe Shuna was a bit too soft on her? They are childhood friends."

Saeko then served us the main dish for the evening, it was incredibly basic, but it was very homely.

It was a good ol' sandwich.

It was a pretty basic sandwich, with some sliced meat and some condiments. In fact, you could say even a 5-year-old wouldn't fail at making this, but Saeko lives to surprise one's expectations.

I took a bite of the sandwich and was impressed. "Wow, this is good stuff, Saeko." I complimented.

"Hehe, thank you!" Responded Saeko.

Luminous and I quickly finished our sandwiches.

I looked Luminous in the eye. "Now I think that's enough messing around, let's get Rimuru and deal with Chronoa, the sooner we get this over with the better."

Luminous nodded, a serious look forming on her face.

"Very well, I will meet you in my Inner Sanctum."

I nodded. Well, no better time than now, I guess.
