Chapter 66: Chronoa Unleashed!

- Felix -

As Luminous left and began making her way towards the seal in the burial chamber in Night Garden, I turned to Saeko.

"I am ready to assist Felix-sama!" Declared Saeko.

I shook my head. "Not this time, Saeko. I'll be honest, this fight is above your weight class, I don't want to be looking behind my back to make sure you aren't hurt, so it would be best if you stayed behind."

It was harsh, but it was the truth. If Chronoa could seal Veldora, then Saeko stood no chance. She likely wouldn't even be able to help much if a fight did happen. I'd rather not place her in danger when I wasn't certain about if I could guarantee her safety.

Saeko's lips quivered, making me wince slightly before she gained a determined look on her face.

"Very well, Felix-sama! B-But if in the future if I am strong enough, could I fight by your side and for you?" Asked Saeko.

That's my Saeko.

"Of course, in fact I'd be honored if you fought by my side or fought for me."
Saeko firmly nodded. "Yes! Then, I shall begin training my abilities! Luminous had already offered to train me if I wished for it!"

I raised a brow hearing that. "Is that so? I'll have to thank her for that, then. But I suggest taking her up on her offer. She is strong and has much to offer."

Saeko nodded. "I will!"

I smiled upon hearing that. "Good, if you need anything, let me know. We may have different fighting styles, but I'm sure I can help you."

A giddy expression appeared on Saeko's face. "Ah! Training with Felix-sama! Hehehe."

"I'll teleport you back to Azeroth now."

Saeko came back to reality and nodded. "I will begin my training immediately!"

I nodded. "Good luck." I snapped my fingers, teleporting Saeko back to my palace.

It's good that she didn't take my words too harshly. She instead used them to motivate her further.

As long as Saeko applies herself, I'm sure she will become incredibly powerful. She has a lot of untapped potential, which is something Odin agreed on.

Though it still amuses me to no end that Saeko insists on adding sama to the end of my name, that isn't even a thing in this world!

It started back when I first met her when she wasn't even a Kijin. She, Benimaru, Hiiro, Shuna, and some other Ogres wanted to hear a bit more about my world. The honorifics had come up, and Saeko had taken to adapting them when she referred to me.

Everyone is always confused when she refers to me with sama until I explain it to them, but she wouldn't be Saeko if she wasn't head strong and followed her desires. With the way she is, I have no doubt that she will eventually acquire an Ultimate Skill of her own.

- Saeko -

She looked around in wonder as she appeared back in Felix-sama's territory.

No matter how many times she saw and felt it, it always left her in awe of how he was capable of traveling such vast distances in an instant.

Felix-sama truly was the best!
Now, if only she could have been more helpful to him.

Felix-sama had said she was not powerful enough to be useful to him in combat. She was his secretary! If she couldn't take care of the riff-raff that challenged him, then she shouldn't be her secretary! And she refused to give that coveted possession up to anyone! Not even to Sukuna!

She was currently in her room in Felix-sama's palace. She wanted to work on improving herself immediately, so she made her way to the training Dimension Felix-sama had made specifically for his direct subordinates.

She briefly nodded to the various maids who were maintaining the palace. She respected them for the job they did, even if Raiden could do what they did in an instant.

She looked out of the window in one of the halls. There was an artificial waterfall Felix-sama wanted created, he wanted a better view for when he was in his office, and so his subordinates quickly got to work.

It was quite beautiful, in Saeko's opinion.

It was quite simple and efficient as well. All that the construction workers needed to do was place some runes that utilize the Magicules in the air, and then a Magic Circle that converts the Magicules into water and sends it out in the form of a large stream, making an artificial waterfall.

The water was even completely drinkable.

She turned away and continued walking through the halls.

She would have to check on Dagura, Ryura, and Debura after getting some training in. On her orders, they had been training themselves and a small portion of troops in her place. Each of them were seemingly volunteers who wished to serve her directly.

The three sons of Dagruel had received regular training from her and then passed on her training to the volunteers who wished to serve her. Dagura, Ryura, and Debura were each above the Demon Lord Seed level at this point.

The volunteers who wished to serve her named themselves the Purple Guards, and approximately 1,500 Majin were part of the Purple Guards.

From what she had heard most of the members had caught a glimpse of her during her occasional training sessions that she did in the military training facility or during her patrols, while others were from her time back in the Ogre Village.

The ones from the Ogre Village were the ones that had wanted to serve Felix-sama. He did make quite the name for himself when he was staying with them back then, and they simply decided to serve her due to their familiarity with her.

She could only praise their wisdom for choosing to serve Felix-sama.

But in the end, she did not particularly care for their reasons for serving her, as long as they were willing to serve Felix-sama and, by extension, her to the best of their abilities, then she was satisfied. The only order she had given so far was to get strong in order to be of use to Felix-sama, and from what she had heard, they were fulfilling her order.

None were below the B Rank, and some had even managed to climb all the way up to A Rank.

She resolved herself to check on them later, and perhaps increase their training if necessary. If they were going to be representing her, then they must be the best they can possibly be.

Perhaps she would ask Felix-sama if he would be willing to give them names as rewards for their training. Raiden had done something similar for her Battle Maids, and according to her, their growth had skyrocketed due to that.

But she would think about them further later. Now, she was on a mission, and she would not be stopped!

One thing she did notice was that she could not sense any of Felix-sama's other direct subordinates in the palace. Usually, at least Arcueid would be present.

"Moss." She called out. Thanks to Moss's Body Double Skill, he could be found pretty much everywhere in the palace. Simply calling out for him was usually enough for him to appear before her.

The strongest Daemon, barring the Primordials and Felix-sama, appeared before her.

"Lady Saeko." He greeted her with a shallow bow.

She nodded. "Moss, where is everybody else?"

"Each of them is training." Moss said as if the words training were foreign to his mouth.

How odd.

"Oh! So they wish to also be more useful to Felix-sama! Umu! I see, thank you, Moss."
Moss bowed once more before vanishing.

She continued on her way to the training Dimension. If the others were also training, then maybe she could have a training partner!

Once she was in the training Dimension, she paused. She could sense the raging Magicules all around. The Magicules in the air of this Dimension had seemingly been stimulated very recently.

She could sense various Auras all around the Dimension, some clashing against another.

The very land present in this Dimension was shaking, but the Dimension was still holding firm.

She made her way towards Megumin, who was sparring with the weakest being present in this Dimension.

She crouched slightly before leaping upwards, breaking the sound barrier in the process. Then, she used some of the Energy she had available to her to take flight.

It didn't take her long to reach Megumin, who was sparring with Carrion.

In Saeko's eyes, Carrion was not very impressive. He was one of Felix-sama's weakest direct subordinates and used to be one of Felix-sama's political equals, something in her eyes Carrion did not deserve. He was far older than Felix-sama and did not even achieve a fraction of what Felix-sama had. Though Felix-sama insisted on being modest saying that someone else was doing all the hard work for him, which Saeko did not believe.

But the past was the past. She could be a very forgiving girl. Umu!

Megumin looked up towards her as she slapped Carrion into another mountain. "Oh, Saeko!" Megumin called out, her voice full of energy.

She descended to the ground. "Megumin, I wish to join you in training."

A large grin formed on Megumin's face. "Haha, sure! You can also help me train Carrion up to par! We can even bring in Ingvild!"

Before Saeko could respond, a massive Aura erupted from the direction of the mountain Carrion had been flung into. Rocks crumbled as his voice echoed through the battlefield. "Stop underestimating me!" Carrion yelled as he burst through the mountain.

He was now using the Unique Skill Felix-sama described to her, increasing his power quite a bit.

Saeko decided to attempt to measure Carrion's total Energy and estimate the amount of Existence Points he had. She could do such a thing because Felix-sama had released his Aura on varying levels and told them approximately how much Energy he was releasing, she could theoretically measure another person's EP by comparing it to the various levels that Felix-sama had released.

When Felix-sama had explained the concept of EP to them, she had been confused. Why did they need to place a number on someone's rank when they could just sense their Energy?

Felix-sama had said not everyone was capable of sensing Energy to that degree. EP was meant to allow even the common soldiers to understand the general threat level of an enemy, and it tended to be far more accurate than the Free Guild's ranking system.

Going by the Existence Points, Carrion was likely around the 700,000 range now that he was fully transformed with his Unique Skill. He was in the S Class range.

Fairly powerful but still below her, Saeko thought proudly.

Felix-sama had also released higher levels of Energy, what he called 5,000,000 EP, and then 10,000,000 EP. When facing those at those levels, Felix-sama simply said to run away if possible.

The amount of power he had showcased that day had left them all in awe. Even the Three Demonesses had been awestruck. They all knew he was powerful, but Felix-sama usually kept a tight leash on his power. To see him let loose was truly awe-inspiring.

Saeko shook her head and focused back on the fight that was taking place in front of her.

"Why don't you make me take you seriously then?!" Megumin laughed out.

Carrion simply charged at Megumin, leaving behind a sonic explosion in the process.

Saeko floated upward, giving them space to continue their brief scuffle.

Carrion's fist collided with Megumin's palm with a loud bang, but Megumin caught his punch effortlessly. With a grin, she crushed his hand before slamming her knee into his chest, causing Carrion to cough up blood.

Megumin was seemingly not done with her abuse as she pulled her leg back and kicked upwards, kicking Carrion in the groin. Megumin had even imbued some of her Energy into her kick, enough to bypass Carrion's Pain Resistance Skill almost completely.

Crack

Carrion gasped in agony before collapsing, his face contorted with pain.

Saeko couldn't suppress her wince at just how… brutal Megumin was being. She recalled one time in the distant past, before she had even met Felix-sama, back when she was just a child, Shuna had gotten angry at Benimaru and had kicked him in the groin.

Benimaru's scream of pain would always reside in her memories, same for Hiiro and Souei's scarred looks.

"Come on! Walk it off! You don't have regeneration for nothing!" Megumin laughed out.

Megumin truly was a Daemon.

- Felix -

I snapped my fingers, teleporting to Tempest to pick Rimuru up.

Dealing with Chronoa may be super easy if Hinata or Chloe are the ones in control, or it may turn out to be a pain in the ass if the other Ego inside of them is in control.

I assume this other Ego will have access to all the powers both Hinata and Chloe had access to, which was enough power to seal Veldora, even if he was just a berserker back then.

Chronoa has a ton of combat experiences, thousands of years of it, in fact, likely more if you count her past loops.

But I was still pretty excited to face her, it wasn't often that I got to face someone as strong as I thought Chronoa to be. Hopefully I wasn't just hyping her up in my mind.

I appeared in Tempest. The moment I sensed Rimuru's exact location, my wings extended behind me, and I took to the skies. With a flap of them, I instantly appeared in front of the building he was in.

I looked down at the building. "A sushi shop, huh?"

I descended and walked through the doors. A pleasant jingle emanated from the bell atop the door.

I saw Rimuru sitting on one of the stools, with Benimaru next to him.

Rimuru turned around to look at me as he popped some sushi into his mouth. "Oh hey, Felix!"

Benimaru nodded at me. I returned his greeting with a nod of my own.

"Don't talk with your mouth open." I reprimanded.

Rimuru rolled his eyes. "Now you're acting just like Shuna."

"Yeah, yeah. Come on, let's go, it's done."

Rimuru immediately caught on to what I was saying. He turned to Benimaru, but before he could speak, Benimaru cut him off.

"It is fine, Lord Rimuru. I will simply enjoy these delectable plates of sushi myself." Benimaru said with a smug smirk.

Rimuru's lips twitched, but he nodded.

"Did you come up with a way to deal with Chronoa?"

Rimuru nodded slightly. "I think I have something that'll work."

I nodded. "I'll leave that to you then."

I placed my hand on his shoulder and teleported us directly to Luminous's Burial Chamber in her palace in Night Garden.

We both looked to Luminous, who was waiting in front of the Holy Ark.

"Felix, Rimuru." Greeted Luminous.

I just gave her a nod since we had just been together minutes ago.

"Hey, Luminous." Greeted Rimuru. He then turned to me. "Now, let's get this show on the road!"

I nodded and snapped my fingers, creating a portal to an uninhabited Dimension.

"This Dimension has no life in it, so we should feel free to ignore all the damage that may be caused. It's a Dimension I searched out specifically for our purposes. It is a fairly neutral Dimension as it does not favor any Element heavily."

Some Dimensions lean towards certain elements. For example, I was able to travel to a Dimension that was basically just an ocean, an ocean that encompassed a planet larger than Jupiter, and no, it was not the One Piece world, sadly.

Rimuru and Luminous both nodded. I waved my hand, causing the portal to move and encompass the Holy Ark, sending it to another Dimension.

I walked towards the portal and gestured to Luminous. "Ladies first."

She rolled her eyes but walked through, followed by Rimuru. Once they were through, I walked through, taking a deep breath as I took in the air of this new world.

Luminous and Rimuru were both looking around in quiet wonder. I spotted the Holy Ark a couple of feet away from Luminous.

"So this is another world huh?" Voiced out Rimuru.

"You're literally an Otherworlder Rimuru." I pointed out.

"That's different from this!" He responded.

Luminous nodded. "Indeed, even though I have not had the pleasure of venturing to another world, the possibilities of such an ability are endless. To have an infinite number of worlds at your beck and call is truly wondrous."

I laughed when I heard that. "I think my ego has been stroked enough, Luminous."

Luminous snorted, hearing me. "Indeed, your arrogance is not something you keep hidden."

I shrugged my shoulders. "I'm strong, and so I'm arrogant."

Luminous nodded. "It is your right as one of the strong to be as arrogant as you wish. Simply be mindful not to allow that arrogance to become foolishness."

I nodded at Luminous's very reasonable advice. "Yeah, I'm aware of the folly of being too arrogant. But thanks for looking out for me, Luminous, I mean it." I said while looking at Luminous with a smile.

She coughed and turned away from me, a light dusting of red on her cheeks.

She really is weak on the defense, huh? She can act all seductive and is a very attractive woman, but when someone does it back, she goes weak in the knees.

How amusing.

Though Luminous's advice is valid, being too arrogant has resulted in the doom of many beings. It's why I'm constantly trying to make sure I don't get too full of myself. One day I may seriously face someone I need to take completely seriously, but I fail to do so due to my own arrogance.

I am not going to be pulling a Gilgamesh anytime soon if ever!

"Alright, now let's get this started." I voiced out. Both Rimuru and Luminous straightened up and began taking this seriously.

I snapped my fingers placing a few barriers around the surrounding area meant to contain our fight. This world wasn't anywhere near as durable as the Cardinal World, if Saeko released her entire Aura she would crack the planet let alone any of us.

Luminous reached into her Spatial Storage and pulled out a God Grade weapon, while Rimuru also did the same. Both of them quickly made some distance between themselves and the Holy Ark.

I did not feel the need to use Yamato just yet. I had Rimuru and Luminous as back up so I could take it a little easy to start with. It wasn't like I was at my strongest when using a weapon, I was just as good at martial arts, I just had cooler abilities I could use when using Yamato. And the rule of cool is supreme!

I gently placed my hand on the Holy Ark but did not activate Anti-Skill. I turned around. "You two ready?!"

Both of them nodded, I turned back to look at the Holy Ark..

If I could contain her to a certain area that would be best.

I activated Anti-Skill and completely nullified the seal Luminous made altogether.

I jumped back the moment the seal was undone.

An eruption of Aura emerged from the being within the seal, it felt even more powerful than Rimuru and Luminous.

Well, I have a feeling that this is going to end up in a fight….

- Rimuru Tempest -

Rimuru shivered as he felt the evil Aura that Chronoa was emanating wash over him. It was easily one of the most powerful beings he had felt in his life.

'Warning. Target possesses a material body. Abnormal power detected—limit is similar to the power of individual Veldora.'

Rimuru let out a weary sigh. Of course her upper limit is potentially on par with Veldora's.

At least he could actually calculate the amount of power Chronoa possessed, unlike the first time he saw her at the Dwelling of the Spirits.

Small victories and all that.

The fact that this being likely had Chloe and Hinata's combat experience was going to be a big challenge, but they had Luminous and Felix along with himself. Hopefully, between the three of them, they could manage to pacify Chronoa.

He had considered bringing Veldora as well, but Rimuru didn't feel comfortable taking Tempest's sole last defense against powerful beings; he didn't think that Veldora was necessary for this since they had Felix, who seemed to be on the same level.

Freaking cheater.
His gaze shifted as Chronoa stirred, her eyes slowly opening for the first time in what felt like an eternity.

- Felix -

I watched as Chronoa slowly opened her eyes, taking in her surroundings with an eerie calm.

She had the same black hair that Chloe had, though Chronoa's seemed to have an ethereal quality to it, likely due to evolution.

From what I'm sensing, Chronoa does not possess an Ultimate Skill, but something within her is preventing me from getting a deep analysis of her Skills.

She was completely naked save for the bracelet on her arm. The same bracelet Hinata had and passed on to Chloe, a bracelet that contained both Hinata's armor and weapon.

I attempted to shift Space to steal the bracelet, but that failed since it was bound to Chloe and, by extension, Chronoa.

Chronoa seemingly noticed my attempt and immediately looked in my direction, a look of anger finally appearing on her face.

The bracelet on her wrist began to glow as black particles began to cover her entire body. Moments later, jet-black armor formed on her, followed by a rapier in her hand.

They seemed to be the same ones that Hinata used and passed on to Chloe, except they were of higher quality, both now God Grade Equipment. They likely evolved through the ages.

It seems I'll have to make Hinata a new weapon and armor once she's out of Chloe's body since I doubt she will take the weapons she passed on back.

This time, unlike the slightly inferior God Grade rapier I had given her that was made through Material Creation, I can give her a top-notch God Grade rapier and armor thanks to Brahma.

I'm sure she'll be happy.

'Notice. Odin has developed a combat mode through analysis of Milim Nava. Would the Master like to don it?'

'Oh? A combat mode, huh? Good thinking on creating that Odin, but no, not right now. I don't know how that will affect my combat power. It's best if I get a handle on my current power and then think about adding more on top of it.'

'Affirmative.'

Even if Odin could perfectly control my power, that does not equate to me being able to do the same.

It's my power. I'll be damned if I can't even properly control it. It'll take me some time to get my power back under control on my own efforts. The increase in Energy was just that drastic. If Odin lets go of her control for even a moment, I'd release torrents of power that would kill everyone in the vicinity.

But I'll definitely have to test this combat mode against Milim, though. Heh, I can already see her reaction.

Seeing that I was distracted, Chronoa raised her palm in my direction. With a sharp crackle, black lightning blazed towards me.

I didn't bother dodging it, trusting Infinity to take care of it.

I smirked as the black lightning practically stopped in front of me. Her attack made use of Spiritrons, if it wasn't for the modifications Odin made on Infinity earlier, I'd have to dodge this. But now? I didn't even have to flinch.

Odin for the win!

Chronoa didn't give me another glance. She shifted her focus to Luminous. With a flick of her wrist, she slashed her rapier, sending a vicious Aura Slash and a shockwave that made the air hum. Luminous barely managed to evade it, leaping to the side in a flash of motion.

Her cold gaze returned to me. This time, her movements were sharper, more calculated. She raised her sword again, and even before she struck, I could feel the shift in the atmosphere. This wasn't like the earlier attack. As she slashed, the very fabric of space was torn asunder, a gaping wound in space racing towards me.

'Notice. The individual Chronoa possesses the Unique Skill: Absolute End.'

Ah, I see. That's basically just the Spatial Severing Unique Skill I used to have. I bent Space to my will, completely nullifying Chronoa's attack.

"Alright, let's focus on suppressing Chronoa!" I called out.

It had only been a moment since Chronoa first opened her eyes, yet Rimuru didn't use that moment he had unwisely. Earlier, he had raised his palm into the sky and activated Beelzebuth, sucking in the Magicules all around us and forcing them into a massive ball.

I purposefully chose a Dimension that had no filter over it so that Luminous and Rimuru could make use of the Magicules in the air.

Rimuru lowered his palm, sending the ball of raw, unfiltered Magicules resembling a meteor toward Chronoa, who didn't seem nervous in the slightest.

Yet, I watched as she sliced downwards without even a blink, cleaving the sphere of Magicules cleanly in half and causing the Magicules to disperse harmlessly into the air.

"H-Hey! That's cheating!" Rimuru called out.

Yet, Luminous wasn't about to let the opening Rimuru had made slide. In a flash, she appeared above Chronoa, her sword slashing downward with a fierce cry. But Chronoa was ready. She parried the blow effortlessly, the force of the deflection sending Luminous stumbling back.

Luminous landed on the ground, sliding for a few feet as her grip on her blade tightened and her teeth clenched in frustration. "I forgot how much of a pain she is to deal with!"

"Blame Rimuru, he's the one that taught her."

"Hey! That's not my fault!" Protested Rimuru. "You taught Hinata! So this is also your fault!"

Both Luminous and Rimuru darted in, attacking from opposite sides in perfect sync. Their blades gleamed as they aimed for precise, non-lethal strikes to disable Chronoa. However, Rimuru's strike was blocked instantly, Chronoa's rapier intercepting his sword with ease. At the same moment, Luminous's sword landed a blow, but it didn't pierce Chronoa's armor.

I noticed that Luminous's strike did do a small amount of damage to her armor, but it failed to pierce through. Chronoa was actively reinforcing her armor with her Fighting Spirit elevating it even further.

Luminous had the skill to match Chronoa but not the raw power, not yet, at least.

The clashing of metal echoed in the air as Luminous and Chronoa exchanged a flurry of blows, yet every thurst or slice would be met with either a block or a parry, forcing Luminous back with every move. Yet even then, they were fairly matched, as Chronoa was not dealing any real damage to her.

I could sense her Ultimate Skill, Asmodeus, wrapped around Luminous's blade, the Lust Energy crackling with intensity, enhancing her strikes. The gap between her and Chronoa wasn't insurmountable, but Chronoa's sheer physical strength and skill made her a formidable opponent, even for someone as talented as Luminous.

I decided not to intervene. Perhaps this could be an opportunity for Luminous to grow further. I'll simply act as the insurance in case things get bad.

In fact, why don't I make use of this time? "Can you two deal with Chronoa for a few minutes? I'm going to try and analyze her."

Rimuru didn't look back, but I saw the slight nod of his head, his focus still entirely on Chronoa. Luminous, too, seemed ready, her resolve clear as she prepared for the next clash.

If I could get a read on how she fought, when I jump in I should be able to defeat her fairly easily.

For the next few minutes, Luminous and Rimuru continued their assault, testing Chronoa's limits while I stayed back, firing the occasional pot shot. My primary focus, though, was studying her movements and her patterns, analyzing the nuances of her fighting style.

She was an incredibly advanced swordswoman, perhaps she would be a match for me in pure swordsmanship, and I've stol– copi– "borrowed" a lot of different swordsmanship styles and incorporated it into my own.

Guy's, Hakurou's, Rimuru's, Agera's, Milim's and now Chronoa's.

"Alright, that's enough playing around. I think I got it. I'll deal with Chronoa while you and Luminous coordinate."

"Got it!"

I had wanted to see what Chronoa was made of, and also use this as a chance to test out the new power I have available to me.

I appeared in front of Chronoa. "I'm your new playmate now." I tauntedwith a grin.

Chronoa seemingly didn't like that as she appeared in front of me, her blade aimed directly at my head.

Yet, I casually caught her blade between two of my fingers. I didn't even need to use any Aura. This was just raw physical power.

"Going straight for the head, huh?" I teased, watching her eyes narrow as she tried to pull her blade free.

Frustrated, she kicked out at me, aiming a strike for my crotch, while simultaneously trying to distort the space around us, hoping to bypass Infinity. Clever, but not enough. Her spatial manipulation was good, but it wasn't anywhere near the level needed to overwhelm me. Not yet.

Despite Chronoa's efforts, Infinity still stopped her kick, just as it had all of her previous attacks.

"You're going there, huh? Not cool."

Mimicking her move, I delivered a solid kick to her stomach, sending her rocketing backward through the air at blinding speeds, fast enough that any normal person would have been vaporized by the sheer force.

As Chronoa was flying through the air, I appeared behind her and kicked her once again, then again, then again.

I was basically just ragdolling her Dragon Ball style.

Honestly? This was kinda fun.

This probably would have gone differently if one of her main abilities wasn't her Spatial Manipulation, something I could easily overwhelm with my superior mastery over the concept.

She may even have some Temporal abilities. In fact, it's likely that she does. But it is probably extremely conditional, similar to her time-traveling ability. Time isn't considered the most powerful Element for nothing.

A few moments later Chronoa let out a scream of rage, her Aura erupting forth from her with even more intensity.

She managed to barely dodge my next kick and quickly dashed at me, her sword now blazing in Fighting Spirit.

"Felix, we're ready!" Rimuru called out.

I nodded and immediately stopped sandbagging. It seems I'll have to rely on Milim to truly test out my new power.

I appeared behind her and grabbed her from under her armpits, leaving her immobilized.

Rimuru and Luminous both immediately appeared in front of Chronoa, the Anti-Magic Mask in hand, he placed it on her face.

What are they doing?

'The individual Rimuru Tempest has used the Anti-Magic Mask to temporarily suppress Chronoa, now with the help of Luminous Valentine's Asmodeus, Lord of Lust, he is attempting to enter the Spiritual Plane of Chloe Auburt and stabilize her from the inside.'

Huh, well, that's a pretty good plan. Asmodeus would be pretty good for that. It deals with the Soul, after all.

'Affirmative. Would the Master like to enter the Spiritual Plane of Chloe Auburt? From there, it is theoretically possible to enter the Spiritual Plane of Hinata Sakaguchi.'

'Do it.'

And then everything faded to darkness.

- Luminous Valentine -

As Rimuru placed the mask onto Chronoa, Luminous hoped that the Slime's plan would succeed. What she hadn't been expecting was for Felix to follow along.

She quickly appeared behind Felix and caught him, carrying him in a princess carry.

Heh, when he woke up, he would definitely be embarrassed!

Luminous looked towards Chronoa and Rimuru, who were both now laying on the floor.

She had done her part, now, she could only pray that Felix and Rimuru were successful.

The brief battle she had with Chronoa pointed out some of the flaws in her swordsmanship; she had only recently begun incorporating her Ultimate Skill into her swordsmanship, and there were still some flaws that had yet to be corrected.

Gaining Asmodeus, Lord of Lust, had been a qualitative change to her total combat power. Once she was able to properly master the Skill, she would become far more powerful.

She was eager to reach that level. Perhaps it would finally put Felix's ego in its place, even if she doubted that mastering Asmodeus alone was enough to reach his level.

The amount of Energy he had radiated after gaining the Dragon Factors was enormous. From what she sensed, he had almost as much Energy as Veldora, a True Dragon!

- Felix -

I could feel myself entering the Spiritual world of Chloe.

'The Unique Skill: Time Traveler has been analyzed.'

It seems that now we are basically in Chloe/Chronoa's Soul, Odin can copy her Skills without interference. I'm guessing that the one preventing Odin's analysis was Chronoa.

'The likelihood of such a scenario is high.'

"Long time no see… Rimuru." I heard a voice call out. I turned and saw Rimuru in his Slime form talking with a black-haired woman.

But that wasn't the only person here. I could also see Chronoa, who was looking at Rimuru in confusion.

I placed my hand on Chronoa's form and quickly scanned her. I analyzed the bracelet on her wrist, it stored Chronoa's armor and weapon and then instantly deployed both the moment that Chronoa willed it.

I created a copy of the bracelet and the Equipment stored within it with Brahma and left it in my Infinity Space to give to Hinata later.

I quickly extracted the Unique Skill from Chloe without any resistance and then placed it into Hinata.

"Rebirth." I whispered, applying Asmodeus' effect through Brahma's sub-skill to streamline the process of resurrecting Hinata and fully healing her Soul.

I basically grabbed Hinata's Soul from within Chloe, and then placed it inside of her body before using Asmodeus to resurrect her. It costed a decent chunk of Energy for a normal person, around 1,750,000 EP but I instantly regenerated most of it, and with my newly increased capacity that was peanuts to me.

"Asmodeus?" I heard Luminous whisper behind me.

Ah, welp she knows I have Asmodeus now. Eh, I don't think that's all that large of an issue.

"Ah, the Soul Corridor!" Luminous muttered.

I'm pretty sure she is doing something women are well-known for. She's overthinking it. Oh well, that misunderstanding of hers is helpful for me. I wouldn't straight up lie to her, but not correcting a misunderstanding that she made on her own isn't really lying now, is it?

'Notice. Placing the Unique Skill: Usurper inside the Soul of Hinata Sakaguchi.'

"There… and done." I called out.

Hinata's hair regained its luster. Her heart began beating once more, and the blood within her body began flowing. Her pale skin quickly regained its color, with even a subtle flush as the blood began to flow through her entire body, revitalizing her.

Hinata's eyes flutter open. "Ah… Felix."

"I told you I'd bring you back from the dead."

She slowly smiled and nodded. "You did." She groaned as she sat up. Before she could react, she was tackled into a hug by Luminous; Hinata returned the hug.

"Hinata!" Luminous cried out.

"Hello Luminous. It's been quite sometime now." Responded Hinata.

As Hinata and Luminous reunited, I observed Chronoa, with Hinata's foreign Soul removed. She should be waking up soon. I noticed Chronoa's Soul was sort of nestled within Chloe's Soul, strengthening it while also supporting Chloe's Soul.

Chronoa's eyes snapped open. She quickly looked around the area, as if searching for something. She lept towards Rimuru when she spotted him. "Rimuru!" She yelled as she tackled him into a hug.

It seems the one in control now is Chloe. The form she was using shifted back into her child form as she continued clinging to Rimuru.

"Ayo, that looks super suspicious, Rimuru! Careful not to summon the interdimensional FBI." I called out. His lips twitched as he ignored me.

Even while I was teasing Rimuru, I was observing Chloe very, very closely. She was strong. I didn't get the chance to do a detailed analysis on her before, but now that I am, her Energy is comparable to Veldora. It seems having hatched two Hero's Eggs did something very special.

Hinata's Hero's Egg was transferred over to Chloe at some point, and so Chloe had undergone a double Awakening, skyrocketing in power and likely immediately acquiring Divinity.

Awakening two Hero's Eggs at once is crazy. I doubt anything like that has been done before.

The amount of Energy Chloe had was just absurd, she had a bit more than even I do, even with the Dragon Factors providing me a significant buff.

Damn Heroes and their broken hax.

Hinata wasn't so bad herself now. Even without her Hero's Egg, she was now a Complete Saint, a fully Spiritual Lifeform now and wouldn't have to rely on her armor as a crutch to temporarily Spiritualize herself.

She has the potential to obtain Divinity as well which may boost her power a bit more as well.

Her EP was a little below 2,000,000, but she'd get there eventually.

"Wait, two Hero's Eggs?!" Yelled Rimuru.

I nodded. "It seems Hinata's Hero's Egg was transferred over to Chloe."

I sensed Hinata approaching me from behind. "Indeed, Felix is right. I no longer possess the qualification to become a True Hero. I'm sorry, Felix."

I raised a brow and turned around to face her. "Oh? What are you sorry about?"

"Did you not wish to teach me due to my status as a Hero's Egg holder? Due to being curious about what effects a True Demon Lord would have on a Hero's Egg wielder?" Asked Hinata.

I nodded. "That was my motivation at the start, but eh, I don't really care all that much anymore. Do what you want, Hinata."

She snorted. "I'd do so even without you having to tell me that!"

I rolled my eyes. "Yeah, yeah."

Luminous walked up from behind Hinata and headed towards Chloe. The two quickly hugged.

Hinata clenched her fists. "It is quite surreal being back in my own body, after spending more time in another's body than my own. This feels quite… off."

I shrugged my shoulders. "You'll get used to it in time." I wasn't as attached to my body as most due to my Spiritual nature. I could always ditch this body or make a new one, but this one was already really strong with True Dragon levels of durability. It would be a shame to lose it.

Hinata nodded.

"Alright, now why don't we head back." I called out.

Chloe and Luminous separated as Chloe looked at me curiously. "Where exactly are we Felix-nii? Chronoa is saying that we are in a different Space-Time, a different Dimension entirely."

I nodded. "And she would be right. I brought us to an empty Dimension in case we'd end up fighting with Chronoa." I took a good look at the destroyed surroundings. "That seems to have been a good idea."

Chloe blushed and looked away. "Ah, she said she's sorry."

"She can apologize by giving me a better fight next time, that was boring, I was expecting more from the so-called Masked Hero." I laughed out.

Chloe pouted, hearing me. "Fine then!"

"A different Dimension?" I heard Hinata mutter.

"We can talk about it more later. For now, let's go." I said as I snapped my fingers, creating a portal back to Ruberious, more specifically to Luminous' palace in Night Garden.

Everyone nodded and walked through the portal. "Mistress." Gunther called out as he appeared.

Luminous nodded towards him. "Gunther, prepare some snacks for our guests."

He nodded. "As you wish." He then vanished.

"Come, follow me." Said Luminous. We all followed behind Luminous as she led us to her lounge.

We all took our seats as Gunther appeared and placed a variety of snacks on the table along with tea.

Chloe was sitting next to Rimuru, while Luminous was at the head of the table with Hinata next to me.

Luminous took a sip of her tea and then smiled at Chloe. "I'm sure you have a lot to tell us now. I assume your restriction of telling me as little as possible to maintain the future is null and void now?"

Chloe nodded. "Yup! Now that we're back in the present it won't matter what Hinata or I share."

"Then why don't you start with why you call me Felix-nii?" I asked.

Chloe looked at me in confusion. "Didn't I always call you that?"

I shook my head. "Nope, the first time you, or rather, Chronoa called me that was when we were in your Spiritual Plane."

Chloe had a look of realization on her face. "Ah! That's right, that's right. That would make sense, wouldn't it?" She whispered to herself. "Well why don't I just start at the beginning, then? That way, you all can have the full picture."

I nodded. "That's fine with me."

"Sounds good to me." Said Rimuru.

Luminous nodded. "Indeed, I am looking forward to hearing this entire story of yours rather than just bits and pieces."

Chloe nodded. "Great! Did Luminous explain my ability to you two?"

Rimuru nodded. "Yeah, she said you've been time looping for a long time and that it's been pretty much out of your control."

Chloe nodded. "Right, I was able to figure out the condition of my time looping over time, but I had no real way to control it."

"Oh? What's the condition?" I asked.

Hinata coughed next to me. "The condition is for me to die. I need to die in front of Chloe."

I looked at her weirdly. "That's an odd condition, but alright then." Skills functioned pretty weirdly, so I wasn't going to question it.

Chloe nodded. "The first timeline was drastically different from the ones after."

I nodded. "Yeah, I bet it was. Veldora likely wasn't sealed since you were originally the person who sealed him. If there was an original timeline, then there would be no Chronoa in it, which would change things quite a bit."

Chloe nodded. "Right, I don't remember much about the first timeline other than the fact that it was very different, so unfortunately, I can't tell you guys a lot about it."

"It's fine, Chloe." Rimuru said reassuringly.

Chloe blushed before continuing. "Then after that, there were numerous timelines, hundreds, thousands, tens of thousands, I'm not sure, I don't exactly remember every one of them, but I know there were a lot."

I looked at Chloe weirdly. She just lightheartedly talked about what I would consider to be some of the worst torture I've ever heard of.

Like, what the fuck? Imagine having everyone you love die, but then you go back to the start. You have hope that you can change things, but in the end, everything still fails, and they die, and then you go back to the start again, and again, and again. That would be enough to break a normal person, but I guess a Hero is no normal person.

Rimuru also likely came to the same conclusion, taking out some sweets from his Stomach and giving them to Chloe while patting her head. "At least you're here now. We'll make sure you don't have to go through that again, I promise." Rimuru declared.

Woah, Rimuru had a shonen moment!

'Record that!'

'Affirmative.'

Chloe shyly nodded. "Un!"

"In most of the loops, Rimuru ended up dying in the invasion of the Eastern Empire." Chloe said.

"Hold up, the East actually invaded?" I interjected.

Chloe nodded. "Un. After a few years, they eventually gathered enough supplies and troops to launch their invasion of the world basically. This is usually when I'm sent back in time."

"What went differently this time around? You were sent back much earlier, going by your words."

Chloe nodded. "There was one key difference in this timeline when compared to the rest. In this one, both you and Rimuru are True Demon Lords."

I raised a brow. "We weren't in the others?"

Chloe shook her head. "You were, but much later, and Rimuru was already dead by that point."

"What do you think was the main reason for this difference then?" Asked Rimuru.

"The Falmuth Invasion." Chloe answered with no hesitation.

"Oh? What went differently this time around?"

Chloe looked slightly nervous now. "Well, usually Rimuru makes it back in time to kick out the army of Falmuth and tear apart the Otherworlders, using them as a message, but he never kills them."

My eyes lit up in realization. "He never kills them, so no Harvest Festival."

Chloe nodded. "That's right. Thanks to this, he was much weaker in the long run, allowing the Eastern Empire to catch him off guard."

Yeah, I can see that. Rimuru wouldn't have a single Ultimate Skill without the Energy from his Harvest Festival, meanwhile, the Eastern Empire might possibly have a few Ultimate Awakened.

Sorcerer's Dynasty Sarion has 2 Ultimate Awakened, so it wouldn't be unbelievable for an Empire as rich in history as the Eastern Empire to also have multiple Ultimate Awakened.

"What did I do?" I asked more for confirmation's sake since Luminous had already told us some of this information beforehand.

"You did something similar to this time around with slight differences. You did not wipe out Clayman's entire army. You simply challenged Clayman to a one-on-one duel, using his pride against him, defeating him, and then usurped his position as one of the Ten Great Demon Lords."

I nodded. "So, no Harvest Festival for me either. Luminous did tell us bits and pieces, but it's nice to get the whole picture. Now I get what made things different. We were weaker, so the Eastern Empire was able to take advantage of that. Why did this timeline change so much?"

Chloe nodded as if she was expecting this question. "In this timeline, for some reason, when Rimuru took us to the Dwelling of the Spirits, I recalled fragments of my memories. These fragments sort of came in the form of sudden urges, moments where I knew I had to do something, anything at all. One of these moments was when Rimuru was leaving us to return to Tempest."

Now, why would she have recalled her memories early in this timeline when she hadn't in the countless previous ones?

'Notice. It is possible that Chloe Aubert's Spiritual Energy finally overwhelmed the mental block she had that prevented her from recalling her memories.'

I see. Well that's as good a theory as any.

Rimuru's eyes widened. "When you asked me not to go, and I gave you the mask?"

Chloe nodded. "That's right. I didn't know why I was doing what I was at that point, but I trusted my instincts."

Rimuru's eyes lit up in realization. "You stalled me. Thanks to that, I didn't make it back to Tempest in time. The damage had been dealt, and Felix and I became True Demon Lords."

Chloe winced but nodded while I just took all the information in.

I closed my eyes and activated Thought Acceleration. Chloe was indirectly the cause of that entire mess, Saeko's death, Shuna's death, and the death of everyone back in that attack. I was pretty angry, but I knew Chloe really had no other choice.

I calmed down and began looking at things objectively. Objectively what Chloe did may have saved our lives. If she's telling the truth about the future, then without the Falmuth Invasion going the way it did in this timeline, we'd lose. Rimuru would die, and I'm sure Veldora would then be released from within Rimuru since Rimuru was basically acting as his seal at that point. Veldora would rampage. I'd likely have attempted to stop Veldora so he doesn't destroy Tempest.

It would be a mess, a huge mess.

I could look at things objectively and see that Chloe made the right move. She herself said she didn't quite know what she was doing when she stalled Rimuru, she just knew she had to do something or she would lose Rimuru, but emotionally, I was still angry.

I would need to process all this later. I sure as hell didn't want to attack Chloe like I did Yuuki, as if I was some berserker. She was put in a shit situation and made the best of it.

This isn't like she was Yuuki or Clayman. She didn't engineer the entire Falmuth Invasion. She used a fixed point in history to her advantage to make sure Rimuru and Tempest survived the coming years.

I would still need to process things more later.

I opened my eyes, and not even a moment had passed. I could see the light of betrayal in Rimuru's eyes, and I could tell that Chloe noticed that, going by the sad look on her face.

I sighed. "Rimuru, she was in a shit situation. Think of it like this, if she didn't do what she did, you would be dead in a couple years' time. Tempest may or may not be destroyed in a couple of years time. Everything you'd have built and worked for would have been gone. I'm angry too, but think things through logically. Chloe has proved that she is not an enemy."

Ugh, why do I have to be the one to defend Chloe? No matter my anger, I knew that without Chloe, we would probably be doomed, Time bullshit is just that, bullshit. It can even affect someone dramatically stronger than you, just due to their ability to change the past and, therefore, change the future and the present.

Rimuru sighed but nodded. "I know. I just need time to think." Rimuru smiled at Chloe. "Just give me some time."

Chloe nodded. "As much time as you need! I've gotten used to waiting patiently."

Rimuru and I winced hearing that.

Chloe then looked at me. "I-I'm sorry about the effects that my plan had on you and your loved ones, Felix-nii. I didn't quite know how much death that one change would cause."

I felt Hinata place a hand on my thigh as a show of comfort. I turned to her and winked, causing her to blush before looking at Chloe with a sigh. What was I supposed to say to such an earnest apology?

"I'm not going to say it's fine, but I can understand your perspective. You had two bad hands dealt to you. You chose the one that wasn't the absolute worst option."

Chloe nodded. "Thanks Felix-nii."

"Yeah, yeah."

Perhaps I was being biased against Chloe due to knowing what she had been through; anyone could empathize with her situation, and I sure as hell didn't take it easy on Yuuki. But in the end, Yuuki was partially to blame for the attack. Chloe was a bit different compared to that.

I sighed. I hate Time bullshit. It was all so confusing and complicated.

Luminous and Hinata were silent the entire time, likely giving us time to think and process everything. It's not like the Falmuth Invasion really affected either of them in any way.

"So you did not tell the entire truth to me then, Chloe, Hinata?" Asked Luminous.

Hinata is the one who answered this time. "We were afraid that if we informed you too much about the current timeline, then things may change. Which is why we told you about previous timelines, telling you how things should have gone but didn't go in this timeline."

Luminous glared before sighing. "Very well then. I am upset, but I can understand."

Hinata smiled. "Thanks, Luminous."

Luminous turned away. "Hmph!"

"I-I'll continue now." Said Chloe. "Since after so many loops, something finally went differently, Hinata and I were determined to return to this future, and so we kept past events the same before eventually being sealed in the Holy Ark, and we were successful." Finished Chloe.

"That's one hell of a story." I commented.

Hinata smirked at me proudly. "Heh, I sealed Veldora. Could you say the same, Felix?" Hinata asked tauntingly.

I looked at her dryly. "Maybe, maybe not. But you sealed a nerfed Veldora, one without an Ultimate Skill and one that had no combat instinct. Maybe you can boast if you manage to beat the current Veldora."

Hinata's lips twitched. "Fine, fine, but I will enjoy taunting Veldora with my victory over him."

I rolled my eyes. "Child."

"I am not a child!"

"Should I call you a hag then?" I responded with a roll of my eyes.

"Hmph!" Hinata pouted as she pretended to not have heard me, looking to the side with some annoyance.

Hinata was usually calm and level-headed, but now she was acting childish.

"Well, I'm not sure about Rimuru, but I'd like to hear a bit more about my alternate self. I heard from Luminous that he taught you Distortion Field, Chloe, and then you taught that to Luminous."

Chloe nodded. "Yup! That version of Felix-nii didn't undergo the Harvest Festival, so he was weaker than you are now. But from that weakness came innovation. He came up with some new Arts that were really strong. One of them he taught to me due to him seeing my talent with Spatial Magic. It was Distortion Field. I taught that Art to Hinata, and then she taught it to Luminous."

I nodded. "I see." I turned to Hinata. "I would normally be surprised that you managed to learn something like that. You aren't a monstrous talent at Spatial Magic, but it seems my Blessing did all the heavy lifting."

Hinata nodded. "Right, without your Blessing, it would have taken me far longer to learn. Thanks for that."

"No problem. It seems the intent I have when Blessing someone matters, so it automatically transferred to you when your Soul binded to Mathematician and was transferred to Chloe."

Hinata blushed. "Right… your intent."

"So, tell me more about my alternate. I wanna hear what he's missing out on."

Hinata laughed. "Of course, you think he's the one missing out. Did it ever cross your mind that you may be missing out on something?"

I put my hands behind my head and leaned back. "Nah. Well, there is one thing." I said.

"Oh? I didn't think you'd admit that. What is it that the great Felix may be missing out on?" Hinata asked curiously.

I gave her a flirty smile. "Well, I heard that you and I were together in one of those other timelines. How unfortunate for me, to miss out on a girl like you." I sighed dramatically. Being a flirt was great, and since I was handsome, I could get away with it. The world was unfair, and I would relentlessly abuse that to my advantage like a dickhead.

Luminous was especially fun to mess with due to her reactions. I even suspected that maybe she was into me, but that wasn't likely. If she was then I'd get to it when she brought it up.

Hinata's lips twitched before she laughed, though I noticed a hint of red on her face. "Pfft, that was horrible, even for you."

I rolled my eyes. "Hey, it was the only material I had!"

"Lucky bastard." I heard Rimuru whisper, while Chloe was giving Hinata a discreet thumbs up.

Weird. My eyes narrowed as a certain suspicion popped up.

Could she really? Perhaps I'm misunderstanding, but I decided that I'd just let things naturally progress if what I was suspecting was true.

"Other than that, I doubt I'm missing out on anything." I said.

Chloe tilted her head. "Hmm, well, not much is different from this timeline, ignoring the obvious. Your subordinates weren't as strong since they did not receive a Gift from your Harvest Festival, and you also did not have any Primordials under your command at that point."

I groaned. "No Arcueid?! Then that must mean that I had to do actual work!"

Chloe laughed. "Fufufu, sort of. You did some work at the beginning before finding someone else to throw your work at. Rimuru tried the same, but Shuna got angry at him."

I laughed. "Haha, whipped!"

Rimuru glared at me. "Shut up!"

Chloe and Hinata told us stories of both Rimuru and I's alternates. Even Luminous was paying attention.

"Looks like our alternates had pretty fun lives."

Rimuru nodded. "Yeah, it's a shame that they don't really exist now."

I shrugged my shoulders. "I'm not that torn up about it. If they existed, I wouldn't exist, and I like existing very much."

The only thing I need to be careful of is not being erased by some Time bullshit from Chloe's end or someone else's end.

'Notice. Odin has begun analyzing the Time Leap function of Chronos, Lord of Space-Time, and has begun making countermeasures.'

'Good.'

"Now that we've goofed off enough, why don't you two tell us about our future enemies?"

Chapter 68: An Alternate History

- Felix -

"Alright, now that we have all the backstory, why don't you tell us all you know about our future enemies? If the Eastern Empire consistently invades in all these timelines, I doubt they won't do so in this one."

I had honestly considered just taking the fight to the Eastern Empire, but honestly, that was a really risky plan. We didn't know much about the infrastructure of the Eastern Empire. Most of the spies I had Lalatina send there didn't return with much useful information.

I had no idea what to expect if I wanted to go solo in the Eastern Empire. I knew I was stronger than most, but I didn't want my arrogance to blind me from the possibility that the Empire might have something that could deal with me. I just didn't have enough information. They had a True Dragon for one, one that used to slap Veldora around even if Veldora's perspective may be a bit biased due to trauma, a True Dragon was still a very dangerous existence.

Even the information about the other timelines wasn't that helpful.

We had learned a lot about some of the other timelines. For one, Hinata was usually sent to Tempest as an envoy from Ruberious, which was meant to see if Tempest truly wished for peace. From there, Tempest would grow closer to Humanity with Hinata's endorsement, and things would only grow from there.

It was pretty interesting to hear about a "What if?" about myself, but I didn't think too much about it. In the end, I wouldn't exist if all those other versions of me hadn't been erased. I could empathize with them because they were a version of me, but in the end, I'm selfish. I'd rather I exist than those other versions of me existing, and if those guys were really me, then I'm sure that they'd feel the same.

But there was still more I wanted to hear about these other timelines, like all the information Chloe and Hinata had on the Eastern Empire, and my actions after Rimuru's death. I wanted to know everything.

Information was key in war, after all. The Eastern Empire had made themselves out to be a threat, and while I had always known that they would likely attempt to expand outwards, I didn't think it would be so soon, and I didn't think we would lose.

It seems that I had underestimated the Eastern Empire.

Earlier, I had simply taken the conversation off track since I could tell that Rimuru needed some time to think everything through. Even with Thought Acceleration, he still needed a few moments to himself.

With my earlier sentence, the cheerful mood vanished. Chloe and Hinata both nodded.

"Right, if I died in all these other timelines, the likelihood that the Eastern Empire was behind my death is pretty high, isn't it? They did invade during that time, right?" Asked Rimuru.

Chloe nodded. "Maybe, I always had a suspicion that the same person who killed Hinata was the one that killed Rimuru. From what I understand, there are a lot of powerful people in the Eastern Empire. Maybe you were defeated by a single person or maybe a group of people."

I nodded. "Rimuru likely wouldn't have been that strong back then. Even with the added five years he had, it was probably still possible to gang up on him, let alone the fact that an Ultimate Awakened would probably beat him."

The difference between post-Harvest Festival Rimuru and pre-Harvest Festival Rimuru was just that vast. He attained Divinity and three Ultimate Skills in a single night and then further went on to develop a fourth Ultimate Skill shortly after.

Rimuru couldn't even manipulate the Laws of the World to a high degree before his Harvest Festival. He would get slapped around by an Ultimate Awakened or someone who could manipulate the Laws of the World.

Rimuru nodded. "Yeah, if someone was able to kill Hinata instantly, then they would probably be able to beat me, too." He was probably remembering the ass-kicking that Hinata had delivered to him before his Harvest Festival.

"There was a flash of light that I couldn't follow, and then Hinata was just dead." Chloe explained. "The person who killed them was either a very powerful Saint, or they had some very high-tier Magi Tech."

"Magi Tech? Like what Sarion does?" I asked curiously.

The Sorcerer's Dynasty Sarion was a Dynasty focused on development. They tried to combine technology and Magic without pushing the boundaries too much due to the Angels and their regular attacks.

Fuck those pigeons.

Chloe nodded. "Sorta, but they are a lot more advanced. Magi Tanks, Air Ships, guns."

Magi Tanks sounds interesting.

But for the Eastern Empire to possibly have Magi Tech, which even Chloe could not perceive, is dangerous. I don't doubt she was quite weak back then. She was likely around the Disaster Class range, I'm guessing, even if she was likely on the lower end.

That kind of weapon might not be a threat to me or my direct subordinates, but an entire military armed with that would destroy the Western Nations military.

I guess I'll finally be putting Sasha to use and see what Magi Tech she can whip up.

"They aren't afraid of the Angels?" Asked Rimuru.

Chloe shrugged her shoulders. "Who knows? I was always helping fight off the Angels during the Tenma Wars in the past, so I'm not sure what the Eastern Empire was up to during those attacks."

Rimuru nodded. "Well, we will have to be careful in that case. Even if Felix and I are Demon Lords now, we don't know how strong the Eastern Empire is."

I nodded. "We do know they have a True Dragon of their own, Velgrynd the Scorch Dragon, so they have some serious firepower."

Rimuru nodded. "Right."

"I recall a battle between Velgrynd and Veldora long ago. It took place on Leon's continent far before he even made a name for himself. That continent is the way it is now due to their battle, the volcanoes, the constant eruptions, all of that is the effect of Velgrynd's lingering Aura." Informed Luminous.

"Yeah, True Dragons are fuck off levels of strong." I mused.

"You both are right. When Rimuru died, there was a brief period of time when Veldora was rampaging without anyone there to counter him.
